reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: I still can't believe how that's a 5 stars resort.I've been to tens of 5 stars hotels and resorts in my life, this one is maximum 3. Very low quality of everything, food, drinks, wifi, room lights, electricity, activities..And the funniest thing was the "all inclusive" booking, you can't get coffee because it's an extra charge, u can't get more than 2 bottles of water to ur room per day, the third will be payed, i still don't get it, the normal human must drink 2 liters per day, they give u 500ml per person, but still u can walk 300m to the bar and get a bottle of water from there..after 11 am only, if u wake up thirsty u are done.They say it's a soft all inclusive, u order soft drinks then..I've never seen such a thing..u order Cola..he brings u a 150ml cup of plastic that costs 0,00001$, and pour into it from the biggest cola bottle which was opened 3 days ago, i really enjoyed the zero Soda in it!!..and the best part was when this plastic cup runs with the weakest flow of wind and it jumps into ur clothes..i don't think this is what the people would love to pay for.Regarding food, same type of food nearly everyday, everyday u get the same with the same gastroenteritis, fresh juices must be forgotten.Wifi u better don't try it..it's not thereIt was so dead, almost no activities, everyday a new problem with the sound system, even at the pool u get no music.In the rooms, if u wanna charge ur phone, u have to keep the lights on, some random problems u get..That was a little of many things...Never coming back..

reviews.title: Catastrophe
reviews.text: Good evening. If you think that you are going to spend an absolutely relaxing vacation here, you are sorely mistaken. We arrived at this resort on September 21st at 3 a.m. Due to extreme fatigue, I didn't even pay attention to the cleanliness of the room. I asked the staff for a thorough cleaning, but it was pointless.​Let's move on to the food: The same thing every day. On the fourth day, I found a bandage with blood in my pasta dish. From that moment on, I stopped eating pre-prepared food. My husband and I then ordered à la carte in the restaurant, but I have to say that not much changed.​The return flight is tonight at 3:30 a.m. We had to leave the room and wait in the hotel lobby for 10 hours. Nothing personal, but simply an absolute disgrace.

reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text: Disappointing Experience – Several Areas Require Significant ImprovementI stayed at this hotel starting from September 22, and unfortunately, my overall experience has been below expectations.Upon arrival at around 1:30 PM, I had to wait until the room was ready and was only able to enter the room at around 3:00 PM. When I entered the room, I found that there were no towels available. In addition, the TV remote control was not working because the batteries needed to be replaced.The swimming pool areas and surrounding floors were not clean and clearly require proper maintenance and renovation. The flooring around the pools was slippery due to algae buildup, which could pose a safety risk to guests.The hardscape areas, including the pathways and areas surrounding the swimming pools, also require better cleaning, maintenance, and refurbishment.Another significant issue is the shortage of staff. In the restaurant, after guests finish their meals, there are often not enough staff members available to clear the used dishes and clean the tables. Similar staffing issues can be noticed at the bars.At the front desk, there was only one employee handling check-in, which resulted in a long waiting time for guests and an unnecessarily slow check-in process.The hotel’s internet/Wi-Fi service was also weak and unreliable during my stay.Regarding the overall guest experience, I noticed that a large proportion of the guests were from Russia and Israel. I also observed differences in guest behavior and appearance that, in my personal experience, affected the overall atmosphere and comfort during the stay.Overall, the hotel has several areas that require significant improvement, particularly cleanliness, housekeeping, pool maintenance, hardscape maintenance, staffing levels, front-desk service, restaurant and bar service, and Wi-Fi connectivity.I hope the management takes these comments seriously and works on improving the quality of service, maintenance, cleanliness, and the overall guest experience.

reviews.title: Stay at Jaz Dahabeya
reviews.text: After 18 trips to Egypt this was easily my favourite hotel. Every aspect was exceptional. The staff couldn't have been more friendly or helpful. The hotel was always immaculately clean and tidy. The main restaurant provided a wide variety of good quality different foods and drinks. Out initial room was very well maintained and we had no issues at all. There was an external power failure at the hotel outside of their control after 5 nights that required us to move rooms, the hotel offered us several different rooms until we found one we wanted to stay in, they were very helpful in changing rooms.All the hotel staff, especially the Front desk guys were fantastic, thanks to Osama and the Hotel Manager for their constant assistance. The entertainments guys were also great fun, I took part in more guest activities than I've ever done before due to they enthusiasm.Highly recommend this hotel if you are thinking of staying in Dahab.

reviews.title: Long-awaited trip to Dahab♥️
reviews.text: Good day everyone! I dreamed of Dahab for a long time, but I always chose Sharm for vacation. This time I definitely knew that I just wanted to be in a quiet, beautiful place where the soul rests. I looked at the Jazz Hotel last year, so I decided on the choice right away. The territory is small, compact, very well-maintained, everything is nearby, and everything is thought out to the smallest detail. Snow-white two-story buildings, in colors, spacious rooms with everything needed for comfortable relaxation. In the center are pools for children and adults, the water is crystal clear. The beach is a few minutes away, equipped with new umbrellas, sunbeds, and wind shelters. Bars by the pool and on the beach, where you can order any drinks, nuts, and chips. Thank you to the bartender Mustafa, a very nice, kind young man, who does his job perfectly and greets with a smile. Thanks for the tastiest mojito🫶❤️‍🔥. Beach entry - sand, which is very convenient for children and people who don't swim very well. Water is always crystal clear, it refreshes a little and gives a boost of vigor and energy. The animation team works at the hotel throughout the day until late evening. The guys and their supervisor Heisam don't let you be bored: charging, aqua aerobics, darts, bocce, volleyball, Arabic language lessons, interesting life hacks from hotel staff, and much more. To my surprise, the hotel has a very diverse evening program: live music several times a week, belly dancing, national dance with a skirt, karaoke, mini discos, and more. It was very exciting and fun with you, thank you very much for the sea of positive emotions, I will remember🫶🤗.I sincerely thank the chef and his team for the very delicious dishes. A wide variety of hot and cold dishes, pureed soups, appetizers, cuts, fruits, dried fruits, vegetables, pastries, etc. Thanks to Ahmed for the morning omelet and pancakes with chocolate 🫶😋. And of course, my special thanks to the most benevolent, most hospitable person in the hotel - dear Sayid and his team: To Ismail, Mohamed, and all the waiters and bartenders (sorry, I couldn't remember all the names). Well-dressed, so attentive, so respectful, well-mannered, so sweet and kind young people. It is immediately clear that the management has very carefully selected the staff, and they are truly perfect!I spent only a short time in this wonderful hotel, but during these 6 days I was surrounded by such attention, care, and the kindest attitude that you don't always find in life. The trip gave me new wonderful acquaintances with people from other cities, from other countries, who come back here again and again. In this hotel, everyone is like one family. I would like to stay for a couple more days... It was a really happy time for me! Loved everyone with all my heart, will remember with warmth and hope for a meeting♥️.

reviews.title: A Hidden Gem in Dahab
reviews.text: Nestled about a mile north of Dahab’s city center, Bedouin Moon Hotel offers a serene escape with stunning views and warm hospitality.- Delicious Breakfast: The Egyptian morning buffet was a daily delight—fresh, flavorful, and something we eagerly anticipated every morning.- Exceptional Service: The staff were consistently helpful and friendly. Special thanks to the receptionist, Mohammed, for going above and beyond.- Beautiful Surroundings: A peaceful green garden and a pool overlooking the sea create the perfect setting for relaxation.- Scenic Touches: At night, the small mountain behind the hotel is softly illuminated—a welcoming sight after an evening in town.- Private Beach Access: Just across the road, you’ll find a private beach with a vibrant coral reef—ideal for snorkeling and spotting colorful marine life.- Local Activity: The road can get busy during morning and afternoon hours as pickups and minibuses shuttle divers to the famous Blue Hole, located about four miles north.The hotel’s beachfront restaurant, Zowwada, combines traditional Egyptian flavors with international comfort dishes, all served with a stunning sea view.- Atmosphere & Service: Headed by the ever-present and attentive al-Nabrawi (spelling?), Zowwada quickly became one of our favorite dining spots.- Dining Experience: During our three-week stay, we enjoyed dinner here nearly every other night.- Must-Try Dishes: The Okra and Beef Tajine and the Potato Tajine with Lamb Ribs were absolute standouts—rich, hearty, and full of authentic flavor.

reviews.title: Amazing staying at Dahab
reviews.text: I stayed at Bedouin Moon Dahab from the 24th to the 27th of July, and it was truly a wonderful experience. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming from the moment I arrived. Everyone was incredibly kind and helpful—especially Mustafa and Ahmed.The place has a relaxed vibe that makes you feel at home, and I’m grateful for the hospitality. Definitely a spot I’d return to and recommend to anyone visiting Dahab!

reviews.title: Amazing clean budget hotel for individuals and small families
reviews.text: A small family spent 2 nights in Bedouin moon hotel. The hotel is amazing. Full view on the red sea, a dedicated beach with crystal water. Every part in this hotel was carefully selected to match the overall vibes of Dahab. Amazing egyptian breakfast which we enjoyed a lot. Super friendly staff. We had a superior suite with sea view and regular room with sea view. Both were clean and cozy. Free car parking, only 10 minutes from centre of Dahab.

reviews.title: Great Great Great!
reviews.text: My wife and I had a fantastic stay at The Bedouin Moon Hotel in Dahab. What really makes this place special is its unique location—right between the promenade (Almamsha) and the Blue Hole, which gives you the privilege of enjoying both sunrise over the sea and sunset over the mountains from the same spot. The views are honestly incredible. Our room was lovely, the pool was perfect, and the staff were always friendly and welcoming. Special thanks to Abdelrazek for his help and to Moussa, the taxi driver, who made everything easy for us. Highly recommended—if you stay here, you’ll understand why it’s such a special place.

reviews.title: Dahab’s hidden gem
reviews.text: A small boutique hotel which is an absolute hidden gem!After several months of travelling throughout Egypt and staying in various hotels, resorts, and Airbnb’s, I finally found a little bit of paradise when I spent 2 weeks here in April with my wife and daughter.The staff are friendly and helpful, the pool is well suited to kids and adults and the sea and mountain views are unmatchedThis is unquestionably my go-to hotel in Dahab.

We appreciate the staff compensating us for the issues we experienced, but ultimately we just can't recommend this as a good stay in Dahab.

reviews.title: 7 night stay in Dahab
reviews.text: We really enjoyed the stay at Bedouin Moon during our trip to Dahab. Mohamed and the staff were very welcoming, super friendly and helpful. They helped us arrange some activities (Mount Sinai hike, Blue Hole snorkelling), with nice people and good prices. The hotel is in a quiet location towards the north end of Dahab, with a nice pool, gardens and a lovely view of the sea and mountains. The rooms were great value at this time of year and served our needs v well. The wi-fi was a bit iffy for the first part of the stay, but worked well towards the end (feedback was well received, so should be ok going forward).Would recommend considering staying here if looking for good value at a nice quiet location with comfortable rooms and nice views.Chris L

reviews.title: Negative
reviews.text: We were on vacation with my husband and child, arrived on 13.09, and paid $20 to check in early. The room is cleaned poorly; if you walk without shoes, all your feet will be black. There were three of us, so 3 towels and 3 waters were provided, sometimes 2, sometimes 3. The food is not bad, but monotonous; on the last day there were supposedly seafood, but it was impossible to eat because it was overcooked. One day during lunch, a waiter came over and offered a romantic dinner for $75; looking at the dinners, it wasn't worth that much money. They directly say that they like "Alenka" chocolate, and if you say you don't have it, the attitude changes. Beer is poured into glasses of 0.33, one per hand. Drinks are poured reluctantly on the beach, more foam than beer. There are no children's drinks, animation, or children's club either. The animation is terrible, monotonous, they are always grabbing your hands if you refuse to go. Playground, as if after the apocalypse, everything is destroyed, there is no lighting, everything is dusty. The children's club is completely closed. The only thing from childhood entertainment is dancing. Camels walk on the beach, it's interesting, but there are also a lot of feces there. Also gave clothes to be washed, they said it costs, in the end gave 30 for 20 pounds. Eviction at 12 o'clock, bracelets are cut, if you want to extend the number, pay $40. There are certainly pros to this place, it's the amazing views, the sea, and the cliffs. I also want to mention the lifeguards at the pools, people who are approachable. The pools are clean, they add chlorine at night, they vacuum the pools. I can say for sure that we won't come here a second time.

reviews.title: Wonderful hotel between the Sinai and the coral reef
reviews.text: If you love the Desert, mountains and sea, this is paradise. The resort is encrusted between the majestic foot of the Sinai and the coral reef. The style and architecture blend beautifully with the surrounding nature with every single element in one shade or another of the desert colours. Not a single thing is made of plastic. The sun beds are made of wood and parasols and the mattress covering the sun beds are made of undyed canvas. The building is beautiful and simple, two storey Islamic architecture and decor, with arches, with climbing jasmine and boungainvillea. The service is welcoming, caring, helpful, and reserved. The activities in close proximity include great opportunity for diving and snorkeling (including the blue hole) and amazing hikes - of particular note an overnight hike to the top of the Sinai which is a one-in-a-lifetime spiritual experience. I can't fault this place. Excellent value for money and very clean.

reviews.title: Vacation for individualists
reviews.text: We spent two relaxing weeks at the Daniela Diving Resort Dahab. The hotel complex is in a great location - between mountains and the sea. It is absolutely quiet. A place to let your soul dangle and wind down.Anyone wanting a run-of-the-mill resort vacation is in the wrong place here. The hotel complex is showing its age. The cleanliness does not meet German standards. This is balanced out by the very friendly and helpful staff and the uncomplicated atmosphere. A bit late for breakfast – no problem! Something not working in the room – an (Egyptian) solution is found. Everything very relaxed!The guest mix is international (Israel, Egypt, Switzerland, Germany, Saudi Arabia, Russia), which made for interesting encounters. The hotel is compact and you quickly get in touch with the other guests / divers. The Daniela Diving Center is absolutely flexible and does everything to fulfill the divers' wishes. Emphasis is placed on professionalism and safety. Our favorite dive site was the Lighthouse. Easy entry, relaxed café atmosphere between dives. We enjoyed diving the seagrass meadow to successfully look for small sea creatures (snails, pipefish, seahorses) there. We felt well taken care of at all times.Our vacation at Daniela Diving Resort Dahab was relaxing and we had a good time.  We have been traveling to Egypt for many years. The country and its people have grown close to our hearts. The Sinai and especially Dahab is a special patch of earth.

reviews.title: Solid hotel with great service and a fantastic house reef – 7/10
reviews.text: We spent a week at Tropitel Dahab Oasis and were overall very satisfied with our stay.Underwater World & Location:An absolute highlight is the fantastic house reef directly at the hotel, making it a perfect starting point for snorkeling! There is also a diving center right on the hotel grounds, which is ideal for water sports enthusiasts. The hotel is located a bit outside of Dahab, so you rely on taxis or can use the free shuttle bus into town. The bus is a great service, though you do have to stick to the fixed schedule.Staff & Service:A big shout-out goes to the team: the service was really very good, and the entire staff was consistently friendly and accommodating. The hotel itself has a very pleasant atmosphere and climate.Dining & Entertainment:We had buffet meals for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The selection was sufficient, though taste-wise it was a bit bland at times. For breakfast, we would have liked a bit more variety and generally more fresh fruit. There is animation/entertainment by the pool—that comes down to personal preference, but it's part of the resort experience.Overall Verdict:A great overall package with strong service and a stunning underwater world, with just minor room for improvement regarding the food. We give it a solid 7 out of 10 points!

reviews.title: Great place and coming back inshallah
reviews.text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️☆ An Authentic 5-Star Human Experience with Incredible ServiceStay Dates: 29th June – 3rd JulyIf you are looking for a sterile, corporate 7-star luxury resort, this might not be your place. But if you value high 5-star personal human interaction, spotless surroundings, and a team that genuinely cares, Shams Resort Dahab is a fantastic choice. It is situated in a perfect location—close to everything, yet offering a wonderful, peaceful ambience with great views.👤 Management & Service Mr. Shams: Outstanding, responsive, and professional. His personal attention to detail made a massive difference to our stay. Reception: There is typically no one stationed in the reception area as it operates as an adhoc service, but the team is highly responsive when needed. Room Service (Shaaban & Ali): Absolute stars! These gentlemen are incredibly professional, kind, and follow instructions to the letter. They cleaned the rooms daily, ensured we always had fresh towels, and delighted us with creative towel art shapes. Restaurant Team (Khalid & Mr. Anas): The breakfast is basic and exactly as described—nothing fancy, but the service elevates it. Khalid simply could not do enough for us, and Mr. Anas, the manager, was always on hand to instantly fix any hiccups. The kitchen team is wonderful and entirely open to reasonable alterations based on what is available, so don't be shy to ask!🛏️ Room & Facilities The Room: Great size and exactly as described. The shower was excellent and incredibly powerful. Amenities: We received a nice complimentary starter kit in the room. Tip: For shopping, head in the opposite direction of Al Mamsha to find the local mini-marts, which offer much more reasonable prices. The Grounds: The gardens are beautifully maintained, clean, and completely spotless with zero litter.⚠️ Areas for Improvement & Practical Tips Maintenance & Tech: The TV was faulty and did not work for the duration of our stay, which wasn't resolved before we left. Wi-Fi: The resort Wi-Fi is highly temperamental and unreliable. If you need a trustworthy connection, make sure you have good mobile data coverage. As a UK citizen, my O2 roaming bundle worked perfectly here. Accessibility: The resort is generally helpful and accessible for disabled guests. However, during our stay, there was building work happening on the main access path to the restaurant. While manageable for most, it could prove quite tricky if you are using a wheelchair. The Sea & Snorkelling: To fully enjoy the coral reefs and snorkelling, the tide needs to be deep enough. Unfortunately, the conditions only lined up perfectly for one day of our stay, so keep an eye on the tide times!

reviews.title: Pleasant stay
reviews.text: I stayed in Shams for a week for a diving holiday. I was warmly welcomed and everyone was very friendly and helpful throughout my stay. The room on the first floor was basic and clean with a nice bed and a sea view. It was also nice to relax in the restaurant. Breakfast was varied and certainly sufficient. The dives were all enjoyable and relaxing. Their house reef in particular is very impressive. Thank you Hareem and Youssef 😊. It was a bit of a shock for me since the last time I stayed here in Dahab. In recent years, this town has exploded in terms of tourism. Full buses come and go, bringing crowds of people, which at times also causes a lot of noise until late at night. Tip: bring earplugs and put things into perspective 😉. And if you want to escape all the hustle and bustle and experience absolute silence, there is a pleasant walk in the mountains near the lagoon where, if you are lucky, you can spot an Ibex or see some birds of prey soaring, wonderful!

reviews.title: Relaxing seafront vacation
reviews.text: My husband and I had a wonderful time staying at Shams hotel in Dahab, we wish we could’ve stayed longer. We had a nice sea view room with a balcony - definitely worth it to get. reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: An extremely disappointing stay and unacceptable customer service.We arrived at around 1 a.m., and the receptionist arranged for someone to show us to our room and assist us, which we initially appreciated.The following day, our room key card stopped working. Reception told us the system was down and would be fixed within half an hour. We returned repeatedly throughout the day, only to hear the same excuses and eventually be told it would take “a few hours.”It is now our third day at the hotel, and the system is STILL down. Every time we want to enter our room, we have to go to reception and ask someone to open the door for us. This is incredibly inconvenient and has disrupted a vacation we paid to enjoy.We requested compensation or a room change, but the hotel refused both. I also contacted customer service and have received no response.Technical problems can happen, but leaving guests without independent access to their room for days, offering no solution, and dismissing their complaints is unacceptable.This is the first time I have felt compelled to write a hotel complaint, especially in Egypt. Based on our experience, even one star feels generous.DO NOT STAY HERE if you expect basic service, respect, and access to your own room.

reviews.text: Drove off for a relaxing vacation: beach, pool, all-inclusive. There were few guests during our stay. The beach is clean, the entrance is a gentle sandy beach with small pebbles, the rooms are clean but worn, but upon check-in, they upgraded the room category for free, giving us a sea view. I want to express special thanks to the hotel staff, especially the restaurant manager and waiters; they are amazing people - always with a smile, conversation, and excellent service. They feed well, the alcohol is local, but high quality. Among the downsides we can note - there were a lot of flies on the beach, which were quite annoying. Also, this hotel could use some evening entertainment, even every other day - karaoke, discos, foam parties in the pool; during our week-long stay, there was only one performance with Arabic dancing, so it seems that after dinner everyone goes to their rooms, but we would like a little more entertainment.

reviews.text: Stay of 7 nights in early May 2026. Room 344.Nothing negative to say. Very well-maintained hotel. Clean and functional room. No noise. Very friendly staff everywhere, whether at the bar, restaurant, or reception. Very good and varied dining every day at lunch and dinner (kudos to the chef, and my wife thanks him for her little omelet at 7 AM brought with a smile). Thank you to the servers for the glass of Coca-Cola Zero, the glass of sparkling water, and the glass of wine (small upon our request) for lunch and dinner. Four fresh fruit juices at breakfast, which is a nice change from many other hotels. The managers are always present to monitor and improve if necessary.Numerous sun loungers and umbrellas at the beach and pool. A very professional and secure scuba diving club is associated with the hotel. It offers a wide choice of sites.We must indicate that at the beginning of the season, the hotel was only partially occupied, which may explain the absence of waiting at the bar and restaurant, the lack of noise, and the ability to easily find a sun lounger in the front row on the beach to admire the beautiful landscape.In short, a superb week. We will certainly return next year at the same time.

reviews.title: The worst stay I've ever had.
reviews.text: I should have listened to other low-rating reviews. I read a few and who knew that would become my experience?! If you are reading this and contemplating then look further. The hotel smelled like an ashtray since they allow people to smoke inside. Also, their bed was old and the sheets were of low quality. It was so thin that you could see the mattress. Lastly, the hot water didn't work well. I didn't know what to say after seeing a stream of black water coming down the faucet. Their breakfast was awful too. There were so many flies and some of them ended up in the food. Staying in this hotel made my trip miserable so I had to switch to another one which was so much better. If you aren't sure about the hotel, just book a day and see if it works for you. I wouldn't recommend this hotel to anyone. There are other better places you can stay in town. don't nice picture fool you. The hotel looks nothing like the picture.

reviews.title: Terrible experience, dirty room, misrepresented facilities
reviews.text: Awful on all counts. I booked them a day before check in because of all the reviews here. I was shocked at the reality! They hide the fact that this double room has a shared bathroom and shared living room. It’s a bad joke to call it deluxe! The room had a smell, there were no toiletries not even a towel on the shared bathroom, the air con looked 25 years old and seemed to have no effect, the common living room had a dirty sofa. Neither the bedroom nor the living room has any windows, it feels like a prison cell. The WiFi is so poor you have to stand out at the road to get mobile signal, the rear extra space in this room is a small rectangular floor surrounded by walls. This was awful in all counts. I left within 5 minutes of checking in but the customer service (whom you have to contact via Instagram!!) refused to refund. This place is a scam.

reviews.title: Disappointing hostel experience  in dahab
reviews.text: I stayed in this hostel in a single room in an apartment stile building (this is a 3rd building in the street where hostel has several separate buildings).  The room had dirty blankets and high humidity - it was on the ground floor. I have seen also shared room and it looked pretty crowded with little space on the bunk beds and was very stuffy in the shared room. I didn't like the management style - it seemed very uninterested in  creating a real hostel vibe story. It was more about upselling trips and transport options. Transfer option I found via app similar to Uber was 2x cheaper compared to Hostel transfer offer. I also noticed that many volunteers work here and the laundry area seemed unsanitary, which is logical as untrained and not professional stuff is doing all these chores. I wanted to change accommodation earlier but this hostel has only Non refundable policy.

reviews.title: Rafiki Oasis review
reviews.text: *solo female traveler review*I had a really wonderful experience at Rafiki Oasis. Private rooms were spacious, clean and had great a/c. Social areas always seem vibrant (although I kept a bit more to myself). There’s a daily group chat with plenty of activities. The shared kitchen and bathrooms are all cleaned everyday.The location is great if you want easy access to the lighthouse area and eel garden beachfront. The walk to Lighthouse is ~10 min and safe, even alone in the dark.If you’re deciding between the two Rafikis: this one is newer, in a slightly better location and more expensive; the other has a pool, is where breakfast is served, and seemed to be a bit of a younger crowd. I’m glad I stayed at this location, but I wouldn’t hesitate to stay at the other.

reviews.title: Lovely stay
reviews.text: We had a blissful 16 nights at Sheikh Ali hotel and we found it to be the perfect place to stay in Dahab. The location is excellent, only a few minutes‘ walk or a few minutes by taxi (which are just around the corner) from pretty much anywhere in Dahab. For divers, Blue Ocean diving school next door is a must. You will not find a better diving school or a nicer folks anywhere! At the hotel, the junior suite was very pretty and comfortable, with plenty of storage space and a huge bed with plenty of firm or soft pillows. The breakfast is delicious, with Egyptian or European  options which can be combined if you wish. The restaurant also serves lunch and dinner and everything we had was very nice, especially the falafel and the barbecued fish (order in advance). The team is absolutely lovely and goes above and beyond to make your stay excellent. Sherif in particular is amazing. He manages to be in ten places at the same time and will help you with anything you will ever need. He is the heart and soul of the hotel (at least from the guest perspective) and one of the main reasons we will surely come back. But everyone else is lovely as well, and the little touches make everything about this place very special.

reviews.title: Sheikh Ali is top!

And if it's not on the map, they'll make it.If I go to Dahab again for a diving holiday, then I will definitely come back to Sheikh Ali!

reviews.title: Terrible stay, rude staff, disgusting food! Couldn’t pay me to stay here again!
reviews.text: We Stayed here for a week all inclusive from the 2nd to the 9th of October and it was honestly the worst holiday I’ve ever been on. The room was dirty, not cleaned properly for the whole week the bed sheets had not been changed at all, towels weren’t replaced and personal items had been moved around put in random places, the beds are rock hard probably would have had a better night sleep on a sun lounger. We booked all inclusive, our first morning we went for breakfast it was all disgusting and the drinks were just as bad, no cocktails, mocktails or standard juices. Either Stella, which you only got half a glass of, Pepsi or 7UP. Nice coffees you had to pay for, decent alcohol you had to pay for, food at lunch by the pool like chips and pizza you had to pay for, we ended up spending 300 L.E a day on chips and pizza because it was the only decent food they had and that would have to do us all day. We both got so unwell off the food there. The staff are absolutely terrible, so rude the entrainment staff would constantly bug you and make you feel so uncomfortable, even if you politely told them no thank you for joining in on the activities they would pressure you and hover over you making you feel bad for declining. The other staff like managers, waiters and receptionist were the worst, I asked the restaurant manager for a beer he said no we need to save it for our Russian guests they are more of a priority. Then one night we made friends with another english couple and two friends travelling together, we all had dinner together which lasted 10 minutes because the food was so bad, then went outside for drinks to watch the fire show which was the only good entertainment we had all week. I asked for 6 beers for everyone, the same manager told me only in espresso paper cups you are not allowed glass outside. I understand this as glass breaks and it’s harder to replace, after being told this we went outside to see a group of people, who were Russians with pint glasses of beer, we went back in and told them we want 6 beers in glasses, they said no I told them they needed to tell the group of people outside they’re not allowed glass either then. He then continued to tell me they must have got them from another bar, and that it was okay for them, we were made to feel like children the whole time and that we weren’t trusted with actual glass. The staff made rude and inappropriate comments on English girls bodies, making us uncomfortable from the very start. If we could have eaten out every night we would have but considering this hotel is in the middle of a desert and literally nothing else we had no choice and the fact that we paid for all inclusive and couldn’t even enjoy it was so frustrating. Dahab city is beautiful, great food and people we went twice out of our week, but couldn’t afford to keep going otherwise we would have. Please do not stay here and waste your money on all inclusive it’s really not worth it the staff are rude, and the rooms are disgusting and the food will make you unwell! Do not believe the TikTok’s and Instagram they have or the photos on the website they don’t have cocktails they don’t have decent food it’s all fake and all for the camera they literally have an entertainment member of staff follow people around to try and capture activities to make it look fun.

reviews.title: Great day and great value out diving in Dahab
reviews.text: I was walking around Dahab at 9:00 am looking for a dive center that could accommodate a last-minute booking. As a licensed diver, I was surprised when several centers told me I needed to reserve a day in advance and asked me to come back the next day.Then I came across Seven Heaven and decided to walk in. I was warmly welcomed right away. After a quick phone call, they confirmed that someone could take me out for a dive at the Lighthouse, one of the nearby beginner-friendly sites. They also offered the option of a second dive in the afternoon at one of the more advanced sites, such as Island or Canyon.What stood out even more was the price - it was about 20% lower than other nearby centers I had checked. All equipment was included and in good condition. The instructors were friendly, professional, and fun, and the entire team worked seamlessly together to create a great experience for everyone.Both dives - the Lighthouse and Island (reached via a short taxi ride) - were fantastic. Visibility was excellent that day, around 30 meters at the Lighthouse and 15 meters at Island, and the dive instructor was attentive and helpful throughout.Overall, it was a great day of diving in Dahab. I highly recommend this center for its professionalism, value, and welcoming atmosphere. They also offer comfortable hotel rooms at very reasonable prices.

reviews.title: Beautiful, clean, welcoming, great location
reviews.text: Absolutely beautifully styled hotel with the most friendly staff. We couldn't wish for a better place in terms of atmosphere, helpfulness, good food (we had about 4 or 5 breakfasts and the same number of lunches or dinners here), and location. It is right at the seaside and right by the touristy center which is fun to walk through. The southern side of the town, where Acacia is located, is more local Egyptian (Bedouin) in feel than the northern side which is quite Western hippie-ish. Know that Dahab is not a place with large beaches. In all of Dahab we felt safe and relaxed. From there, be sure to visit the ancient St. Catharine Monastery as a day trip. The sea was for us too cold to swim in (except for diving with a suit on) and the hotel swimming pool as well (late feb. 2024), but the air temperature was perfect for us (around 25 Celsius max). Acacia Hotel usually has some music on the loudspeakers and is known for its parties but when we were there, there were none (which was good for us). The sympathetic staff keeps the hotel clean, welcoming and well-functioning. If you are new to Egypt, make sure to tip because tipping is part of the income they need. In Acacia Hotel, you will enjoy tipping because the staff deserve it! Highly recommended.

reviews.text: I’ve been visiting Sinai for the past 15 years, and I only discovered this gem of a camp only recently. While many places in the area are becoming louder, more geared towards mass tourism, and simply less like the Sinai I remember, Galuma offers the kind of relaxed, peaceful atmosphere that first made me fall in love with this place. Comfort and hygiene are clearly a priority too: the rooms are clean, well equipped, and having a private bathroom makes a world of difference. Thanks to the owners for the interesting conversations, genuine hospitality, delicious Bedouin food, and for helping me get a closer look at the reef. I’ll be back soon.

reviews.title: An Oasis of Simplicity
reviews.text: I spent several weeks in Abu Galum, and somewhere along the way I stopped counting the days. The camp is simple, and perfectly so — not as a compromise, but as a quiet statement about what actually matters.Maqbul, the Galuma Camp‘s owner, has grown up at the intersection of two worlds — the deep-rooted Bedouin culture and the rhythms of international tourism — and has made that meeting point his natural habitat. His generosity is the kind that is contagious. Somewhere during the stay it stopped feeling like merely hospitality and started feeling like a natural way of being — you find yourself offering things back without thinking about it. Arab hospitality is not a gesture, it is a living culture of mutual giving and the joy of gifting and receiving, and in this place you feel the simplicity of experiencing abundance from the first day. Maqbul owns several camps at different spots along the coast of the Golf of Aqaba, and if you’re looking for something different, he will find a way.Wael is harder to place in a single role, because he fills several at once — camp manager, certified dive instructor, multilingual, internationally networked across diving and maritime worlds, and deeply versed in the cultures and contrasts of this region. A Jordanian and citizen of the world, he lives a cross-cultural philosophy not as an idea but as a daily practice. Spend an evening listening to his stories about the sea, the desert, and the people of this corner of the world, and you’ll understand what I mean.He is also the cook who’s devotion is tasted in every meal he creates. One day we asked if it was possible to get fresh tuna. That evening he surprised us with classical Sushi, as well as a traditional Tuna dish, that i became a fan of. Strong sweet teas and arabic coffees laced with cardamom appeared between meals like small rituals worth pausing for. Wael is, in the truest sense, a genie in a bottle — tell him what you wish, and something fitting will find its way back to you.The reef is right at the doorstep. You swim out almost flat across the reef crest, and from there a coral landscape opens up — hills and mounds stepping gradually downward, an underwater archipelago alive with color and quiet movement. Snorkelers find their world in the shallower reaches; divers can follow the slopes into deeper territory. A sea turtle drifted past one afternoon at its own unhurried pace. A few steps from the camp, a clearly marked entry point makes it all easily accessible.Abu Galum is within walking distance for diving, snorkeling, and windsurfing. Day trips by boat or across the desert came together without any fuss.In the evenings the sun went down, the moon came up, the wind shifted. The desert and the rough mountains touchng the red sea from both sides, the straight horizon line in the distance. This alive scenery invokes a peculiar sence for Space and Time and leaves one with awe.This is a place where something loosens. Where being offline feels less like a sacrifice and more like a return to something that matters on a deeper level.For divers, freedivers, wanderers, and anyone who needs to clear the mind of the world fast and loud chatter, slow down, feel the elements, and fill up their cup with beauty— this is a secret oasis of nourishment.

reviews.text: It used to be good, now it's a stay-away-from junk.I stayed in this hotel two times before, in summer 2015 and 2016, both were very good visits. However, my most recent visit was traumatizing (August 2020). The hotel used to be safe for families and women, now in 2020 It's not. The manager and one member of the staff verbally harassed me and my sister. They moved forward with their unacceptable behaviour and attempted at suggesting to get us into some uncanny situations. We were able to put them in their places.The management didn't honour their agreement with us too. Before booking the room, we agreed on a late check-out. Having stayed for five days without being requested to expedite the check-out time, the management, out of nowhere, unilaterally decided to evoke the agreement in our very last day of the visit. They "instructed" us to leave 5 hours before the agreed time. We had to interrupt our activities, rush to the hotel and get ready to leave. We ended up spending the last 5 hours of our trip tired and angry until the bus departure time. We gave the owner the benefit of the doubt, assuming these violations were inflicted without his knowledge. We thought he'd listen as we know him from the previous visits when he used to run the hotel himself. I am sorry to say after two long calls, he was only annoyed for how much a review we wrote to the hotel FB page would cost him money. We're both disappointed and sorry. It's a shame such a nice hotel had to be sunk into this level of unprofessional and unethical behaviour.

reviews.title: Best place in Dahab
reviews.text: From the moment they picked us up we were treated like family.  The rooms are spacious and the hotel is right on the beach.  The manager Hossam and our driver Mido bent over backwards to make sure our stay was perfect.  Breakfast was delicious and the tours we booked were so much fun!  The hotel is about a 5 minute walk along a boardwalk to the center of town, it's perfect because it is close but quiet.  They will serve you breakfast by the pool, in your room, or on the beach overlooking the Red Sea and Saudi Arabia in the distance. You can also snorkel right in front of the hotel or a short walk to the lighthouse or the lagoon if it is windy. Again, cannot recommend enough!

reviews.title: Heaven on earth
reviews.text: Highly recommend Seaview Hotel in Dahab. Best place ever, everything you need is there. First of all location is perfect, The rooms either direct or side sea view are perfect , very clean, quite and comfy More importantly, the amazing staff Mr. Hossam and Ms.Sara They were very supportive, Friendly and treat you as a family member.whatever you need is done. Thnx Alot Hossam for everything..Of course won't forget to mention Mr. Adel the owner is a really decent man and always thinking how to make the hotel better Really loved to have my breakfast by the beach with Bedouin-tea hearing the sound of waves watching the Red Sea in-front of you, there is nothing more relaxing than this.Loved every second of it. THNX ALOT

reviews.title: Lovely Place , Amazing Staff
reviews.text: I would like to thank each and everyone in the hotel for their hospitality , we had a pleasant vacation and will definitely come back ,The staff there is the friendliest ever and they made sure to make our stay very comfortable,they even helped in arranging trips and suggesting what we can do there, The hotel has it's own beach infront of it and it's only 5 mins walk to the busy area which contains all restaurants ,shops and whatever you need , the breakfast isn't diverse and it's a set menu but it was more than enough , They have a very nice pool as well . if you are looking for a cozy and relaxing place then this is what you definitely need

reviews.title: Awesome Staff
reviews.text: The Staff are really nice friendly and cheerful all the time, especially Ms. Sarah the receptionist who helped us during check in and she helped us with a recommended tours with a really good prices, also the buffet was convenient comparing the price with a good taste. We would go there again for the nice staff.

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: A truly wonderful experience! From the moment you arrived until the moment you left, everything was top-notch. The cleanliness is excellent, the quiet is relaxing, and the staff are extremely polite and professional. The attention to detail was evident, and the stay was very comfortable. I confidently recommend it and I hope to return to it again. ❤️

reviews.title: Dahab
reviews.text: I stayed at this hotel and it was a wonderful experience. The place is very clean, the rooms are comfortable, and the staff is cooperative, respectful, and cares about the comfort of the guests. The service was excellent, the location was convenient, and the stay was quiet and enjoyable. I thank all the staff and recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a comfortable and distinctive stay.

reviews.title: Alles top
reviews.text: We had a pleasant stay at Ali Baba Hotel in Dahab. The location is very nice, right on the promenade, and you can reach restaurants, cafes and the sea in a few steps. The room was clean and tidy, everything was as expected.The Service was also good – especially the receptionist Mohamed was friendly and helpful, and helped us with any questions. Overall, everything fit well, we were satisfied and would recommend the place.

reviews.title: Excellent hotel & check it out
reviews.text: Very excellent hotel and hotel staff cheering with the Egyptians. Clean pools and clean tubs Food is diverse and acceptable, as are the drinks From transferring hotels to what it really is

reviews.title: I like everything, I recommend it for five
reviews.text: Gorgeous hotel, I really like everything, the location of the hotel is close to the sea, the animation is at the highest level, I would like to highlight Alsou and Diana, they are so friendly and helpful! Thank you for playing! The food is excellent, the rooms are clean, they are cleaned every day ✅ I recommend the hotel!

reviews.title: Super hotel Ali Baba
reviews.text: First time at Ali Baba, we will definitely come back here again! I liked everything, gorgeous beach, very clean sea. Animation Cool, New Year's Eve we were at the hotel, everything was cool. We will come again in March. 😃😃😃😃

reviews.title: Weekend at dahab
reviews.text: We stayed at Ali baba hotel last weekend. Family suite, it was a Great experience, excellent location, close to literally everything, breakfast was fresh and super delicious.Very helpful and friendly staffRoom was clean and spaciousWould visit again and again :)

reviews.title: First stay in Dahab
reviews.text: Clean hotel with a nice view. The staff were helpful welcoming and friendly. The room was clean and the service was good. The food was good as well. During our stay the staff was always finding cabs and users for us and organize some activities as well. And in the last day they accepted to keep our luggage till the end of the day for free. So it was a really nice stay in this hotel.

reviews.title: clean with helpful staff.
reviews.text: the hotel was clean and the rooms were comfortable. the view was nice.  the staff were really helpful and friendly , they helped us organize all our tours in dahab, and the prices were very reasonable. even the food was very good. a highly recommended place to stay.

reviews.title: Our second home
reviews.text: For many years we are keep on comig back to this hotel. Clean seaview suit, perfect for 4 people, we were5, but with 2 small kids. Comfy beds, fridge. A/C, balcony,frendly and helpful crew, everything you may need durin your stay.

reviews.title: Wonderful time
reviews.text: We stayed there for two weeks and had a wonderful time. Mahmoud & Seif helped us out a lot and provided us with information, superb breakfast and good vibesWe will come back for sure:)! شكرا جدا

reviews.title: Lowest
reviews.text: I just can't explain how this "structure" could have such a rating. Given that we are not pretentious, indeed we are very accommodating and know the Egyptian tourist reality well, it was the worst experience of our lives. Dilapidated structure, lurid, unqualified bathrooms (in Italian stadiums are much better) filthy cover, to sleep we used our beach towels, doors, furniture and broken curtains, no soap in the bathroom and only one shower towel (the second we received after numerous requests). Not to mention the breakfast room.... Only positive note the location, friendly but inefficient staff. I couldn't put zero because it's not possible. Don't trust the photos. Absolutely not recommended.

reviews.title: More than great. Great place and very friendly staff
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful experiences I have ever had .Wonderful stuff and amazing  service.Thanks alot and looking forward to seeing you again soon One of the most beautiful hotels I have ever stayed where cleanliness and service are top-notch and the staff is all top-notch. Didn’t change it anywhere Thanny. Thank you so much

reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: I spent 4 night in this hotel at the beginning of July... for me it was a very good experience in Dahab ..specially that it was my first visit  .the location of the hotel in the "city centre " was excellent as you have everything around; restaurants of all kinds, shops with reasonable prices, diving centres, trips organisers and taxis.The sea is just two minutes walking from the hotel, it is a small rocky beach but once you step into the water you can enjoy swimming and watching the coloured fishs belowThe hotel has only two sea view rooms and a nice restaurant on the roof with a sea view.Our room was one of the two sea view rooms , it was clean enough and comfortable.The staff was very friendly specially Mr. Ahmed at the reception, they make you feel at home, and they are always smiling and ready to help .Our stay was bb so we had the chance to enjoy their delicious breakfast.I highly recommend that hotel and looking forward to go back.

reviews.title: Best hotels
reviews.text: Clean hotel. Staff work hard to clean every day. The staff are very friendly. It solves the difficulties, great rooftop views, convenient location is a hotel that has no shortage. Powerful 👍

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text: Perfect location.. perfect room .. perct service.. very friendly stuff. 1 minute from beach . Very clean.Breakfast is so good and delicious.  Many varieties Bathroom inside room cleanReception very nice Value of money good comapred to other hotels in same area

reviews.title: Golden Europe has the amazing staff I’ve met in a hotel. Amazing view, breakfast, location and hospitality.
reviews.text: I initially booked only a few nights at Golden Europe with the intention of moving around and experiencing different hotels/hostels in Dahab. However, the staff alone at Golden Europe were so amazing I ended up staying about two weeks. I didn’t want to leave. The location is absolutely perfect. The morning sea view from the restaurant is the best feeling and perfect place to wake up. The resident cats, Piso and Pisa are very snuggly and like to run up to you in the morning. The service is outstanding and the included breakfast is the best way to start the morning and has lots of variety. Ahmed at reception (both of them) are incredible and I didn’t want to say goodbye to them. The restaurant staff Mahmoud and Ahmed do an outstanding job and I looked forward to seeing them each morning. The cleaner (Mohamed I believe his name was) was lovely and really goes the extra mile. I can’t recommend Golden Europe more. Thank you to all the staff who made my stay there so much magical. I will see you again.

reviews.title: Great value for money
reviews.text: A lovely hotel in Lighthouse area of Dahab, central location, staff members are helpful and neat. AC works like charm, wi fi available too. Rooms are well equipped, there is a minibar, wardrobe, kettle, and they're soundprood so you can sleep with no hassle.Side notes: wi fi signal could be better. a TV would be nice addition too, but not a deal breaker though

reviews.title: Lovely stay in Dahab
reviews.text: I had a great stay at the Lady Bird in Dahab. I stayed for one week, it was my first time. The place is located very centrally, right next to the sea and restaurants. The staff was amazing, very friendly, always thoughtful and kind (both at reception, restaurant and cleaning). I'll stay there again!

reviews.title: Heartwarming welcome
reviews.text: This hotel has the best staff in all of Egypt. It has a great location, has a great selection of breakfast plates and is the perfect place to stay in Dahab. The room is comfortable, always cleaned and the rooftop restaurant has a wonderful view. We stayed for seven nights and highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: Unsafe and extremely, extremely, extremely, extremely, extremely bad
reviews.text: This is one of the worst experiences I've ever had in my life. I've tried both expensive and cheap options, and I've never seen anything worse than Camp Alaska.Firstly, the room is more like a prison than a room. It's truly awful, utterly awful, and incredibly stuffy. There's no air, and they've made a very cheap wooden bed with a mattress on it. There's no wardrobe, and the bathroom isn't even big enough for one person. Plus, there's no hot water. Hot water is a luxury that the inmate doesn't deserve. Secondly, you open the door to the room and find clothes hanging on a line and a mess that brings on depression.Thirdly, their style is very, very, very bad. We were two sisters alone, and they sent us a strange-looking guy who kept banging on the room door (the room door is weak and broken, and it's very easy for anyone to open it for us). He kept banging very hard and telling us to get out of the room, because it was 10 o'clock, the time to leave the room, even though we moved in at 2 o'clock, and when we moved in, no one said that the time to leave would be 10 in the morning! Although we called the day before and someone told us that the exit would be from 11 to 12 And of course we were preparing our things so that we could get out of this prison room and get rid of this harsh treatment, and every now and then they would send someone different to bang on us hysterically without stopping!!!! I think if we had been another half hour late they would have broken down the door on us!!!!!!!Honestly, the treatment was absolutely terrible. I don't recommend Camp Alaska at all because it's incredibly scary and literally a prison. The treatment there is awful; they have no manners or respect for the inmates, and of course, it's completely unsafe.

reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: The place is very nice and quiet, and the service is very classy.

reviews.title: Solo traveller discovering Dahab: go to Alaska Camp
reviews.text: Tremendous stay in the heart of Dahab. You're located at the middle of the boardwalk with every hot location around you. The manager Shahd was so lovely and sweet, in about 30 seconds she booked me a mountain trip on the spot and a snorkeling trip for the day after. No hassle at all. I would recommend this spot for any solo traveller discovering Dahab for the first time, you won't be disappointed with the location and the help they provide. God bless ❤️

reviews.title: Extremely Unprofessional. Beyond Rude. Appalling rooms. Horrible Experience.
reviews.text: From the moment I arrived, I sensed that the management of this place had clearly changed for the worse. When I saw my room, I was extremely disappointed and refused to stay at any cost.I had booked my round-trip bus through them and spent five days asking when my departure was, only to get no answer. My entire plan for the day and the end of my trip was completely disrupted because I was not informed until the very last minute. After five days of constant questioning and reaching out, I received a call at 10 PM—not from Alaska, not from the travel agency—but directly from the bus driver, informing me that my departure was first thing in the morning. Outraged by such unprofessional behavior and refusing such short notice, I was denied a refund. There was zero coordination between their night and morning shifts, as well as between their travel company, despite their claim that everything was handled since the payments were already made.Upper management repeatedly refused to speak to me directly throughout my entire stay in Dahab. And had stopped responding to my messages. When I decided to visit them in person to escalate the issue. With unbelievable rudeness, the front desk handed me her personal phone sarcastically telling me to speak to her manager who is going to refuse my request anyway. The so-called manager asked me to “drop it” and they would only pay back the money to “stop nagging!” When I made it clear that this has nothing to do with money and that this is not going to end in their favor, the front desk girl snatched her phone from my hand and told me to leave their premises immediately or they would call the police. I told them to go ahead—I’d be waiting.An hour later, I received a call from a man claiming to be the police, asking where I was and if we could “have a chat.” When I welcomed the opportunity and gave a specific location, he agreed to come over but never showed up or called back. Clearly, it was just another intimidation tactic.That being said, I’m in the process of officially filing a complaint against these people with the Ministry of Tourism to prevent others from being deceived by this place. A true shame and a disgrace to Egyptian tourism and our country.

reviews.title: Nice stay in Dahab. Feel at home
reviews.text: Enjoyed this simple and authentic place. Single rooms with big bed and AC. The special thing was the staff. Amazing people.  Toni. Ahmad. Nada.  All been welcome from check in till I left. They helped in arranging doctor for pcr. Everything available in short walking distance. Good value for money. Central location close to the bridge. Close to most of diving clubs and restaurants. The place is safe and quiet

reviews.title: Sentido reef oasis senses resort
reviews.text: Location was beautiful gardens and all areas emasculate , relaxing atmosphere and friendly staff could not do enough for you . Never had a problem getting loungers on beach and pool , if you dive or snorkel it is the place for you as marine life is amazing and coral was great going out and seeing all this . Rooms were spacious and comfortable and cleaning standards were exceptional. We cannot say enough about this resort  the staff are a credit to the hotel . We will be coming back as the food , snorkelling and whole area  fantastic

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: What a wonderful hotel with lovely accommodation excellent facilities and the staff were brilliant. We had two weeks in this lovely location. The hotel staff were all so helpful and friendly. Nothing was too much trouble. The food was varied every day with three meals every day and all prepared fresh and tasty. The communal areas were kept clean and we had fresh pool towels supplied every day. There are a few members of staff that went the extra mile and I would like to mention these personally. Bar staffWaleed. Sabir. Sameer and Medihat.Served us drinks as we relaxed by the pool and were always attentive. LifeguardMahmoud. He always ensured we had fresh pool towels. I cut my foot badly and Mahmoud dressed my foot four or five times over a couple of days and this was above expectation. Accommodation attendantWaleed room 1149 kept our room clean and tidy every day so when we went to our room after the day it was lovely. We will go back to this hotel. 🏖️⛱️🏝️

reviews.title: Nice place with bright rooms, sea views and friendly staff
reviews.text: Nice guesthouse, clean and spacious with a very pretty garden and sea views. Hakim and his team were friendly and helpful. Well situated just off the Main Street, close to everything but away from the noise. Just the crying dog that gets shut in the large space between Tree House and the sea was a nuisance and kept us awake sometimes. Dog was nothing to do with the hotel and Hakim did try to sort it. Electrics slightly worrying in bathrooms and breakfast traditional but basic quality. All round enjoyable stay, value for money, great location, would recommend the Tree House. Thanks for helping us have a great holiday! We love Dahab

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Totally recommend it for a budget stay in Dahab. From the moment I arrived the staff was super friendly & welcoming. The manager Mr. Ali welcomed me personally & helped me with the wi-fi & was so helpful during my stay.  A Memorable 10-Days Stay at Villa 22 in Dahab.

reviews.title: Well situated, good facilities, helpful staff, clean, reactively quiet, very affordable.
reviews.text: Stayed here (room 406) for two weeks. It’s ideally placed in a relatively quiet part of town  5 minutes walk to local shops and restaurants. Ali Haggag the owner is attentive, helpful and keen to assist. There’s always someone on site 24 hours. Room is clean and was cleaned twice in our stay. A/C, shower, fridge all work well.Very affordable too.

reviews.title: Stay away
reviews.text: I arrived at the property early morning 5 am. The key cannot get out of the door, the internet is not working and the personnel speaks no English, the bed sheets are dirty. I manage to close my eyes for and hour or two. I ask for the internet again, still not working, the manager Mr Ali should be there in some time and I will get all the answers. With no actual sleep, heavily exhausted I meet the manager who quickly fools me into paying a total amount (for 10 nights) in cash to him in advance. The amount is already more than 40 euros higher than the price stated on the booking.com (have screenshots of the actual price on that day). My brain does not work so I allow for all this to happen. He gives me back the change in Egyptian pounds that is heavily undervalued (all my fault!).Next night I don’t sleep due to noises in and outside of the studio (knocking on the door, screeching and banging of all the windows and doors in the studio, nothing closes properly!). The night after it is worse as the strong wind hits Dahab and there is literally a storm in the studio! I put the table against the balcony door to moderate this, without any success. The day after I decided to leave the place and go to a place where I will be able to rest.I called Mr Ali and informed him that I was going to leave by that evening and that I wanted to arrange the return of the money with him.He first wants to to move me to another studio or another property that he manages, I say no to that. Then he says I will pay for the upcoming night and when he extracts the 25% commission that he pays to the booking.com I will get the rest of the money back (in pounds! the euros are gone he says). I say there are clear rules on the cancellation fees on booking and he should follow them. He tells me that I will get no money back and hangs up on me. I meet him that afternoon confirming that I am leaving in 2 hours, to what he says “ you can stay as long as you want, you paid for 10 nights”.I left the property the same evening and moved to another one to which I have a confirmation of stay of 7 nights. My stay in villa 22 was never officially cancelled by the property (whoever that is!) and I could not do the cancellation via booking.com (very dangerous and stupid trap!)Important! The same person is a manager in the place named “the Castle”.I must add that the personnel was very kind and at service, trying their best to help out, they speak no English though. So any kind of communication goes via Mr Ali, over the phone or face to face if it happens that both you and him are at the property. A major learning for me, and hope that by telling the story I will save at least one other person from going through what I have gone through.

reviews.title: Great accommodation and certainly fantastic value for money.
reviews.text: Villa 22 fantastic location, about a five minute walk to the main Boulevard where all the restaurants, cafes and boutique shops are found. We could not fault the Villa 22 for cleanliness, also the staff were  fantastic and friendly, great value for money which included a typical Egyptian Breakfast. All rooms have very good air conditioning, and flat screen television, plus a big fridge, shower great and always hot water, I will be back in Dahab soon and of course will book the Villa 22.

reviews.title: Villa 22 ...a nice spot in Dahab
reviews.text: Room is clean & tidy, location is good. Staff is helpful. But not all items listed in the room description on booking.com were actually available  sad  😞 😔 😕. Loud DJ  from the Villa's rooftop was very annoying.Special thanks to chef Maher & his assistant Hamada, who made yummy pancake, and chef Maher was kind enough to share his pancake recipe with me.  We had a nice stay  @Villa 22.#Dahab#villa 22#

reviews.title: Best bedroom
reviews.text: Wonderful place with wonderful people. Great home base for all trips or even remote work. The terrace is amazing and the whole atmosphere very chilled and relaxed. Helpful friendly staff. Clean rooms. Best bedroom ever (with balcony). Close to everything that is important.

tripadvisor.streetAddress: El Mamsha El Tourist Street, Dahab 46617 Egypt

reviews.title: This is the third time I've stayed at the same hotel because I feel like it's my home.
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful, cleanest, and most luxurious hotels in Dahab The hotel apartments are exceptionally clean and stylish; I feel right at home. The staff are truly incredibly polite and respectful. The food and beverage staff, especially Mr. Adel, are simply the best. The management, Mr. George and Mr. Yasser, are incredibly helpful and respectful, and the pool is always spotless. The atmosphere is relaxing and peaceful... The price is reasonable, and the hotel's features are unnecessary... I recommend everyone choose it

reviews.title: Very nice stay in this very nice hotel between sea and mountain.
reviews.text: Cairo. Sharm el sheikh . Nothing beats dahab (gold in French ) this village with a thousand colors where diving is paramount. I stayed a month at the hotel blue residence dahab nestled between sea and mountain with views of the pool and mountains.A hotel where everything is there: beauty of the city center, beautiful beaches nearby, a site well arranged for calm reigns. Really impeccable service and exquisite cuisine. I want to highlight the unfailing dedication every day of Mr Georges who spoke French which helped me and his colleagues as well as all the staff of the establishment without forgetting the many cats and zika the hotel guard.I really had wonderful times with them, they were all very kind. Another big thank you to Mr Georges the manager who knew during this stay to meet my needs very quickly whether for the operation of everything in the apartment and all that is visits , activities in the surroundings. The apartments are very nice , clean and well arranged. The pool is beautiful and clean. Cleaning of the apartments is on request. Towels are changed regularly. Everything is perfect. Really recommend this hotel, it's worth it, everyone without exception showed friendliness, kindness and was incredibly helpful. A sincere thank you for my unforgettable stay. I would return without hesitation.

reviews.title: Mixed review
reviews.text: My opinion of Blue residence is very mixed. We booked via Expedia.Communication before our stay was good, we requested a pool view room, which they agreed to and organised our transport from airport to hotel.On arrival, late at night, we were directed straight to reception, had to sign an agreement of rules and regulations ( first time i've ever had to do that in a hotel)  and pay the full amount for our 7 day stay. We were then shown to our room. As we entered, we tripped over the loose door tile and was told "dont worry we'll fix that" It remains loose and a trip hazard. Block 1 G3.Our promised pool view was non existent (completely obscured by a large gazebo) The accomodation was ok, pretty much what you would expect for a low cost Dahab residence, but the fridge was dirty, bedroom light hanging off the wall, and you would be very hard pushed to "self cater" with the very limited contents of the kitchen.We were only provided with 2 towels and had to repeatedly ask for toilet paper. Our room was not serviced at all during our stay, and when we requested clean towels, they insisted we gave back the first two before we could be given any more. There was no bath mat or bedside lamp,  and whilst we had a reasonable size balcony/ terrace, there was no furniture on the balconys to sit on.The situation of Blue residence is good, just off the main road, close to the banks and an easy walk to Mashraba and the town. Ideal as we were diving with Big Blue dive centre an easy 10 min stroll away.Blue residence does have a pool bar but does not serve alcohol, infact they have a no alcohol on site policy.Breakfast is the same everyday and rather uninspiring. Other food available to order from the bar is OK.Music around the pool is the choice of the staff and played very loud ( even if there's only 1 or 2 guests there trying to relax,) The worst part of our stay was receiving a personal text from the manager accusing us of using drugs. When questioned what basis they had for the accusation, we were told staff had smelt drugs from our room. As no one had even been to our room, and as we don't even smoke,  we couldn't understand the accusation and  were offended by it. The manager seemed to think it was a joke. This left us feeling very uncomfortable.We would not return to Blue residence.

reviews.title: Amazing Place

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: Star of dahab I stayed here for 3 nights as I was diving with The Big Blue who are based on the same site as the hotel, which made everything very convenient. When I arrived I had a lovely welcome from the staff and was offered a refreshing welcome lemon drink sitting in their beach cafeMy room was typical Egyptian style and was very clean.  I asked for an additional sheet which came quickly and if I wanted the room cleaned daily. The shower pressure was fine for washing but not powerful enough to wash my hair. (However I used a complimentary room at the end of the day and the shower pressure was great so may have just been my room) I used a jug which was fine with me to wash my hair. I had a lovely balcony which directly faced the sea with a table and chairs to sit at. The hotel is literally on the sea front - 20 metres from my room. They have a Bedouin style cafe/ lounge area where you can have you breakfast looking out onto the sea. A simple breakfast is served between 8 and 10am. Omelette, a fewslices of fruit, natural yogurt, toast with jam and honey and a good cup of tea. A big thanks so to Sayed for making me a cup of tea each morning.There is also a comprehensive menu of traditional and European food - I recommend the falafel sandwich. A lovely lady called Ashaan was very kind with a beautiful smile. She cleaned my room and refilled any bits I needed. She made the most wonderful Mashi (stuff vine leaves) and shared them with me. They were absolutely delicious. You must try them. The hotel is a ten minute stroll from the centre of dahab which I loved. You then have the choice to have a busy evening (not that anywhere in dahab is busy). I chose to sit at night on a sunbed outside the hotel cafe listening to the waves with Egyptian music playing in the background reading my book. I couldn’t think of any better way to relax.  I think the distance from the town adds to the charm of the hotel. There is a street at the top of the road where you can eat at different cafes and there is very small supermarket.I would definitely recommend The Star of Dahab - it gets a thumbs up from me 👍👍👍🤗

reviews.title: The only hotel in Dahab that doesn't allow people to drink Alcohol..
reviews.text: It’s frustrating when a hotel enforces strict alcohol policies that seem out of place, especially in a tourist-friendly area where other establishments allow it. In this case, the owner’s behavior—fighting with guests over drinking beer and wine at a beachfront café—creates an unnecessarily negative experience. Tourists expect a certain level of relaxation and freedom in such destinations, and banning alcohol while competitors allow it only alienates potential guests.Hotels should consider the cultural and economic context of their location. If all other hotels in the area permit alcohol consumption, enforcing a ban makes this establishment stand out for the wrong reasons. Tourists choose destinations based on hospitality, atmosphere, and local norms, and an overly strict policy can drive guests away. Confrontational behavior from the owner further damages the hotel’s reputation, discouraging return visits and negative reviews that could impact business.If the hotel is concerned about excessive drinking or disruptive behavior, they could implement reasonable guidelines instead of outright bans. A better approach would be designated areas for alcohol consumption or specific time restrictions. Otherwise, guests will simply choose friendlier, more accommodating hotels nearby. At the end of the day, hospitality should be about enhancing the guest experience—not restricting it without good reason.

reviews.title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Absolutely Recommended – I Will Definitely Be Back!
reviews.text: My stay at Al Deirq Hotel in Dahab exceeded my expectations in every way. The location is excellent: within just a few steps, you can find supermarkets, small shops, clothing stores, and a variety of restaurants. The Mamsha promenade is also only a few minutes away, making it easy to enjoy relaxing walks along the waterfront.One of the hotel's highlights is the rooftop terrace. From there, you can enjoy a beautiful view of the sea and fully appreciate the relaxed atmosphere that makes Dahab so special.Although the rooms do not offer sea views, that honestly does not matter at all. They are exceptionally clean—so clean, in fact, that I have rarely experienced this level of cleanliness, even in some five-star hotels in Sharm El Sheikh. It is clear that cleanliness is a top priority here.What truly makes this hotel stand out, however, is the staff. From reception to housekeeping, every single team member is friendly, polite, helpful, and always in a good mood. You can genuinely feel that their hospitality comes from the heart and is not simply part of their job. This warm and sincere attitude makes the entire experience even more enjoyable.The surrounding area is also very pleasant. Yes, there are a few construction sites nearby, but that is completely normal in a growing destination like Dahab and did not affect my stay in the slightest.My conclusion: Al DeirqHotel offers an outstanding location, exceptional cleanliness, and a team that makes every guest feel truly welcome. I will definitely return and can wholeheartedly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Dahab.A big thank you to the entire team for such a wonderful stay! 🌟⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
