reviews.title: GREAT HOTEL
reviews.text: Our room is good but the air-con broke down and it was in October. Got it fixed after the 3rd day. Very humid and hot. The floor is muddy and water has salt in it. Air-con leak but honestly, the services were good and they very attentive and cooperative. Even though our room is not great, we like the services they rendered. They definitely need improvement - esp dry rack, rusty tap, room service - clean. Love their pool and overall, good service that makes us a happy couple and recommended. WIFI reception not great has to get it worked in the balcony.

reviews.title: Overall Good
reviews.text: The rooms are clean and spacious. The pool is small but it is very refreshing in the intense SUNNY mornings. The location is great and is very close to the main pedestrian street, However it's relatively far from the beach (10 mins walk).

reviews.title: Convenient place, helpful staff
reviews.text: The hotel is right on one main drags of Dahab, where most stores, mini markets and restaurants are.The setting is quaint, clean, and pleasant.Staff, and management have a very relaxed, and helping attitude.They helped with, advice, and local calls when I was trying to contact the monks at St Catherine for a reservation, then they helped me finding a ride to get there.They also arranged my snorkeling excursions in the nearby areas...The "Three pools" one is beautiful and right by the coast.For breakfast they found out I like fruits, and they prepared some for me... very kind.

reviews.title: Cheap and clean hotel in the center of the country thanked my Cheap and clean hotel in the center of the country thanked
reviews.text: Very warm welcome,staff could do enough for us.rooms spotless.great location,plenty to do.would stay again and again.brilliant place to stay.had all facilities needed,fridge,t.v,wifi,breakfast included,room cleaned daily,diving good prices,quad biking a must.bbl in the desert brilliant. Excellent value for money.

reviews.title: Good place to stay
reviews.text: The hotel is very nice  and clean , staff was really friendly and helpful. The only strange thing that they requested to pay the whole stay upfront which is kindda wierd in dahab. It would have been great if they have a sea view but this hotel isn't located by the sea

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: Very warm welcome,staff couldnt do enough for us.rooms spotless.great location,plenty to do.would stay again and again.brilliant place to stay.had all facilities needed,fridge,t.v,wifi,breakfast included,room cleaned daily,diving good prices,quad biking a must.bbq in the desert brilliant. Excellent value for money.

reviews.title: blessings in paradise
reviews.text: Excellent hospitality big clean rooms best prices. Staff are helpful, nothing is impossible. Diving with Tamer Hussien.Thanks Ziggy, Amen, Siad, and all the amazing staff, for making an Aussie girl feel like an Arabian princess.

reviews.title: Just terrible
reviews.text: One of the worst hotel experiences ever. The staff was extremely rude and imposing. We were for example not allowed to use our room or balconies for mixed-group gatherings even in the daytime; this was also not related to us politely or before booking, but by yelling and insulting (the female members of) the group. At the same time, the hotel or the rooms didn't look like anything promised, but they were shabby, grimy, and of questionable hygienic standards. I had no hot water, there were cockroaches in my bathroom (just spray regularly for godsakes), my AC only half worked, and the pool that looked so nice in the photos was grimy. And the management was so not interested.It's not like this was a nice beautiful clean place with bad service, it was simply a sucky hotel. Goes without saying that we lasted in the hotel one day only.

reviews.title: I wouldn't recommend this place
reviews.text: I stayed in this hotel last summer (2014), and was pretty disappointed by the quality of the room and the service in general. The room was much more ascetic than it seems it the photos and the bath room was straight forward dirty. Once I entered the room and checked it, I noticed the bath room's condition and asked the staff to clean it, which they actually didn't do. Also, the remote control of the TV did not work and 4 out of the 5 lamps in the room didn't work. The staff was quite uptight and not helpful at all. I ended up staying there fewer days (actually only 2 nights)  than what I had planned, and looked for another option. I would not recommend this place unfortunately.

reviews.title: discriminatory and accusing management
reviews.text: Our Egyptians friends (I am a foreigner) were treated terribly - with public accusatory shouting episodes, banging on doors, watching our every move - and even when the booking was made in my name, they insisted on talking to and negotiating with the Egyptians in the group because they knew they could pressure them much harder than me as a foreigner.We would have left immediately were it not for the fact all of Dahab was booked up, when rooms elsewhere became available we immediately left the Octopus hotel.Their treatment of us ruined the whole holiday and turned a much needed break from the city into an experience that made us want to return to Cairo as soon as possible.We will never stay there again and I would not recommend for it anyone who is not a conservative Egyptian family.

reviews.title: Will definitely be back!
reviews.text: I've been to Dahab many many times but this is the first time I've stayed in Villa Can Kiko and I have to say I can't believe I've been missing out on it all this time! The place is beautifully decorated, the courtyard is designed like a garden with greenery everywhere. The apartments are super clean and spacious witb a beautiful interior design. They even left us welcome snacks and water on the kitchen counter and rose petals and chocolates on the bed, such a cute gesture! The roof has plenty of place to lounge around. There's a nice pool with its own seating area set up like an oasis that you can ask them to prepare for you. It fits up to around 10 people. They also give you free access to their beach club "Pattaya". What really made our stay there were the staff who were very friendly and of course, the owner, Doctor Karim. Extremely helpful, very decent person who made us feel right at home. Will definitely be coming back to Villa Can Kiko! I already miss it!

tripadvisor.streetAddress: Al Salam, Peace Rd, Dahab 46617 Egypt

reviews.title: Excellent value for money in Dahab
reviews.text: From the moment i walked out the door of the airport in Sharm , my driver whom was arranged by hotel greeted me to drive me directly to the hotel about an hour from the airport in a private car.  Once I arrived at the hotel Hazem at the front desk greeted me and checked me into my room. Once inside the hotel I realized this place is brand new everything from the bed to the furnishings, I knew I was in the right hotel. A very nice breakfast served daily by the amazing staff. You are located right in the middle of everywhere you want to be. Standing outside at the hotel entrance you can walk right and you are on the main city street near all the busses & taxis turn to the left you are a few steps away from the all the action seaside. I was amazed how perfectly located this hotel is. Whatever you want to do on your visit Hazem & the rest of the staff are there to make sure you enjoy your staff to its fullest potential. Air conditioning blows cold & like I mentioned is brand new all the bedding is brand new and comfortable you will have no trouble sleeping. The room included nice small balcony to sit & relax should you need a great spot to sit & chill before or after you head out on your adventure. Soul Sinai tours is located in the lobby to help with any excursion you may want to go on.

reviews.title: i had a bed in an 8-bedroom dorm it was barely filled, i played pool with the locals there, the staff is very helpful
reviews.text: very cozy and comfortable place, it has good furniture and new appliances, a lot of activities being conducted and suitable for solo travellers and foreigners

reviews.title: Quiet, scenic and accessible
reviews.text: Hotel is just a few meters away from the Assla beach with the upper floors having the most amazing sea view. The rooms were very well furnished with all the needed amenities from a TV (a flat 32 inch screen) and very good Wifi, the only point of improvement is the outlets situation as the room has very few electricity outlets and most of them are hidden behind the furniture. The staff was amazing and was always there when we needed something and they do offer a small bar at the reception in case you fancy some drinks. Overall the experience was very good and definitely will be visiting the place again

reviews.title: A Great place to enjoy your vacation
reviews.text: A cozy small hotel overlooking the sea. It has a small and very beautiful sitting area on the beach. The rooms are very clean, the upper floor has balconies with an amazing sea view. The price might be considered a bit high comparing with the hotel prices in Dahab. Breakfast is included, which is quite ok but we preferred to have our breakfast somewhere else as a change. The owner and the staff are very friendly. One of the things i loved about the hotel that it is not close to the center area of Dahab which is usually crowded and noisy.I would definitely go there again.

reviews.title: Not something I don't recommend, look for another place
reviews.text: OK minus. No good internet. Great foreign workers (from nervous Russia)I would not come againdo not recommendThe door handle kept breaking. Pipes on the floor. The place needs renovation.There are ants on the floor***Bad air conditioner***But the breakfast is goodand clean

reviews.title: Great beach front hotel
reviews.text: Lovely beach hotel great staff great breakfast and all around amazing vibes right on eel garden reef for snorkelling room cleaned every day staff so welcoming felt like being at home beautifully decorated

reviews.title: a nice, homey hotel
reviews.text: I have been there twice, didn’t really like it the first time but then I changed my mind the second visit. The location is heavenly, in the heart of eel garden, which is the quieter, calmer area in dahab now. You have access to a nice private beach (make sure you bring your beach shoes). Bakar is a lovely guy and has an awesome attitude. The owner might come across a little bit unfriendly but he was nice and welcoming.

reviews.title: The best stay in Dahab
reviews.text: Clean rooms and excellent breakfast. The place looks like a postcard.  We felt in a private paradise. Bachar the bartender is a kind and welcoming guy who will always be happy to help. Highly recommended

reviews.title: Good enough to make your stay a pleasant memory
reviews.text: I like it’s cleanliness, calmness and the fact that it is not in the crowded area but still few minutes walking away from it.Pretty decent breakfast and a simple yet chique rooms.The staff is friendly but assertive which doesn’t make a problem if your plans and needs are clear, but I haven’t tested their flexibility and I won’t count on it.

reviews.title: What a shame about the owner's  attitude to all the street animals.
reviews.text: His behaviour is threatening to the street animals and those who support them. It's a beautiful spot so such a shame. It creates quite an unpleasant atmosphere. If you love an open, calm, animal friendly environment  this is not for you

reviews.title: Little corner of peace in paradise
reviews.text: We stayed for 4 nights in El Primo and wished that we could live there... this place is just the best!! The rooms are clean, well organized and decorated... the bed is very comfortable (to my opinion).The owners of the place are a wonderful couple with two children (don't worry, you won't hear kinds playing day and night) The staff are very friendly also and speak great English! Everyone there is smiling and really helpful!The place has a really nice atmosphere, with its russian/Greek style... I just love it!And let's not forget the food!!!The best Egyptian breakfast I had in my travel in Egypt!!!Everything on the menu is great, but the porridge with fresh fruits in the morning, for me was the bomb! So, go to dahab, book a room there, and it would be the best decision you've taken in a while ;)@thomas_freediver

reviews.title: Lovely little hotel, very clean
reviews.text: Lovely little hotel by the sea. Basic room with great view. Extremely clean which I loved. Breakfast starts at 8:30am unless preordered but is freshly cooked. Price is not cheap for Dahab and a 10 min walk to Light House which is the center. Room is bright, nice terrace, Bed is comfortable, good shower. Though a bit noisy as the room doors opens to the back roads and you can hear the cars, did not bother me though as I travel with ear plugs all the time.

reviews.title: Cosy atmosphere and warm welcome
reviews.text: Love affordability,  style,  comfort and location of the place.  The hotel is very cozy, simple & convenient, very well situated and with the great helpful staff.  We had received  the best organisation of our stay and even were able to organize the desert trips and transportation through the hotel staff.  Will definitely stay there again & again.

reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: The hotel staff are amazing, and go out of their way to help you. The room is pleasant with a good bed and a balcony.The room is very clean.The shower was ok but the bathroom is a little tired. Breakfast is good and the pool is great.I would highly recommend this place.Also very central.

reviews.title: Better places to stay in Dahab
reviews.text: There are lots of options to stay in dahabI wouldn’t recommend Blue BeachSure we were out of season but still…The shower draining point was not located in the shower itself , therefore when taking a shower the water drains to bathroom and rest of room. On having mentioned this, a towel was left on the edge of the shower (to function as a dam?)I almost slipped 3 times, despite using the squeegee multiple times to get the water back in the shower. Still a pool of water following day.Water shower was hot end of the day, cold in the morningNo WiFi besides on the stair case - maybe more spots that I didn’t discover (not in room, balcony, nor breakfast area.)The door to the balcony remains open in the room but locks on balcony side. Thank god we left window open and were able to climb back into room.Bed was pretty comfortableRoom only cleaned if askedA voucher is needed to get breakfast, reception not always manned. Breakfast mwah (mashed potatoes?)

reviews.title: Excellent week at the Blue Beach Club hotel
reviews.text: I arrived really late after midnight and the reception quickly sorted my room which was a deluxe double. I had a sea view, small balcony, decent double bed and a desk with a tv fridge and kettle. Bathroom had a nice shower with hot running water. I’ve spent a lovely week here, waking every morning watching the sun rise from my balcony. There is a great dive centre attached and a bar restaurant on the beach side of the hotel. The location is hard to beat with a short stroll to the centre. The staff here are really good, felt like home for the week!Highly recommend

reviews.title: Can’t wait to come back!
reviews.text: Me and my friend had an incredible stay at the blue beach! It is an incredibly central location, the service was unbelievable, everything we needed, any questions we had we always were assisted and treated very well. Mohammed specifically was an absolute delight! Cannot wait to come back and stay at the blue beach!

reviews.title: SUPERB!
reviews.text: My wife and I had the pleasure staying at this Hotel 1 month through December, it was amazing.Firstly we booked a hotel room for a few nights, we liked it and Mr Ahrmed (General manager) let us view the "penthouse apartment " (flat)...it was so amazing we booked it for the rest of the month. It is a beautiful and spacious 2 bed apartment overlooking the sea and we adored it in every way. The roof top terrace was incredible to sunbath, have a drink and enjoy sunsets....wow!The General manager Ahrmed even spent 2 afternoons of his free time to help me have a  further Covid vaccine in Dehab .We needed US currency to travel on(middle East tour) ...no problem he took care of it. This is an amazing lovely hotelier, perfect English and runs a very popular language school located in the Hotel.....a great Manager and a kind and decent man.We often had room service from the restaurant which we thought was excellent by any standards. All the staff at blue beach were so kind, professional in their jobs.We arnt into diving but there is an excellent diving club centered in the Hotel complex who also rent bikes, excursions etc.I recommend blue beach  totally and we will be staying their , hopefully with Mr Ahrmed in charge next year.

reviews.title: Good place in Dahab
reviews.text: I stayed at Blue Beach Club for almost a week and really loved it.It's location in Masbat bay is great. You get the best of both worlds, as it's close to the heart of the village (about 10 minutes away on foot), but still manages to be away from the hustle and the bustle. There's also a clean, private beach of sorts just outside the hotel.The rooms are in keeping with the prices charged. Nothing too fancy, but clean and comfortable. The inclusive breakfast is at the Steakout restaurant. It is a set menu, but the staff were more than willing to tweak it to my taste. It still didn't compare to a full buffet breakfast, but I always managed to eat my fill.The front desk staff, Ahmed and Dina are a delight. They could help with all my queries including making arrangements for the COVID tests. Sandra was also very responsive and accommodating.All in all a comfortable place to stay for a dive vacation or any other trip to Dahab

reviews.title: Great all around experience...
reviews.text: A must stay place for a great experience when in Dahab.  Impressed with the staff who were professional and cordial and the process for COVID preventive measures with sanitization stations, mask and social distancing signage and implementation. Right on the water with nice beach viewing area. Restaurants with great food, bartenders and the view thru the all glass walls of the water was very good. Nice rooms and amenities with Poseidon dive center in the facility.

reviews.title: Nice and well located
reviews.text: Located by the water (perfect for a morning swim), a bit off the buzz of gulf, this hotel offer normal but nice room for good value. Nice and friendly staff. Also has a bar wihtin the compound for a chill out after diving.

reviews.title: Great place to stay in Dahab
reviews.text: Very helpful staff couldn't do enough to help you clean nice pool and a great place, if you're planning a trip to Dahab this is a great place to stay, you are 5min from the center of Dahab so full of life, for a dive trip fantastic.

reviews.title: Breakfast  in blu
reviews.text: Nice breakfast  in blue it's near water side with great view and service we love this place and going  to recommend to all our friends  thank you  to joju who greeted with great email and polite  heist really nice guy

reviews.title: Professional, clean, high international standard.
reviews.text: Everything always efficient, clean, clear and friendly. Perfect service, outstanding location, swimming pool, very comfortable structure. A very trustable place, easy. Decent breakfast, amazing shower, comfy balcony.

reviews.title: Warm welcome!
reviews.text: Stayed few nights there.Reception lady was friendliest who I have met, very helpful. She made me feel welcome. Other Staff members were also very friendly and helpful.Nice clean hotel, quiet, middle of all, everything is near.Will visit them again!

reviews.title: Absolutely the best
reviews.text: We had a 4 night stay in New Yalla. It was amazing. I have been to many hotels in Dahab, but this one was great! Check in: We called them right before we came because we had a problem with the hotel we were staying in and they said they had 3 rooms available, so we booked them and went. The staff were super friendly, helpful and welcoming and made sure we were settled quickly in our rooms as we were very devastated with the other hotel. Thanks a lot to Mr. Sabry who made sure that happened. Rooms: The rooms are new with reasonable space (I assume it's a new hotel), the ACs work perfectly, clean sheets, clean bathroom and a free internet connection (although very poor connectivity, but it's something); However, just like most hotels, the lighting wasn't the best, but it was fine. Our rooms had a pool view and a little balcony. The toiletries weren't the best, only towels and tissues, but it's fine. It's recommended you get your own shampoo, water and stuff (it's a budget hotel after all).Location: It's like a 3 minute walk from the Lighthouse. It has its own bar "Yalla Bar" which you get a 10% discount for on food because you're in the hotel. The hotel is surrounded by restaurants, cafes, shops, diving centers and supermarkets. A very highly recommended hotel.

reviews.title: Very clean rooms
reviews.text: I stayed for one night there, Thursday 20th April till 21st April. Rooms are clean and equipped with tv, refigrator and a.c . The only problem me and my friends had was regarding the staff (receptionist) he was very unpleasant and talked to us in a very rude way. Even the person who came to notify us for check out turned his back to me while I was talking to him. Very disappointed with their approach wouldn't recommend

tripadvisor.streetAddress: Al Masbat Lighthouse Area, Dahab 46617 Egypt

reviews.title: God central location with nice community
reviews.text: Central location with the possibility to be walking distance to all landmarks in Dahab. There’s a space in the garden where people can gather and socialize. Rooms are placed around a central courtyard with the rooms looking onto it. Staff is nice and friendly.Disliked · Extremely dirty starting with the room, ending with the restrooms. The place needs a thorough renovation as everything is old and shabby. if you just want to be within a community and in the center of everything, then it's a good place to stay - but Dahab is so small anyway.

tripadvisor.streetAddress: Dahab Main Promenade Behind Ali Baba Hotel, Dahab 46617 Egypt

stays.nameEn: My Hostel in Dahab - Dive Center
stays.nameAr: My Hostel in Dahab - Dive Center

reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience staying at this hostel as a solo traveler. From the moment I arrived, I was warmly welcomed by the staff, who made me feel right at home. The service was top-notch, and they were always happy to assist with any questions or recommendations. The hostel also organized some great trips, which were a fantastic way to explore the area and meet other travelers. The atmosphere was cozy and inviting, making it a perfect place to relax after a day of adventures. I highly recommend this hostel to anyone traveling solo!

reviews.title: Top hostel
reviews.text: Nice hostel with friendly staff. Absolutely recommended. Fresh breakfast and nice view from the rooftop. The price is cheap. My tip is to view the sunset on a clear day, a good way to end the day.

reviews.title: Top hostel!
reviews.text: Excellent welcome that makes you feel at home.Hostel ideally located in the center of DahabFree and excellent breakfastDive center on site, practical!Unbeatable priceWifi on the rooftop, an essential place to meet travelers from all over the world.I had a great time, I will go back

reviews.title: Cooolest place in Dahab
reviews.text: I would generously describe it as a magical place. Thanks to the wonderful people working there and the amazing breakfast provided every morning with love. A lot of activities were proposed every night from diving, snorkeling, trekking and bonfires. Rooms were clean and provided with AC. Thanks for this amazing experience! definitely we will come back! With love, Selma, Mila and Giacomo

reviews.title: Incomparable!
reviews.text: Basically it's the best! not just offering great hotelling services but most importantly providing the atmosphere you love! the roof is a perfect place for solo travellers from around the world to chill out and socialise.For digital nomads, they have a unique co-working space with stable, fast internet with the mountain view in your back and the sea in front of you (depending where are you sitting).Also, they organize hiking trips, bonfire by the beach in the night, transportation to/ from SSH.Plus, they've a quality diving center attached to the hostel, so you can a permanent discount if you book both ;) Check the reviews on Booking.com, Hostelworld, and Google..For some reason, those reviews aren't reflected here!

reviews.title: 10/10 must stay when visiting Dahab
reviews.text: We stayed in the rooftop private room. It was a stunning studio apartment. So beautifully presented with all the amenities to make it feel like home. The bathroom was so clean and well presented. There was a private roooftop terrace which gave a fantastic view of the mountains it was in a great location easy to walk to the town. The rest of the hostel was also lovely. The house is beautiful inside and out. The owner was so helpful and the staff made it feel like a home. Easily a more luxurious experience than many hotels I have stayed in.

reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.text: I have been to Jaz Dahabeya in November 2019. I stay their the third time, and I think it is the best place in Laguna for serfing and relax. Three serfing stations 50-100 meters along the beach. I hope, i'll be back.

tripadvisor.streetAddress: Next To Sababa Hotel By The Main Promenadd, Dahab 46617 Egypt

reviews.title: Your Motel in Dahab
reviews.text: Very clean bathroom and comfy beds, soap, towels, hot water, very near to the center, markets and at the same time in a quite street... We really enjoyed the roof, you can see the mountains and the sea from there, you can make your hot drinks for free. Million thanks to Mr. Hanna, he allowed us early check in and late check out without any extra payment, he even helped us with arranging internal trips.Totally recommend it!

reviews.title: small cozy, very welcoming motel
reviews.text: it supposed to be a four nights stay, but i had to make it a night less unfortunately due to some personal issues. perfect location, near the beach area just 2 min walk, near all the night life, near all the restaurants you want, 4 mins to the light house area, 2 mins to the bus station. the manager Mr. Hannah he is the best, decent and professional. in short if you are searching for a cozy very clean and big beds with AC rooms in dahab you definitely had to see this motel

reviews.title: Laid Back and Chillout Amazing Stay in Dahab
reviews.text: I generally don't write reviews on my stays over booking or Airbnb however for this spot I would. Won't be much but I will say few words to show my appreciation and encouragement and recommendation to this GEM of Dahab. Amazing stay, super laid back, clean rooms, happy friendly staff, prefect location. Got it all this place. Mousa the main coordinator and front desk man is a legend. Gave me "mate" rate and was great to have a conversation with him. Keep it up Mirage Village!

reviews.title: A wonderful place 100% recommend and can't wait for next time
reviews.text: Great service and a wonderful staffGreat rooms and a wonderful viewVery helpful and kind staff100% would come again anytime

reviews.title: A true hidden gem
reviews.text: A true hidden gem.Mohamed at the reception is super friendly, polite and descent.We met the owner, Dr. ekramy, a super gentleman. Very welcoming.The place is small, yet the best for the typical dahab stay. Super clean rooms, beds sheets and toilets. The rooms have high end quality of furniture and amenities. Smart TV with 24/7 free WiFi. The bed sheets and blankets are very clean and new. The housekeeping wash them and change then whenever you ask. AC is of top quality, very new. Toilets are basic but super clean. You have in the room small nice table and chairs. Also, a closet for your clothes. Very clean and top quality. I truly don't know how this place is not very known compared to the same price of competitors where they have very bad quality " the competitors I mean. "2 rest is totally recommended.Thank you all the wonderful stay.

tripadvisor.streetAddress: Dahab - Sharm El Sheikh Rd, Dahab 46617 Egypt

reviews.title: ❤️New and spotlessly clean rooms…High quality service…Happy stay…Expectations met expectations
reviews.text: Thank you to all the staff at Dahab Now Hotel. My stay was wonderful. The hotel is clean, and the staff are extremely respectful and courteous. Special thanks to Mr. Abu Bons from the front desk for his exceptional hospitality and professionalism. He instilled confidence in the quality of service. A big thank you also to Majid from housekeeping for his meticulous attention to detail regarding room cleanliness. The rooms were comfortable, especially those overlooking the swimming pool on the ground floor. The breakfast was excellent in quantity and quality, and special thanks to Chef Abdul Salam. The room maintenance was superb, from the air conditioning to the hot water, and the rooms were brand new. With love and gratitude for the place, you made me wish to return to Dahab again ❤️❤️

reviews.title: Would definitely come back.
reviews.text: Amazing clean place for travelers great location close to almost everything in Dahab. Mr Trbouche is an amazing host always offering help and directions if you’re new to the city. Very friendly safe neighborhood and good vibes. Cheers

reviews.title: Best hosts ever!!!
reviews.text: We so enjoyed our stay in Dahab, but staying in Tarbouche house made our stay truly wonderful. The room was nicely decorated and spotless. We had a comfy bed, nice hot shower and a fridge and kettle. There was a basket with fruits and a bottle of water for us upon arrival.Location is just perfect. Close to all the excitement and snorkelspots but also easy to go for a walk to the less busy areas. At night we couldn't hear any noise so a good nights rest was guaranteed after full days of activities.Yasser and his wife were always there to help. Whatever question we had, they were there to respond to us. There is only one thing we regret and that is that we couldn't stay any longer...but we'll be back for sure! Future guests...don't hesitate twice to book this place. You'll have an amazing stay!

reviews.title: I Really Recommend this awesome place
reviews.text: I Really Recommend this awesome place, I stayed there 3 weeks. awesome place with awesome people. Very clean and modern Rooms. it's in city center beside the sea, diving poitnts, bazaars and restaurants

tripadvisor.streetAddress: Al Fanar Str. Center of Masbat Bay, Dahab Egypt

reviews.title: Terrible hotel and owner!
reviews.text: I had a terrible accident during my stay at Sababa Hotel that I cannot recommend this hotel to anyone. As soon as I arrived at my room, I went to the bathroom to wash my hands and part of the sink, which is a huge marble block, suddenly fell on my feet! This was caused by the hotel's poor maintenance and safety standards, which were clearly inadequate. The accident cut my toe which resulted in a huge bloodbath that lasted the entire day, and I had to be rushed to the hospital. Even though my friends helped me, I can no longer walk normally because of this incident.To make matters worse, the hotel owner's behavior was completely inappropriate. He was incredibly rude and did not take any responsibility for the incident, nor did he offer any apology. If I had more time to stay in Egypt, I would have taken legal action against him.The photos I took show the broken sink and my injuries, which clearly show that the safety of this hotel is zero and the maintenance is terrible. I am disappointed that such a serious incident could occur, especially since hotels have a responsibility to ensure the safety of their guests. I urge anyone considering staying at Sababa Hotel to take caution and be aware of the potential dangers.It is important that the hotel takes full responsibility for the accident and compensates me for the injuries I sustained. Additionally, the hotel must take immediate action to improve their maintenance and safety measures to prevent such accidents from happening to other guests in the future.Based on my experience, I cannot recommend the Sababa Hotel to anyone until they have demonstrated that they have made the necessary improvements to ensure the safety of their guests.

reviews.title: very good location
reviews.text: the location is what made me book thi hotel. I really relay love the restaurant on the beachfront, Their mnu i a bit all over the place but it has some very tasty things on there!  Hotelroom ws clean, with ac and private bathroom

reviews.title: Good hotel, prime location
reviews.text: This small hotel is good. The roos is clean, and with its own bathroom. The resturant is on the other side of the bouleverad on the beach. It is nice to go for a swim and come back and have breakfast.  The russian food on the menu i nicer than the english food.

reviews.title: Supercheap hotel directly on the boulevard
reviews.text: I was amazed that directly on the boulevard, you can find hotels like this! It is nog superdeluxe, but you will not spend much time in your room anyway when you have the choice to sit in the restaurant at the beachfront. They have sunloungers, and proper table an chairs to work from.

reviews.title: best food and very clean
reviews.text: This was our first time in Dahab and at Sababa it looked very clean. The staff in the restaurant was super-friendly. The menu is half Russian half European and Egyptian so a good mix of food. I can recommend the fresh juice. It is really fresh and made without sugar or water.

reviews.title: beautiful & friendly
reviews.text: We came to this restaurant because it is next to the tour company we used King Safari( very good!!). The restaurant is at the beachfront and serves a very good breakfast and good coffee. Staff is very attentive and the place is clean, even the toilets!! ;-)

reviews.title: Very nice  and clean restaurant at the beachfront
reviews.text: Sababa restaurant is in the center of the boulevard. The restaurant is clean, with a nice sitting area and wifi. And easy entry to the beach. This was one of the places where they didn't play the horrible music really loud. I was pleasantly surprised by the menu! I didn't know this was a Russian restaurant!Very good coffee, and loved the dumplings!

reviews.title: Nice place to chill on the seafront
reviews.text: Sababa was the only place where we all (10 persons) could sit together, so we went there. I was bit critical at first but the staff made such a great effort making us all feel welcome that  we kept coming back ;-) ;-) Nice, relaxing place. Good coffee and juice, and totally loving the Russian menu!

reviews.title: Very good hotel
reviews.text: The hotel was very helpful with our check-in time ( 3 am). The rooms are simple but clean.  They have their own restaurant directly at the beachfront where you can swim and hang out all day.  The food was good, and they make the best-iced coffee in town. The chef was very thoughtful. I mentioned I didn't care for tomatoes on the first day and haven't seen them on my plate for the rest of my stay, which I  appreciate very much.I think for this price you will find nothing else directly on the boulevard.

reviews.title: Excellent Russian Chef
reviews.text: There are many restaurants in Dahab, and this one was recommended to be good. This was the first time I and my fiancee tried Russian food, and it was absolutely delicious!  The restaurant is nice and clean and at the beach front.  Only negative was that it took at least 20 minutes before we were served our drinks.If you are in for Russian food and want to sit on the beachfront, this is the place to be!

reviews.title: Worst experience
reviews.text: HelloI would like to tell you about my bad experience with the Castle HotelI was supposed to check in with them 15 days before my appointment, and I came yesterday at 12 o’clock to receive the room. He said that the person in the room had not yet left, so you can wait until it is cleaned. I waited and found the receptionist coming and telling me that he still had about an hour to go. I told him that we will wait, no problem. He made a face and said, “Okay, look, you will receive.” Another room until the person in front of you comes out, so I realized that there was a conversation and that the topic was not about an hour that I would wait for. The hotel owner spoke to me and told me to pick it up, and when the person in front of you comes out, I keep moving, so I told him, “I understand, he can still leave at 4 o’clock.” He said, “Come in.” So I told him, Okay, I will check out at the same time. He said. This agreement will not work for me. I told him, Okay, I will go back to the employee who agreed with me from the beginning. Then I found the respectable owner of the hotel coming to tell me why I didn’t stay. I told him I don’t like the alternative room and I need my room. He said, “This is what I have, and if you don’t like it, you can take your deposit.” I told him, meaning, take a deposit and sit in Dahab. This sun said yesI spoke to the employee and he said, “Okay, try to settle things with me.” I told him, “I will leave at the same time as I came in. I will be charged for half a day. I will be billed for the alternative room, I hope for less.”I rejected all these solutions and took my money and walked away after the treatment and did not see anything worseInformation about the alternative room is at the back, not the front, and smaller. Despite this, he wants to charge me the same price, and I accept that he will force me to do so.

reviews.title: I will be back for sure
reviews.text: Amazing place and Ayman the dive instructor is great I will be back for sure thank you mo and joI arrived late at night and they're waiting for me you can try diving there they're very good and make you feel safe and calm and the prices really good Thank you 😊

reviews.title: Affordable, suitable for solo travelers
reviews.text: Deep blue divers hostel is located at the center of the city, near all the shops and restaurants.. I spent 4 days there in August 2020, the staff is welcoming and very friendly, their internet wi do is fast, the room is appropriate, the root is nice for spending nights or having meals.. and it's affordable.. it's great for the prices you pay..

reviews.title: Awesome affordable hostel
reviews.text: I stayed few days for diving.Not fancy place but great for what I have paid.Located at the center of dahab ,close to the beach,nice staff.I recommend this place for budget travelers,very simple place.

reviews.title: Terrible hostel, avoid at all costs
reviews.text: Arrived to an untidy hostel and were provided an unmade bed with wet sheets. Dirty mattress and dirty bathrooms with no toilet paper included.They ask you to sign a waiver agreeing to not dive with any other companies in Dahab. Bad customer service, very unhelpful staff.

reviews.title: No trust, No Ethics
reviews.text: I booked my stay through booking.com and when i arrived, they asked me first to sign a paper that i have to dive with their diving center "side business". when i refused, the staff told me we have no place to stay.

reviews.title: You get the basics - But note: no diving with them NO stay
reviews.text: I booked my stay with Deep Blue Hostel as it looked great on pictures as well as very sociable. Unfortunately found it anything but.While I know the price is cheap, and you DO get what you pay for in terms of quality and facilities, I had still hoped to at least meet some friendly staff. However:They will not allow you to check in if you arrive late at night unless you pay for one of their drivers to pick you up. And even then they seem like you showing up is more of a nuisance.Upon venturing out in the morning, I was told by the owner that since I had not booked my diving with them (I declined to dive with them when he asked and told that it was because I had already booked at another place), I was asked to leave the hostel.This requirement was not stated prior to my booking - and with their attitudes (both the night before and the owner even) I would not have wanted to dive with them anyway.There are nicer people and places in Dahab.

reviews.title: Awful staff ruins the experience
reviews.text: Stayed in a private room for 3 nights. The price on booking.com does not include the 14% extra charge. Was surprised to have to pay 60 le more. Best to book on arrival.The WiFi doesn't work 95% of the time. The private room is big but has no air con. The bathroom is clogged so gets flooded after a shower. The toilet flush doesn't work properly.The young staff only wants your money and doesn't care about anything else. He even demands 20 le for staying in the lounge after checkout even though I paid for 3 nights and only stayed for 2! I was furious and left immediately.The only good thing was I met some of the best people in the hostel whom I travelled with around Dahab.

reviews.title: NO DIVERS NO CHECK IN
reviews.text: If you fine nice hostel, not here.The receptionist, young guy, was so rude and poor english. Maybe you can feel upset talking with him.I request check in on day early, they said yes. So I took bus earlier than my schedule. How ever when I arrive there, they said if I do not diving here I couldn't check in. What the hell?I was really tired at that time, so I don't want ague anymore. I change hostel. Please don't go there.

reviews.title: good place for divers to sleep
reviews.text: with a good price you can sleep and rest after your dive.it is basic but friendly.the staff are friendly.the break fast is light and goodvery close to the bus stationyou can dive with big blue diving center tin the hotel

It's located near the beach and near a lot of restaurants staff and owner where friendly and helpfull .

reviews.title: Decay of a hotel
reviews.text: I’ve been many times at the Lagona in the past. The first was in 1996! It has always been a Spartan hotel but in any case clean, with the staff very cooperative. Not anymore now. Either the rooms and the location is very dirty. Nobody cleaning. The manager is not managing anything. You ask several times to make up the room and nobody comes. At breakfast they don’t serve any tea or coffe. You have to pay them apart. According the reception breakfast start at 8.00am but, in reality never before 8.30 and after 30 minutes everything is finished. Outside it is full of rubbish and scrap. It is a pity because was really nice place. Anyway, in future, I will not come anymore here.

reviews.title: Good location and clean rooms

reviews.title: Different hospitality
reviews.text: I would like to thank all hotel team for their hospitality specially Mr.Ahmed and the uniqueness Mrs.Sarah.I really enjoyed my time there ,one of the best hotels that won’t let u go out, there are amazing view ... see and mountains and one minute walk by the see to be on with the most famous and fabulous sight seeing (Lagona) also 20 minuets walk by the see to be in famous street bazaars and restaurant (Al-Masharaba) or 5mint by car or 10mint by bicycle.also u can stayed their there are a supermarket and they helped u to deliver for any restaurants.plz contact with the office if u wanna organiz any trip not the fake trip u get nowadays.In night at the beach it’s amazing stars view and clearly Milky Way its quite place and there are a night guard so take a safety nap time.The room are special clean and quiet it’s built by Hassan Fathy architecture with different vibes it orders helps to relax its awesome to be under dome.Don’t worry about traveling alone because with them u can easily sense evolved privacy and respect . Highly Recommendations for families , girls and grooms. Really they are over expectations.. keep going 💙💙💙

reviews.title: Value for money
reviews.text: It is a good place if you are looking for cheap place and meeting the minimum cleanness, but not fancy. It has it own its beach which is really good. It is so close from the lagoon, but 25 minutes walk from elmamsha if you like walking.

reviews.title: Family Vacay 2020
reviews.text: Good location in terms of beach front. Swimming pool water is sea water, imagine swimming with you’re eyes in pain all the time unless you’re using goggles. Beach front has a lot of dried seaweeds. It wasn't maintained very well.. We use this hotel as part of the package of our tour.. Restaurant serves breakfast and lunch (part of the package). I'm not sure if they have housekeeping because NO one seems to  clean our room and no one collects garbage on daily basis. Employees has no uniform, hard to identify who is staff and who is guest.

reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text: Despite the hotel beautiful location it turned out to be a big disappointment. Unclean rooms, unclean pool, even the plates inthe restaurant are covred in dust. The hotel corridors are totally dark at night with so many rocky stairs risking a bad injury. The pool is dirty and unusable. Dust everwhere in the room and left over gum stuck to the bed.The AC is noisy making sleep very difficult  and its filters are full of dust.For the similar price tag you cab get a much better room and view just a couple of meters away.I hope management can turn things arround because the hotel location is great otherwise it is going to waste.

reviews.title: A little oasis in Dahab
reviews.text: Fiona and Toby were incredibly helpful even before we arrived by quickly replying to messages. We arrived late and they’d already got some supplies in which made a difference. The apartment itself is a little oasis of peacefulness and greenery. It had everything we needed including bits for the bathroom. The accommodation was really lovely. Throughout our stay, Fiona and Toby provided us with great recommendations for places to eat (out/take away) and for lots of activities. They arranged a great trip to the Three Pools and to have a bbq under the stars in a wadi through a lovely Bedouin man, Swalem. They have lots of local knowledge and were really helpful. I’ve been to Dahab in the past and whilst it has changed a lot, it still retains its charm and would definitely be my preference over Sharm. I’d definitely recommend this as a place to stay even though it’s not in the centre of Dahab. Taxis are cheap and easily available. Fiona and Toby were amazing hosts and made our holiday very special.

reviews.title: First visit, but definitely not our last!
reviews.text: We have just had the most memorable holiday ever! Fiona and Toby were fabulous helpful hosts. The information pack was really really helpful as we had no idea where anything was or what to do about things. The apartment was lovely and I slept like a log, helped by the air conditioning. We were close to the supermarket, the beach, the water sports centres and the hotel where our friends were staying. Also a 2 minute walk to pick up a taxi. We took a photo of the map from the info pack which helped with explaining to the taxi driver where we wanted to be. The apartment is in a really good position for everything and has everything you need. We will be back.

reviews.title: Best place to stay
reviews.text: I just had the best holiday ever! It was so easy to feel like home at Fiona’s and Tobi’s beautiful place. Everything was very clean, the bed was so comfortable and I could deeply relax and sleep well! The apartment is very close to the beach and to go downtown I just took a taxi. Very cheap. Fiona and Tobi were so lovely and provided everything and were always available for anything I needed during my stay. I enjoyed Dahab so much and I will definitely come back and stay by Fiona and Tobi ❤️ highly recommended ❤️ Thank you so much! See you next time!

reviews.title: Highly recommended on AirBnB
reviews.text: The English owners have provided a haven in Dahab which was located in a quiet part of Dahab medina and a few minutes walk from circle divers each day. They were so helpful, booked our taxi to and from airport, gave us rating out advice and helped with any enquiry or need. The apartment was very clean, just the right size for us and the teenagers with an oasis in the garden and nice little pool for cooling off. It was made better by not having intrusion from the neighbouring apartment so we had good privacy. Air conditioning worked very well, thankfully.

reviews.title: Sunny Times
reviews.text: A great place to chill out in as a group of friends for 2 weeks.The apartment had everything to make you feel at home and the garden was a peaceful retreat .Easy  to get to the Lagoon, beaches and into town.Fiona and Toby were  really helpful with local knowledge .Fabulous place to take in some winter sun.

reviews.title: Dahab Lagoon  Villa Apartmenrs
reviews.text: We had the most amazing 2 weeks staying at the octypus villa apartment. The hosts, Toby and Fi, were very welcoming with a wealth of local knowledge and able to recommend and book trips. The aparttment is 1 hour transfer from Sfarm and arranged by Toby and Fi. The apartment is minutes walk from a stunning beach and ideal for swimming, snorkeling and wind surfing. You can use the public beach or pay to use one of the private hotel beaches with sunbeds and towels.. There is a local supermarket and fruit and veg shop very close by the apartment. Dahab is a quick taxi ride and cost us around £1.50 each way. There are many restaurants and places to snorkel. We had a relaxing 2 weeks and would love to return. Dahab offers a more authentic Egyption experience compared to the bright lights of Sharm.

reviews.title: Amazing location
reviews.text: We had the most wonderful time staying at the lagoon villa apartment. The hosts, Fiona and Tobi were so kind and are always there if you need anything. They gave us advice and locations where we could go eat or do activities. The apartment is very clean, the garden is so beautiful and it is big enough to let children play. I loved the pool very much, I used it many times during my stay. Toby and Fiona came to clean the pool many times to make sure it was clean for their guest. I will definitely go back there.

reviews.title: Solo windsurf and post winter season unwind
reviews.text: I had the best experienc staying in with Dahab Holidays. From well before take off I was offered solutions to things before I'd even thought about them. I had airport transfers arranged, dinner ordered for my first night, advice for getting set on the water. It was all amazing!Fiona and Toby made me feel so welcome, the apartment was spotless and had everything I needed for my stay. Just a short walk to the beach to launch from Harry Nass center 2 it was the perfect place to make the most of fantastic wind, getting out on the water right after breakfast. I didn't once regret traveling alone, with friendly faces everywhere!

reviews.title: Outstanding stay!
reviews.text: What a stay! I was alone underway for a windsurfing holiday - and never b4 in Egypt. After booking the room, Fiona and Toby (who are perfectly conntected to the Dahab-every day live) contacted me for further information and any help. A shuttle from Sharm-el Sheich was organised; I got information about fair and realistic prices in taxis/restaurants/activities; I could asked everything I wanted (weather/wind/choice of wetsuit)! When I came first in the appartement, everything was clean (top!) and decorated with fresh flowers. Water and small foods were already there. I got instructions - in the right, appropriate way.Wow - that is what I call a perfect hospitality. Gold standart and better.I never had a feeling of being alone or being a "normal" tourist. It felt more like being a foreign family member. I never had such a god organisation and safe, clean, uncomplicate stay like in this very comfy appartement. For everyone, who does not like to stay in a hotel and wants to get connected easily - go for Fiona and Toby. I strongly recommend.

reviews.title: Home away from home in Dahab!
reviews.text: We spent a fantastic 3 months staying in an Apartment in Toby and Fionas chalet.  Overall the quality of the apartment and homely feel to it is excellent.  Some apartments in Dahab can be quite "barren" and not exactly a "European standard".  Not so here!  Our apartment was beautifully appointed and furnished and the kitchen had more utensils than I think I do at home!  The garden is peaceful and sunny and well sheltered from the famous Dahab breeze.  The garden has pretty flowers, grass and a small pool to cool off in during the summer months.  Again grass is a varity in Dahab, so this was really a proper garden to relax in!  The property is just minutes walk away from the beach, both public and hotel beaches are available, both with very affordable food / snacks / sunloungers etc....  There are also a few small shops nearby for daily essentials, an ATM, and a store that sells alcohol too should you wish an afternoon beer in the garden.I am sure there are cheaper places possible in Dahab, but for what you pay staying here is excellent value for money for the quality of the apartment and the location.  There is zero traffic noise compared to many other noisy areas in town.  What really makes staying here are Toby and Fiona themselves who are always available via WhatsApp or phone call and live just minutes away.  They've lived here for over 15 years and know Dahab from restaurants to snorkeling spots inside out.  We stayed here for a full 3 months and their advise on everything from taxis to visas was invaluable.  They have both worked in hospitality and tourism for most of their working lives and make excellent hosts, I can't praise them enough!  Full marks from me and I really hope to come back 10/10!

reviews.title: Bad of the highest order

There is no Wi-Fi, TV, or even a phone in the room, and it is very far from the walkway or anything in Dahab, and you will not enjoy it. You will feel like you are distressed or in a prison. Give it only one star. . Attention must be paid to cleanliness, then cleanliness, then cleanliness. I wish there was a telephone in the rooms for communication, a TV as well, and Wi-Fi. It is necessary to pay attention to the quality and cleanliness of the food.

reviews.title: People in the kitchen are nice but owner and reception not good

I was in a single room and I demanded to change it because it was a horrible room with ants as well. However , the last time when I went to the reception, they told me that I didn't go to tell them that the things were not fixed. As if I should keep going to the reception more than 3 times! They don't have a phone in the room and they don't have a kettle. I asked before I travel if there's a kettle and they said that they will bring me one. And they didn't bring me anything. The view is nice and people in the restaurant are really nice , but the reception were not doing anything in the complaints and also the owner. I will not go there again.

reviews.title: Friendly, helpful lovely hotel and dive centre
reviews.text: Friendly, Quiet hotel. Well located for restaurants and the reef. Room was clean and comfortable. Showers were clean and warm. Staff were very friendly and helpful as were all the other guests I had interaction with. Really enjoyed staying here and would come back again.Dive centre and staff all very friendly and knowledgeable. Haven't dived in many years and this was the perfect place to start up again. As a solo female traveller I felt safe and would recommend coming here. Look forward to coming back.

reviews.title: Well located and great diving
reviews.text: Well located, quiet inside, but right in the middle of things, with the dive shop inside and the reef straight across the road. Diving was great and the instructors including the world famous Saddam Killarny (7 days underwater!), who took me for my refresher dive and showed me how he is growing and proecting the coral. Ahmed took me out to Moray gardens, Canyon and Blue Hole. The accomodation was good and clean with good hot water. Bed was comfortable. Mustafa and Amy were very helpful

reviews.title: Best diving school in Dahab
reviews.text: Captain Anwar is the best dive instructor you will find in Dahab. He is so relaxed, patient, well informed and I felt very safe diving with him. I had the best trip and loved diving with all the dive masters and other guests. I made loads of friends and will be back as soon as I possibly can. If you can go to Gabr el Bint on the boat dive trip, this was the highlight for me. See you soon 🧡

reviews.title: Excellent diving center
reviews.text: Asking around at different diving sites in Dahab, this is the one that made the best impression on me because of the good treatment, safety and seriousness from the beginning to do 30 meter dives. Also thank the instructor Sadam for the excellent attention he had during the three dives, highly recommended.Octavi.

reviews.title: Simply felt like home
reviews.text: Nothing can express my happiness with this place starting from the great hospitality they have and the amazing staff ..you really feels like you are at home everything you need is around you, super location and very clean rooms and the perfect advantage they have that you can swim in the pool at Night really one of the best places in dahab ( totally recommend )

reviews.title: Good place for individual trips.
reviews.text: Good and tidy rooms, nice pool and close to the lighthouse area, which is the best for diving trips. It is an awesome place if you plan an individual trip to Dahab. From here you get anywhere interesting quick per foot.

reviews.title: Wonderful diving vacation, highly recommended
reviews.text: We stayed in Dahab divers hotel and used diving club services. The stuff is very professional and friendly. They arranged diving for us according to our wishes and level.  I liked dive-instructors Anvar and Saddam. Rooms were quiet. Very close to the beach and tourist promenade, restorants and shops.

reviews.title: Advanced Open Water
reviews.text: My dive instructor, Mostafa, was very helpful and explained everything thoroughly before diving. He was extremely patient and made me feel comfortable with important aspects of diving that I needed to know. This made the dives enjoyable because I felt like I could trust him completely.

reviews.title: Dahab divers center, Diving courses
reviews.text: It’s easy to find good diving instructor, but one in million to find a diving instructor that his passion takes scuba diving courses to another level of professionalism & knowledge, thank you MOHAMED SHERIF for the great experience & positivity

reviews.title: My favourite hotel & dive center
reviews.text: I haven’t stayed anywhere else in Dahab and don’t plan on doing that. The rooms are really clean, the breakfast is good and the staff are really friendly & helpful.I feel like it’s my home away from home.

reviews.title: Worst Experience Ever Harassment - Unsafe and Unprofessional Staff
reviews.text: I recently stayed at Ganet Sinai Hotel from Worst Experience Ever - Unsafe and Unprofessional Staff October 7th to October 11th, 2024, and what should have been a relaxing vacation turned into a nightmare on the evening of October 10th.While I was hanging my clothes on the rack in front of the garden, where a dinner party was happening, I was harassed by two members of the hotel staff. They made inappropriate gestures toward my clothes, exchanged offensive comments, and laughed. One of them, Ahmed Galal, was particularly involved.I immediately went to the reception to report this incident and spoke with the Front Office Manager, Ashraf. His response was shockingly dismissive and unprofessional. Instead of apologizing or taking action, he seemed to defend the behavior of the staff, and, to my disbelief, admitted to harassing me as well. I felt unsafe and completely unsupported by the management.In addition to this, I was charged twice by mistake at reception. They told me the money would be refunded within 48 hours, but if not, I should call Ashraf again—the same manager who was not supportive at all.Furthermore, I stayed in room 106, and my friends were in room 334. They noticed that the housekeeping staff did not replace the towels. Instead, they merely rearranged the same used towels and presented them as if they were fresh, which is completely unhygienic.This was by far the worst experience I have ever had in Dahab, and I strongly urge anyone considering this hotel to stay away for their own safety and well-being.

reviews.title: Rude and lacking - definitely would NOT recommend
reviews.text: My mother and brother live in Dahab, and have frequented the Ganet Sinai restaurant area often, ordering food at the table and accessing the sea from the beach. On this occasion, my family and I had just ordered lunch at the Restaurant, and my two brothers and I laid out towels on the sand in an empty space closest to the sea and sat on the beach (we knew that you had to rent the sunbeds, so we did not go near them), while our parents remained seated at the Restaurant table. A man wearing no identifying uniform or name tag came to tell us we had to get up and leave or pay to stay sitting there. My brother speaks fluent Arabic, and asked him who he was and where was this rule that we had to pay to simply sit on the beach, if we were paying guests of the Restaurant. Therefore this man, who we later discovered to be a "beach boy" named Mohammed, walked my brother to the reception, rudly saying "Don't you speak Arabic to me" and "You talk too much". We did not have an issue with there being a fee, it was the manner in which we were told to get up and leave by Mohammed, despite being clients of the resort. The reception simply made excuses for Mohammed's behaviour, and did not acknowledge the two e-mails I sent the owner, simply asking for an apology.Think twice about deciding to stay here or visit their restaurant; despite there being very pleasant employees such as the restaurant staff, the way this event was handled says a lot with regards to client handling, in English, Arabic, or any other language.Don't ruin you stay in wonderful Dahab by choosing the Ganet Sinai.

reviews.title: Terrible value for money
reviews.text: Having spent over 2000 USD on a 6 night stay in a Suite I’m left feeling very disappointed - the ‘premium accommodation’ of this 5 star property was old and uncomfortable - 3 star at best - apparently there is a refurb plan in the works but why charge this amount for such an obviously substandard product - it lacks integrity and is terribly short- sighted - at the very least get some decent pillows the current ones are of very poor quality and replace the sofa which collapsed every time I sat on it - I was offered a 30 euro discount by way of recompense 🫣🤪The staff are for the most part lovely The room service is great The beach is also good The gardens are very well kept & housekeeping do a good job However I could have done without : rock music at 10 am onwards in the beach bar - how about something less intrusive Full blast disco music from 8 pm onwards 50 metres  from where guests were having dinner on the restaurant terrace I would have liked it if the sunset bar was actually open for sunset and beyond  -  there was nowhere on the beach to sit and have  a drink in the evening - the only bar that was open was at the front of the property and was small , dark and looked onto the reception area - I fail to understand the logic of that Ok rant over With some consideration for the guests and a few tweaks around bar opening times / usage / musical choices / bedding this would have  been a far better experience - as it is this is very far from a 5 star experience

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: We loved our stay!! Perfect location right on the beach. Every day we had the best breakfast with the sea on the background. reviews.title: Clean, bright, calm, friendly!
reviews.text: We had actualy booked with another Camp which was a massive disappointment on so many levels. So we searched for an alternative and got the Crazy Camel Camp recommended by a friend. We arranged a meeting to see the rooms at night and were welcomed righ away. I immediately loved it, so we stayed the rest of our days in Dahab there. It´s just lovely. The rooms are bright and very clean. As we stayed there with our dog, we especially loved the terrace and also the open yard, where our dog socialized with the resident dogs and lay in the sun. There are also multiple tables outside in sun or shade to sit and enjoy your time . If we ever needed anything there was always someone to ask. For example: as there were heavy rains the night we wanted t leave in the morning, our bus company told us that they would leave Dahab in the afternoon at 3pm. We asked if we could stay in the room a bit longer instead of checking out at 12, which would have been the rule and it was no problem at all.The camp is perfectly located directly at the promenade. The first snorkel spot (getting in the water at the bridge) is just 3 minutes away. You cans stroll the promenade for food or find some cheaper options a bit away from the shore, nothing being far away. We would always stay there again and highly recommend the place!

Accomodation was fairly basic but had all the essentials - comfortable beds, decent bathroom etc. Our only complaint was that it was pretty darn cold at night and the rooms have no heating but they do provide sufficient bedding but that's no consolation for a late-night nip to the en-suite!

The family flair is just beautiful and you feel at home. And from a diving point of view, I would like all dive centers to display such professionalism as the Sunsplash divers.

reviews.title: Pure relaxation
reviews.text: This was the second time I was able to spend my holiday at Sunsplash - many thanks to Sayed, a perfect host, and of course his great team, who anticipate your every wish.The Sunsplash is in a quiet location, a little away from the hustle and bustle, but if you feel like it, you can be in the middle of it all in just a few minutes on foot.The rooms are practical and comfortably furnished, always clean and well maintained. The WiFi works perfectly.If you are travelling to Dahab for diving, you are in the very best hands with Sayed. There are numerous beautiful diving spots in the surrounding area - just ask Sayed, he will take care of everything you need.I will definitely come back. Thank you for two very relaxing weeks!

reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.text: A place to feel completely at ease, quiet and peaceful and yet close to the 'coastal boulevard'. The hotel owner is very friendly and does everything to make your stay pleasant, including organizing excursions. Great hotel!

reviews.title: Trust Calm Reliability Net Very friendly owner and staff
reviews.text: I arrived with my girlfriend. The owner was waiting for us in the middle of the night.He also arranged the taxi that picked us up in Sharm El Sheikh.Every morning there is a delicious extensive breakfast. Skip fruit? No problem ... in the refrigerator for this afternoon!The location is fantastic, with its own beach spot.Wonderfully quiet at the end of the promenade...Bottle in the fridge? That's possible!Hang up the laundry? That's possible?A wonderful and safe feeling of being at home. Very nice too.I was there in January with a friend...and went back in February with my husbandJanuary 2024

reviews.title: A great place to be!
reviews.text: Sunsplash Divers is a basic hotel with clean rooms and a great a/c. The people working there are kind and attentive. In the past, I have heard crazy stories about diving in Egypt. Not so with Sunsplash Divers: absolutely safe and diving in small groups. After a 3,5 years break of diving, not only was I able to catch up that time but to elevate my skills. I did 24 dives - I think that already says it all. I also celebrated my 50th dive there. Thank you, Sherief, for making this a special one! The location of Sunsplash Divers is also great: away from the bars but still everything in walking distance. Also: don‘t miss the sunrises at the beach!Sayed was very helpful in organizing my tour to the desert or giving advice about local agencies for a quad tour. Thank you to the whole team for making this  an amazing vacation!

reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: This was one of my favorite experiences in dahab! I go to dahab very frequently, but this is yet my favorite hotel. Rooms are very clean and well maintained. The AC works perfectly which is very important in such hot weather. I loved the vibes there, it was cozy and very welcoming. I definitely recommend it to anyone who’s looking for a hotel with direct beach access. Loved the experience!

reviews.title: Great value hotel.
reviews.text: Great value hotel located by the beach to the southern, quieter, end of the main tourist area. Helpful and friendly proprietor and staff. Clean and spacious room.  I had an enjoyable stay at Sunsplash.

reviews.title: wonderful hotel, amazing and professional diving, lovely food and super service
reviews.text: I like to travel a lot, but this hotel was the place with the best service I ever had so far. Helpful, quick service, and understandable support from the booking until the end of our stay, while the covid time.The hotel and the rooms are beautiful and clean and the environment was charming.The diving was amazing and professional.We where there with our whole family (with 2 kids and a baby) and everybody felt more than welcome.The food was delicious and more than enough. We definitely will come back.

Cleanliness was fine, if you want anything done again or changed you just have to ask. Pool was lovely, and the seating area around it was nice. Air conditioning in the rooms works really well, room was spacious and had a nice outdoor seating area. I would recommend this hotel to someone staying in the area. Very pleasant stay 💕

There was no room service at all, and the staff were unhelpful and unprofessional whenever we asked for anything.The bathroom was barely functional, with rust everywhere، on the fixtures, furniture, tables, and almost every surface. The bed sheets were visibly dirty, the towels had a very unpleasant smell, and the floors were not cleaned properly. There was also a strong sewage smell coming from the room, making the stay extremely uncomfortable.The breakfast was extremely poor with very limited options, low-quality food, and everything felt cheap and neglected. The entire hotel feels old, badly maintained, and not worth the money in any way.There was absolutely no peace or quiet during our stay. Maintenance and renovation work was taking place in the rooms next to ours, creating constant noise throughout the day . It was impossible to rest or sleep properly.I would never stay here again and honestly would not recommend this place to anyone. One of the worst hotel experiences I’ve ever had.

reviews.title: Both Rooms Were Subpar — Poor Maintenance, No Wi-Fi, and Deeply Uncomfortable
reviews.text: This was one of the most uncomfortable hotel stays I’ve had.The first room felt unsafe — the door lock was flimsy and visibly exposed between the frame and the wall. The lighting in both rooms was so dim that even with every bulb on, the space felt gloomy and depressing. The window in the first room directly faced a yoga studio, leaving me with no privacy and no way to let in natural light.I asked to change rooms only because the first was already unacceptable, but unfortunately the second was just as poor — the view was split between the yoga studio and a rooftop full of debris and industrial pipes. I completely understand that room options may have been limited, but that doesn’t excuse the overall lack of basic standards — especially since others in my group, who paid the same rate, were placed in rooms that were noticeably more functional and well-maintained, which made the lack of consistency even more frustrating.The chair in my room was broken, the linen had holes, and the pillowcase had a hair on it — all after the room was supposedly cleaned. They replaced some of those items, and I ended up with a duvet cover that had a torn zipper. The kettle was completely black inside, and the cup was full of black specks — so I walked back to the first room and replaced them myself, since the rooms had no phone to contact reception.The bathroom had a foul, suffocating stench that made it genuinely hard to breathe — I had to keep the door shut the entire stay just to cope, and I later found that several people in my group had also specifically complained about the bathrooms in their rooms. On top of that, the water heater was barely functioning and the showerhead barely released any water, making it difficult to even shower properly.The furniture was old and cracked, and I even found a toenail trapped under the glass of the table, which was absolutely revolting and impossible to ignore. There was no Wi-Fi available in either room, no safe, no hair dryer.It’s hard to overstate how disheartening the stay was — both rooms left me feeling neglected, uncomfortable, and deeply disappointed. You could get far more value for your money elsewhere.

reviews.title: Very good hotel, excellent location and breakfast, good beds and excellent service! Plus Fantasea diving center on site!
reviews.text: The place has improved a lot since our last visit in 2018. The breakfast is excellent, rooms have AC and are cosy, the beds are good and the staff are very friendly. The pool is also nice and clean and every room also has a porch where you can enjoy the sunsets etc. Their restaurant on the beach is also very good, it has excellent coffee (from the espresso machine) and top class fresh juices. The staff responded to our every wish and they were all friendly and helpful. We also liked the location, as the centre is only a few min walk away. As the price - performance ratio is good, we are definitely planning to come back when we visit Dahab again!

reviews.title: Best spot in Dahab.
reviews.text: Booked last minute over Christmas on a diving trip with the attached dive centre. We arrived pretty late in the evening but staff were super helpful, got us checked in quickly and directed us to the attached bar/restaurant on the beach (quickly our favourite spot of the trip!). Rooms are a great size - basic but nice and clean with comfy beds. We were comfortable enough without aircon and there was enough space for all our kit. The included buffet breakfast was lovely, Arabic selection plus fruit and fresh omelettes. I only took a quick dip in the pool as we were diving everyday. Staff are fantastic - ever so helpful. We had a great laugh with the beach bar team and a lush Christmas dinner. Highly recommend the spa, dive school (Fantasea) and the restaurant. Would definitely come back when in Dahab.

reviews.title: Very simple and beautiful accommodation
reviews.text: We spent a wonderful week at Sinbad Camp. All staff were super friendly and helpful and everything was very clean. The accommodation is very simple submitted, but just this simplicity makes you really come down there. In the common area there is always someone sitting for nice conversations and the location by the sea is priceless.Wi-Fi is only available outside, so you can really relax in the room. There is a small kitchen that you can use. There are also refrigerators available to everyone.

reviews.title: Dream Camp!
reviews.text: We found out about this camp by recommendation and asked for available rooms! It is super lovely and cozy place which gives the extra community feeling. You can feel that all guests are happy there and love this place so much they keep coming back. The rooms are nice and clean! The enclosed bathrooms or shared ones are pretty nice and extra clean. Plus the garden is just a nice place to stay and rest or read a book and forget about time. The several community areas are just as beautiful as the decor of the rooms - I guess no room looks like the other and one could feel that the memories of an open-hearted person went into it. The team is super friendly and decent, humble and helpful. There is also a good selection of hot drinks and food available. It was my first time in Dahab and I stayed at different places but Sindbad did the magic to me and I began to understand why everyone keeps falling in love with Dahab! If I come back then only for staying at Sindbad Camp!

reviews.title: Affordable and genuine.

reviews.title: Friendly and relaxed atmosphere
reviews.text: I stayed at sinbads camp for one week. The snorkelling and diving a few minutes walk away at lighthouse bay is amazing. The Bedouin people who run sinbads were welcoming and I felt very safe there.  Many people have been visiting for years. The relationship between them and the Bedouin people creates a relaxed atmosphere whether you want to sit on your own and read, chat to others or play a guitar and sing. A Bedouin guide took us for a trip into the Sinai dessert where we drank tea and went for a walk, this was an incredible experience. I definitely want to return.

reviews.title: Fantastic place
reviews.text: Spent a wonderful week at Sindbad camp. Everyone there is very friendly and the atmosphere is laid back and welcoming.
