reviews.title: Good location, worst experience.
reviews.text: The place has a very good location, yet the provide the worst hospitality service ever. The rooms are so dirty and doesn't have basic living needs, the food is terrible, and their staff is unprofessional and rude. I would never recommend this place to anybody. Also the road to the village is so pumpy and difficult.

reviews.title: Chalets are old and poorly maintained, with unprofessional customer experience.
reviews.text: The reality is a serious letdown. The chalets are old and poorly maintained, with issues affecting the water, sofas, Wi-Fi, and TV, as shown in the attached photos. I repeatedly asked for a replacement TV and receiver and was ignored. There was no meaningful assistance, and the receptionist, Ahmed, was rude and unprofessional. I strongly recommend avoiding this place and booking elsewhere.

reviews.title: Disappointing experience
reviews.text: Very disappointing experience. This place is nowhere near the standard it claims to be.We reserved three chalets, and all of them were in extremely poor condition. The reality was completely different from the photos—everything looked worn out, dirty, and badly maintained.Basic necessities were missing. There were no proper bed sheets, and we were expected to sleep on a stained mattress with just a blanket. This is completely unacceptable for any place that calls itself accommodation.The air conditioning was another major issue. Most units were either not working or barely functioning, and the ones that did work caused discomfort. Despite raising complaints, nothing was fixed.The internet there was just as disappointing as everything else the speed barely exceeds 2mb/s which makes it very hard for even normal browsing, so people who do work from home remotely they will not be able to do a thing with that internet, which all added to the frustration.The staff were not helpful, and the receptionist, Ghada, in particular, was unnecessarily rude and unprofessional in her attitude toward guests.Overall, this was a very poor experience and a waste of money. I would not recommend this place to anyone.

reviews.title: Dont like it
reviews.text: Rooms were dirty, like no one even tried to clean them.”	•	“The staff were rude and looked like they didn’t wanna be there.”	•	“It’s noisy, unorganized, and not worth the money

reviews.title: Brilliant Moon House
reviews.text: Me & my mum stay at Moon House every year because the place is so clean & nice. Wifi is great, European satalite tv, good kitchen with everything you need. The guys are really cool & funny & help with anything you need. The beach cafe has tasty food & is reasonably priced. We sometimes look at other places but always come back to Moon House cos it’s like our home away from home. Totally recommend this place 11 out of 10 stars!

reviews.title: Great choice
reviews.text: Came to Lila Inn and got a great well come and care from the hosts of the place .There are family who run the camp.Hisham the father and mustafa the sun are taking care for all you need . Just ask from them .Azeza the mother cooking are delicious.And camp is well served .Will come back again for sure

reviews.title: Chilling ❤️ And feeling home
reviews.text: Nice and high quality food and service the place is very good for relaxation the room was nice and clean but you need to get mosquito spray for room . At all this camp is the one of the best places I have ever seen! 💕

reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: Excellent. I‘ve been to multiple camps in and around Nuweiba. What‘s great about Leila Inn is the family environment of the place. Hesham and his family run the place and take great care of their guests. The food is homemade and delicious. Fruit juices and fruits sweeten the day. The sanitary facilities are clean and the water comes hot and with enough pressure. From your hut you will see the sea theough a small window, right next to your bed - lovely. Would always come again. Thanks for the great time

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: IT was so AMAZIIING ........,i loved the place so much, really comfy ,clean ,quite and there's activities to do, the food was delicious and the staff very helpful and so friendly it was a great experience and for sure it will not be the last time to visit , thanks for your efforts to make us enjoy our time.

reviews.title: Relaxing Stay
reviews.text: Everything was really nice, starting from the smooth reservation through WhatsApp till the checkout, the beach is really wide n clean, rooms r a bit small but sparkling clean, toilets as well, there is hot water n it is a plus, the staff r really friendly n u really feel home. Even it was crowded a bit they kept the cleanliness levels at a good way. Thnx for everything, would definitely go it again.

reviews.title: UNIQUE ❤️💜
reviews.text: Very nice place, i think it the best place in the world to who want relaxing and serenity.The food was great we told me what is specialized them is the food cuz they have a good chef and it’s homemade and really it was NICE ❤️

reviews.title: So comfort 🤩❤️
reviews.text: This is my second time in laila inn and evertime i leave i feel i want to go back again ❤️ Really guys everything was more than beautiful the hospitality, food ! , cleanliness of the room and the toilets and staff were frinedly always great 😊

reviews.title: Laila inn is the best ❤️

reviews.title: Their response is ruthless.  It is not recommended for services except for classes.
reviews.text: The disappointing thing about Dahab Days is after class.  They promised to send me photos and videos of the class, but they never responded.  I don't know why.  I have asked them for photos and videos several times, but they still have not responded.  In addition to photos and videos, there was an incident where double payments were made while paying tuition.  However, they only responded after I contacted them several times and begged them to do so.  I would like to receive my photos and videos from them.  The class with Dahab Days was very informative and great!  I took the advanced course through Dahab Days, and instructor Hussein was kind and gave me detailed information.  But I don't know why Hussein suddenly stopped responding to me.Their response is ruthless.  It is not recommended for services except for classes.

reviews.title: Excellent diving sites were chosen. Knowledgeable instructors and very professional.
reviews.text: I dived with a group of divers from Kuwait. We made use of the services of Dahab Days Diving Center whilst diving in both Dahab and Sharm El Sheik. Our diving instructors, captains Atar and Ismael were very professional, helpful, and friendly. I will certainly recommend them and dive with them again should the opportunity arise.

reviews.title: The best holiday of my life!
reviews.text: The best holiday of my life! Beautiful places, amazing and patient instructors, great organization in Dahab Day Diving center. I'll come there again for sure. I recommend this place and instructors for everyone who wants to have wonderful experience and so many adventures under the water!

reviews.title: Best diving center in dahab
reviews.text: What a wonderful experience I've experienced, best team ever professional and friendly. I'll come again and do diving with you , you're the best in dahab in diving . I will come to have diving courses with you !!🥹😍

reviews.title: Fully Satisfied
reviews.text: Clean, tidy, helpful, cheap. Perfect location, 2 minutes walking from the beach and eateries, 5 min walking from the Lagoon . Got a boat ride half day use with the same owner of the studios,  and it was just stunning.

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: I traveled alone. I had a long stay almost a month and I felt very safe, the studios are clean and fully equipped very close to everything comfy and chill. The little city is easy to walk and extremely beautiful  btw I did diving and safari with the same company and It was just incredible, such an incredible experience.

reviews.title: Best diving center in dahab
reviews.text: I highly recommend the dahab days diving center, the equipments are very good and the team is well trained and helpful friendly and I recommend to dive with the best instructor mr Elattar he is well experienced and he helped me to get over my fears in the water thanks a lot it was really amazing

reviews.title: Horrible experience! Rats in my bedroom and scam!
reviews.text: I spent one month in the studios, from the beginning Mohamed the owner scammed me and mislead me, I noticed that the place was very dirty but he told me that one of the few places with fresh water and the lowest price(he even complained that he wasn't earning money, nothing of it was true you can find a better place and cheaper just next door ), and of course he wanted to sell me everything he can at a higher price using misleading techniques speaking very bad about other diving centers and windsurf instructors. The first week I heard noises in my room and I could see TWO RATS eating my food!!! When I complained they said it was my imagination, the same story with the other guests, the place was INFECTED WITH RATS!! Then when I told them I was not going to renew my stay there Mohamed start sending me messages at midnight asking me to leave the place earlier than agreed and of course without having my money back! So I was so scared that I had to leave not having the money I paid for a month's stay. It is not a safe place for girls, take into account that the owner will tell you "you are my friend we are a family" just don't trust him!

reviews.title: The diving center
reviews.text: The diving aquipment is old and not so good. The prices are a bit higher than the other clubs. In the end we payed 30 euros more than we agreed (they kept our logbooks and diving licenses until we paid the extra money). We left this wonderful city with bad feelings just because of this diving center

reviews.title: Friendly and expert
reviews.text: Well, no enough words to describe how great and smart this diving centre. Hospitality...giving u the feeling that u r at ur home, soft deals and polite staffs.Very advanced and experts instructor.Highly  recommend  to dive with.

reviews.title: Always a warm welcome
reviews.text: It's like returning to your family home when you arrive at Diver's House.  Everyone there gives you a warm welcome and it makes you feel  like you've never left,  even though this time it wasn't our usual annual visit, but a 3 year gap due to Covid travel  restrictions.Thank you guys for your smiles, fun and friendliness as always.

reviews.title: A really good place to stay and enjoy dahab.
reviews.text: A really fantastic place to stay in a great location. The hotel is right by the sea in a quiet part of dahab.All the staff are really friendly and helpful and make you feel really welcome. The rooms are nice and clean. There are lots of good places to eat and drink a beer after a day of diving.

reviews.title: Love this place
reviews.text: Very nice and friendly team, love every second of our stay, definitely will do it again. YAser from the diving center is fantastic he was quite helpful and calm with the new divers. Highly recommend it for diving and staying in dahab  and looking for serenity and calmness

reviews.title: Amazing Service
reviews.text: The hotel is amazing & the staff is very very helpful.The diving instructors are velly skilled and great teachers.I had a problem with my diving open water  licensce which was issued from the hotel in 2013 & Tamer was more than helpful.

reviews.title: Diving Holiday
reviews.text: Perfect atmosphere, perfect view, perfect people, perfect vacationWe stumbled upon Divers House when we were looking for another hotel in Dahab. We are so happy to find this place. We got a really nice room and the staff and service was amazing. We will have to come back!

reviews.title: Great stay and scuba diving in Dahab
reviews.text: How nice was to find this place! All the staff is super friendly and efficient and they make everything they can to make you feel at home. The room was simple, clean and with a beautiful view. The diving lessons were great, Yasser was a top instructor, full of energy and always with a smile on. I had an amazing time and I’m definitely going back !

reviews.title: Amazing Dahab diving
reviews.text: We were at Divers House for 10 nights. Airport pick-up and drop-off was flawless and all our needs were attended to and taken care of by the Team.We dove every day we could and Yasser (Divers House's in house instructor) made this diving vacation very special for us. It was fun adventorous relaxing and fascinating at the same time.You could not ask for a better guide to show you all the major and also the secret spots underwater.We will most definitely be going back as soon as we can.

reviews.title: The best of the best
reviews.text: Thankyou for another great holiday  I can’t say how much fun we had   Thankyou everyone for all you help it was great to see you all and we loved all the diving with great friends and the best guide  Yasser  to everyone there we can’t wait to come back to our home in Dahab. You are all the BEST. mr Magdi , Tamar, Adham,Ali and Hamid.

reviews.title: Diving heaven
reviews.text: I would like to recommend Yasser Mohamed with Diver's House for all your future diving trips in Dahab. He is extremely knowledgeable, professional, funny, friendly and makes you feel safe before you start suiting up. He sits with you and explains everything you will be doing before you even touch your gear. His briefings are clear and detailed. He is also very patient, so ask him any questions that may come up, or to repeat anything that wasn't clear. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Best Value for Money
reviews.text: The hotel offers great value for money with an excellent service. Get the room with the balcony for an unbeatable view. Also it has the beat dive center in Dahab. The staff is very friendly and will help you with your overall experience.

reviews.title: An experience worth repeating
reviews.text: Really, when I went to the place, it was really nice and the management was excellent. I wanted to go to a first-class hotel with nice rooms. When you sent me the pictures and went to the place, everything you showed me was like the pictures. Thank you very much, Mr. Ahmed. I will try it again soon♥️

reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text: Very bad hotel. The rooms are very dirty. Very dirty pillows. Haven't amenities. The ants in everywhere even on bed. The T.V is not working. The positive side was just the friendly staff and sales man called (Shawaza) who arrange the trips, he's very helpful.

reviews.title: A ne pas recommander du tout
reviews.text: The worst place I've ever seen and will never recommend it to anyone. The reception staffs are not professional at all specialy GHONEIM this person was so rude with us in every sense of the term, cleanliness is zero, continual electricity and water cut, cockaroches in the rooms and a lot of details !! the only professional person was the restaurant director, chef and all his staff they are literally the only friendly, respectful persons in this place and I really appreciate the way they treated us.

reviews.title: liked it so much I returned this month
reviews.text: This hotel is an ideal destination for people visiting QATAR on business....Very near to Airport and late night departures are not a problem at all. liked it so much I returned this month, The buffet was the same each day, but with plenty of variety, it was ok for a few days.

reviews.text: Dirty pillows..No pillow cases..dirty walls horrible air conditioner makes to much noises cant sleep because of it .. mattress not comfortable..bad furniture.. heater not working and tv not working.. awful toilet..so far away

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: One of my friends recommend the place for me , actually it was a Good place to visit , nice service and. Evaluation i can give them 4,7/5 I highly recommend the place for everyone who wants to change his moooooooooood .

reviews.title: Have A Blast At Dahab Dorms
reviews.text: I stayed at Dahab Dorms when doing a PADI Divemaster course at Red Se Relax Relax Resort dive centre. I enjoyed the accommodation and the transient travellers were a blast of fun. There are friendly dogs and cats all around. I managed to sleep well throughout my stay, however, some did not.

reviews.title: Best accommodation in Dahab
reviews.text: I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at the dorms/saver annex of Red Sea Relax Resort. The friendly and helpful people working here made it a very pleasant experience. The staff, especially Osama, assisted with everything from travel arrangements to tour and activity booking and helpful tips on what to do and where to eat. Perfect! Adjacent dive center is great value for money, too, and staying at the dorms is refunded when diving. Plus, access to a gym and a fantastic breakfast included. At nighttime the bar turns into the social hub of Dahab and especially the terrace is a cool place to hang out for a drink. Come to Sinai despite any travel alerts your governments might have issued - it's safe and this little gem is such a relaxing place with great vibe and hospitality and plenty of stuff to do in the area.

reviews.title: Best in dahab!
reviews.text: Have stayed here twice now and loved it both times. Great location, very spacious apartment attached to the dorms, and free breakfast at the adjoining hotel. Also very friendly and helpful staff as well, especially Osama - thanks! Without doubt the best hostel in dahab, and amazing value too!

reviews.title: Great prices, staff, and location with tons of freebies
reviews.text: I stayed here for 5 nights in November 2013, extended from 3 nights. I loved my time in Dahab with Dahab Dorms at Red Sea Relax Resort. I stayed in the dorms, which are located a 1 minute walk away from the resort. Staying here was like having a flat.  There was a kitchen and male and female dorms. This place has some of the best prices in town, the best location, and every day you dive with the dive centre, you get free accommodation in the dorms with access to their resort facility. Some of the freebies that were included were a clean pool, breakfast, kayak rental, gym and sauna access, strong wifi. The guys that work at the front desk could not be friendlier. I wished I could have stayed longer but at least I managed to convince some of my friends to!

reviews.title: Best Deal in Dahab
reviews.text: I've stayed at Dahab Dorms twice and have loved it each time! the dorms are comfortable and clean and the complimentary water makes all the difference. Additionally, the staff, especially Osama and Said are so friendly, welcoming and professional! This is the perfect place to relax and not worry about anything. It's reliable, pretty, convenient and hands down the best deal in Dahab!

reviews.title: Great value & Terrific Breakfasts
reviews.text: This place exceeded my expectations. In addition to the two dorm rooms (one male, one female, each with two bunk beds), there was a very large living area with dining table and chairs, couches, purified water and full working kitchen, including stove, refrigerator  pots, pans, dishes, etc.The breakfast included in the price at Red Sea Relax Resort, it's "sister" facility," was excellent. it had many Western and Arab choices as well as omelets or pancakes made to order. Free instant coffee and tea was available 24/7. The beautiful swimming pool  at Red Sea Relax Resort provided a lovely option to the Red Sea.Staff was friendly and helpful, especially Said who worked the afternoon/evening shift.

reviews.title: Great value!
reviews.text: We stayed in the dorms for 6 nights, and we were absolutely happy with our experience! There were six beds in the room and plenty of lockers for bags. The shared bathrooms were not always functioning, but a message at reception, and it was handled right away. Rooms were cleaned every day and bathrooms more often. The people at reception were very helpful and eager to make our stay as good as possible. The breakfast buffet was pretty good, with a good range of choices between fruits, cereals, eggs, sausages, pancakes etc. the bread could be a bit boring though. A nice touch was the all day free coffee/ tea/ drinking water!

reviews.title: The best
reviews.text: One of the best hostels I've ever stayed (and I stayed in hundreds), incredibly good value for money. Location - very good, it's located on the main seaside street. Hostel is a part of a bigger hotel. Staff - very nice, kind and friendly, it's possible to arrange bus tickets and tours at the reception for a fair price. Dorm room was very neat, beds comfortable. Atmosphere - superb! There's a bar at the hostel, with cheap beer and very nice terrance. But the best part of the show was breakfast, I expected tiny one - some juice, some bread, ham and cheese. I get hot traditional egyptian dishes, all were very delicious. To be honest - it's wise to pay for the night just to eat this breakfast, as it was better than meals in some restaurants before, and one night in dorm was cheaper than meals in those restaurants. Recommended without any doubt.

reviews.title: Great place, lots of extras
reviews.text: The dorms were quite clean.  Situated on a resort grounds you get access to all the amenities.  There is a pool right outside, free wifi, internet, breakfast.  The dive centre is a bit pricier than others but I had a good time with them.

reviews.title: Very bad stay
reviews.text: Very bad hotel ! No towels or any amenities to be offered.The hotel is lacking the basic hygiene .One of the staff hassled me from the cleaning and I dealt with him !! The beach is not for swimming even for professional because of the high waves .I didn't like the surrounding ( the area around is so primitive  and not clean at all !

reviews.title: a nice location but zero hygiene
reviews.text: The hotel has great location buy poor hygiene. The room is dirty, the bathroom is leaking everywhere. The bed sheets and covers are dirty and when we asked for clean covers, no one was able to help since the room service staff leave at 5 PM.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: A pleasant place to spend a few days relaxing.  The open design of the hotel is clean and appealing with its views towards the sea.  The small private beach I very nice although the sea is rocky but there is a large private pool at the heart of the hotel.  The rooms are comfortable but not perfect but the faults are only minor and easy to rectify.  The breakfast is of very good quality and served in a large airy room.  Staff work hard to maintain cleanliness in all public areas including the large authentic Bedouin tent in the beach which is  a great place to relax with friends.   Lots to do in the area and the hotel works in conjunction with local attractions to put on a programme of events for clients to enjoy.   All in all a great place to stay for a short break or a longer relaxing holiday.  The simplicity of design and pleasant nature of the staff make this a great place to be an the location and views are perfect

reviews.title: A good hotel to use in Dahab
reviews.text: I travelled to Dahab with my friends in Summer 2019 and we stayed in that hotel for about 4 days. The hotel located in front of the sea directly with a private beach and a good big pool for those who would love the pools more than beaches. Located from downtown of the city about 15 minutes walk. very calm and clean and good simple designed hotel.My experience about 6 out of 10 and I may stay there again when I visit Dahab.

reviews.title: Nice and quite
reviews.text: really nice facility that is beach front, small but comfort rooms with the needed facilities when we are comparing to other at DAHABthe stuff is friendly and nice, and the location of the hotel is beside dahab downtown (walking distance).the price is good comparing to other facilities offering the same experience.

reviews.title: Comfort and simple
reviews.text: Great viewClean rooms Private bathroomsFriendly peopleTasty breakfast Great value Very close to everythingJust 2 problems: The pool wasn't very cleanThe beach (like most of dahab hotels) was very rocky

reviews.title: Very good just needs some maintenance
reviews.text: Hotel location is very good as it is close to shopping area (15 mins walk) and cafe area too. Rooms area is very good relatively to the hotel nature.Rooms are clean No towels Room service does not visit your room daily! Doors are not working, so you may not e able to lock the door whenever you are out. AC is very good.

reviews.title: Beautiful view, great staff, clean and comfortable
reviews.text: We stayed here for 3 nights and enjoyed it thoroughly. So quiet and beautiful, The staff is incredibly sweet and helpful, My room was bright, spacious and clean and was perfect for my requirements. i will be back.

reviews.title: Excellent place
reviews.text: Very simple and clean place,  suitable for youth and couples. Staff there are so helpful,  specially Mr. Mohamed Magdy. Location of the hotel is very near from everything. View of sea in the hotel is so magical. This will be my only choice every time.

reviews.title: All rounder, kind of not bad for the price
reviews.text: Good value for tje money. The hotel is clean although the rooms in the ground floor are a bit smelly. The breakfast is very basic. No activities or animation team in the hotel. The private beach very basic thing.

reviews.title: A peaceful and beautiful hotel
reviews.text: My son and I stayed in Sukoon for 5 days and enjoyed our stay very much. The hotel is very pleasent, very clean and, although in a central location, very peaceful. Additionaly, Sukoon is also very beautiful. The hotel owner, Rami, and Sdaam, who works in the hotel are very nice and helpful (recomendations re resturants, arranging transport etc').Therefore, I highly recomend staying in Sukoon.

reviews.title: Awesome place
reviews.text: Very nice place to stay Toilets & rooms are very cleanThe plce Near to everythingIt's in the center but in a quite areaRami is very nice host, he and the team are awesomeHighly recommended to stay in.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem!
reviews.text: I've stayed in Sukoon four times now and wouldn't stay anywhere else in Dahab! It's one of the main reasons that my friends and I love visiting Dahab.The location is perfect: close to countless cosy cafe's, just a two minute dash to a beautiful swimming spot, and yet tucked away in a quiet spot amongst the palm trees.The team at Sukoon are super friendly and helpful, and have helped us to organise some incredible trips around Dahab.It's always sad to say goodbye to Sukoon, but I'm sure we'll be back again in the near future!

reviews.title: A peaceful paradise in Dahab.
reviews.text: Sukoon is an amazing place in the center of Dahab with beautiful minded people, amazing breakfast, cozy decor, nice and comfy rooms and a very unique atmosphere. It represents peace and beauty for me and I would love come back !

reviews.title: Lovely place
reviews.text: Great place overall!Excellent location, quiet place but very close to downtown and the markets. Very helpful and friendly staff. Definitely going back and recommending it to others.rooms are clean and breakfast is really good

reviews.title: Little Oasis in the middle of Dahab
reviews.text: It was really difficult to say goodbye to Sukoon, this welcoming place...for me it was definitely one if the nicest places in Dahab.Everybody who comes to Dahab and wants just to drop out of rush and hussels of the daily live, will find good vibes and an surrounding which has been realised with lots of love and a good feeling for lots of details which just can make people feeling better...you will get a delicious breakfast every day and can even make Yoga on the roof ;-) a little oasis in Dahab near to the centre and the beach but nevertheless quiet and not crowded.

reviews.title: Simply...AMAZING!
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I spent almost a week at Sukoon guest house, and it was phenomenal!!. Ramy, the host, was very friendly and specific about the details of the place. Booking was fairly easy and straightforward and he even arranged a pick up for us from Sharm el Sheikh airport. Upon arrival, we had a very warm welcome, were given a quick tour around the place. The place is eco-friendly and there’s a place for food waste (compost) as well. The rooms are simple and very comfortable with a unique design and lots of sunlight. The guest house is designed for travellers, so if you are thinking of a 5 star service, this place is not for you! This is a place for people who seek simplicity, peace , and quiet! Ramy also has lots of contacts in Dahab and was able to put us in touch with different places to do different activities (diving, safari, snorkelling, etc.). All his recommendations were excellent and we didn’t have any trouble at all! The location is ideal; it’s right on the strip where all the restaurants are, we didn’t need to take a cab anytime during our stay.We had such a wonderful time and were sad to leave :( (we even extended our stay 1 extra night) we will definitely be back!

tripadvisor.streetAddress: El Masbat, Peace Road, Dahab 46617 Egypt

reviews.title: Fab location with great views
reviews.text: The apartments are beautifully decorated with fantastic sea views from the roof terrace. The hammocks are perfect for relaxing and reading in when you're not swimming or diving. It's only a 5 minute walk to the beach and a short walk to shops and restaurants. All in all a wonderful place to stay!

reviews.title: Great Location + Roof Terrace
reviews.text: Great Location - 5 minute walk to the beach and 10-15 to the centre with restaurants etc. Communication was easy, Tim always responded quickly to any questions we had. The Roof terrace was an added bonus. Would definitely recommend to anyone visiting Dahab!

reviews.title: amazing stay!
reviews.text: We fell in love with this place! Thanks to the amazing staff members for making us feel at home! We totally recommend it and we will definitely go back there on our next trip to Dahab! Make sure you go diving!

reviews.title: Relaxing and diving
reviews.text: The appartment is really cosy and offers space for 2-4 people. The roof top terrace has a great see view. All necessary things are in the kitchen. We've spent really relaxing days in Dahab - swimming, diving, reading...

reviews.title: Sea stars apartment
reviews.text: If you want a luxurious, relaxing, clean, comfortable place, then this will defently will be ur choice. Amazing view, calm area, 1 min to the sea, 10 to 15 min walking to the light house and the mamsha of dahab. Price are very reasonable, our group also took the diving course, so the price was more interesting. Just check and confirm the rates with the owner to avoid any confusion, as the rates are in Euro and often the payment is LE. I recommend it for all.Cheers.

reviews.title: WOW, WOW, WOW! Lush and very lovely!
reviews.text: Sea Stars Apartments were absolutely perfect in every way. Truly! Great location with a delightful sea view. Roof top for tanning and a wonderful sea breeze. Cute personal balconies and a garden area for chilling. Fridge was even stocked up for us upon arrival. We were very well looked after by Tim and Abdul, speakers provided for our tunes right away and children's toys provided for the kids. Perfect for all, couples, groups and families with children too. Nicely laid out, comfy beds, stylish interior decor with Dahab feel. We would definitely stay there again and highly recommend for long term and short term stays. Do it, book it and of course, enjoy!...

reviews.title: Great location with great hosts!
reviews.text: Me and my partner stayed at Sea Stars Apartments for our holiday to Dahab.the location was great just a short walk to the Eel Gardens, restaurants and bars.The room was Great and the hosts super friendly and helpful.The fridge even had cold beers, milk, eggs and cheese as a welcome pack, which was handy as we didn't have to spend our first day shopping to stock the fridge.Abdul the boab was always super helpful.Id recommend Sea Stars to anybody looking for a quality apartment in a great location.

reviews.title: Very friendly, perfect service
reviews.text: Eventhough my flight arrived after midnight with a delay, Tim managed that someone picked me up and drive me for around 20 EUR (not really sure about the right price) safe during more than an hour from sharm-el-sheik to the apartment in dahab; and the same when i went back home.The flats are clean, Tim is when problems arises (like how can I get delivered some delicious food to the apartment the at 10 o'clock) always friendly and extreamly helpul! So the price/service ratio is definetely excellent!! So it's a question of time, when I will go there for a next time:)I was there with friends but I would also recommend it for a family, because children can play outside without problems because of a big wall around the apartments.

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: Beautifully appointed apartment, really clean, comfortable and relaxing.  Really appreciated the mosquito nets on the windows which meant we could have the windows open and not worry about the insects. Loved the location a little out of the main tourist area, with 'real life' all around in the form of goats wandering the streets, local shops and lovely people.  Tim the owner was on hand and was really kind and helpful.  The roof terrace was awesome with its canopy and cushions where we relaxed gazing out over the sea on one side and the mountains on the other. Books and backgammon were provided.  Simply loved Dahab and our holiday at Sea Stars, thank you, we hope to return!

reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.text: Second time staying here and it was lovely! The apartment is bright, modern and spotlessly clean and the little welcome package was greatly appreciated after a late arrival. Thanks to Tim and his team for everything. This accommodation comes recommended and I will definitely stay there again.

tripadvisor.streetAddress: Sharia El Melal Assala, Dahab SS1 7DH Egypt

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: Website prices are wrong. When I arrived I was told the most affordable room was 300 LE.The front desk staff was sleeping when I arrived at 3pm. When I showed him the prices online the internet was very slow.

reviews.title: Unfriendly staff
reviews.text: The staff are very unprofessional and unfriendly at all, they waited for me to get outside my room to close the AC from the outside everyday Though it is not a bad place to spend a night or two because it is not far from everything

reviews.title: At the end: Very unfriendly staff
reviews.text: Good location Sometimes helpful.Most of the time: very aggressive and unfriendly.Very bad treatment specially at the departure. The room very poor and very bad designed.Only one lamp working at the room, the 2 others not working, while asking to fix it, they ignored it. One of the stuff was really tuff and rude and screaming at my face, and kick us out just as we asked to put our luggages at the reception. Very bad and rude attitude. You can have other hotels around this camp but with good stuff well educated and Friendly one.

reviews.title: For a night in Dahab 👌🏻
reviews.text: We were there for one night and they charged us 400 egp for it, We didn't have TP in the toilet and it was not that clean.   But the guy working there was nice and smily.  So all good overallIts right in the center near the beach of Dahab and the market.

reviews.title: Miramar Camp
reviews.text: We stayed there for 5 days, it's in a Super good location, almost in the center of everything, the rooms is not luxurious but that's what dahab is all about, ragheb the owner is very friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.text: The camp is really very clean and safe and ghanem the owner is a very friendly person and very helpful i love it in the center of dahab markets u have everything outside from alcohol shops and others a foot step away

reviews.title: Relaxation
reviews.text: i stayed there on my own for 5 days ,the camp is clean , Calm and secured , location is near by Ghazala Market , i enjoyed my stay there with a perfect budget.they have a cool garden with seats , also you have your own table with two chairs in front of your room (Check pic)

reviews.title: Miramar excellent in Dahab
reviews.text: Dahab is a great place to visit in the Sinai.  Western tourists are often ripped off in many Middle Eastern sites; but not Dahab.  Maybe its appeal rests with Egyptian travelers more so than westerners since visitors come from Cairo.  Anyway, it is a rare town that businsses don't double the prices on westerners when they walk in the door.  Dahab is great as most businesses treat everybody the same without discrimination to westeners.  Miramar in Dahab was the absolute best in price for good, clean accomodations.

reviews.title: One week in Heaven
reviews.text: One of the best camps in dahabIts very cheap and very cleanExactly in downtownU can enjoy ur day in the camp sitting in sunlight enjoying the green viewWith very nice services like TV , Fee Wifi and hot and cold waterIf u r planning to visit dahab u must stay in miramar

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: The most beautiful place in the morning is Al Jazeera, a great place to unwind, relax and separate from the world.. The owner of the restaurant is respectful and friendly and the welcome is great for everyone, the wine level and service is high for quiet lovers ..the atmosphere by the sea is elegant and beautiful, the elevator is large and for many people

reviews.title: A nice café/hotel on the waterfront
reviews.text: The receptionist, Tito, organized a trip to Mount Sinai for us after eating breakfast. The trip was amazing with the best tour guide that we encountered on the hike. Upon return to Dahab, Tito was also nice enough to organize a taxi ride to Sharm El Sheikh airport. Although we didn't stay here, Tito showed us accommodations. They were very clean with a stellar view of the Red Sea. If we were to stay longer in Dahab, we would've booked a couple nights. The restaurant has beautiful scenery, delicious breakfast and the absolute BEST Turkish coffee I had in all of Sinai and Jordan!

reviews.title: All you need!
reviews.text: I had a really nice 2.5 week stay in the Jasmin Hotel! What I loved most about the hotel and restaurant is the staff. Very friendly and helpful, always! I stayed in one of the rooms with seaview, and I loved the view! The room has all you need; it was cleaned every few days, AC worked well, clean towels etc. Furthermore, the food in the restaurant is really good, and I loved my breakfast every morning. It was freshly cooked and they make it exactly how you like it. If you're looking for an affordable place with seaview, delicious food and nice staff, this is your place!

reviews.title: Day trips and safaris to avoid by all means!!
reviews.text: We came to know the Jasmine pension through our search for a trip to the Coloured Canyon. We met Tito who works there and who promised us a trip there full of good surprises with a group of people that have already signed in. We paid 500EGP each in advance as requested (the trip was planned for two days later) but, of course, the following day we received a WhatsApp message from him with a funny excuse: "the trip is cancelled because of the hot wheather and the police wouldn't let us through." It was planned to be 38°, as pretty much every day in Dahab at this time of the year. But hey, he promised us that the trip would take place another two days later. And again, the following day, we received message saying that the trip is cancelled...because he actually didn't have enough people.So we had to go back to the Jasmine hotel to get our money back. We were angry because Tito actually lied to us and he sent us the messages late in the evening so we couldn't even plan another trip. As Tito kept searching for excuses, he get me angry and I throw my bag of leftover food on the floor. At this moment another man (probably the manager), older and taller, came to us and grabbed my boyfriend by the neck and tried to kick him and kept coming at us and threatening us physically.

reviews.title: Amazing holiday in jasmine
reviews.text: We are second time to jasmine palace and still lovely place and enjoyed the pool with the anination team and ramadan was lovely on the pool help us with the Towels and clean the pool and evening show was so nice

reviews.title: Wonderful, as usual!
reviews.text: I stayed there many times and every single visit is a souvenir for me. A perfect one actually. Rooms are affordable, the view is stunning, position is perfect and the food delicious. Cant ask for more. Tito is an unbelievable manager and can organize any trip around you ask for (desert, canyons, ATV, Motocross, bedouin camps, etc. You just have to stop by when you visit Egypt, its a must!

reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text: I stayed an amazing 5 consecutive days at this place and I really had relaxing time, the view and the service are just perfect.It's so relaxing out there and the breakfast was tasty The crew was friendlyHIGHLY RECOMMENDED ❤️

reviews.title: Sweet hangout
reviews.text: Hello , we just had a very good stay.Tito and his staff were welcoming , good natured , willing to help with travel arrangements and room amenities.Away from the main area of the tourist zone but only a 5 minutes stroll away.Easy access out the back door and cheaper locals restaurants , grocery store and services ie ATM and pharmacy.Good food and prices in the restaurant as well with great beach location for hanging out. Evening firepit on request with shiesha!We would book again, good value for the room and breakfast.Enjoy.

reviews.title: Diving trip in Dahab
reviews.text: Well the hotel or pension the view is almost the best price is good cleaning is ok, if you look for nice view so close to the see for relaxing maybe yoga i suggest here, also staff are so polite and friendlyThanks Tito and Ahmed hk and Ahmed of service

reviews.title: My new favorite cafe/restaurant
reviews.text: This place is awesome. After long days of diving, we always looked forward to going to this place for drinks and shisha. You could not ask for a more relaxing place. The staff are super friendly and are great with kids. Sometimes you’ll even be joined by puppies and  cats. Plus, you can’t beat the view. Highly recommended and see you again in a few weeks!

reviews.title: Not recommended
reviews.text: Pros: stable & speedy wi fi connection, budget friendly, cozy, good AC, minibar, location is amazing close to old market area, comfortable beds, wardrobeCons: bed sheets and linen need some care, walls should be painted, rust everywhere in bathroomGeneral tip: invest alittle bit more bucks and you get a better deal somewhere else "did that"

reviews.title: Nice Staff and easy going place
reviews.text: The staff were really nice and helpful. It was great value for money. I enjoyed my stay at Cuba Auski. My tips for helping them to improve would be to keep the shared bathroom facilities a little cleaner.

reviews.title: Very kind and friendly Crew
reviews.text: Unfortunately i didn't stay at the camp because it was fully booked but the staff was very kind to offer me to stay in the plaza and rest from the road , i didn't try the camp but i highly recommend to stay if you looking for something on budget and friendly environment.

reviews.title: Excellent and cheap place to stay in Dahab!
reviews.text: I absolutely LOVED staying at Auski Camp in Dahab. The place has a new owner since around half a year, who improved the place a lot and made this one of the very best options to stay in Dahab! The whole resort is beautifully designed in blue and white, has a perfect sitting area in the middle, and cozy rooms meeting everyone‘s needs. There are basic rooms for an unbeatable price (I couldn’t find any cheaper place to stay in the whole time), rooms with AC, group rooms- whatever you need. The toilets are in a good condition and there is hot water 24/7.The best thing about Auski Camp is the amazing location. You‘re literally in the middle of Mashraba, and you have all the cheap good restaurants of Dahab just one walking minute away. Just outside, you find many shops, a liquor store, taxis, everything you need. I would say that you can’t find a better location in Dahab.Then, finally, the owner Karim and his worker, Mahmoud, are extremely kind and helpful people, who quickly became friends.If you‘re searching for an amazing cheap place (also for long-term!), this is it!

reviews.title: What an aweful sh*thole!
reviews.text: I usually do not write reviwes, but that experience was so bad, I just have to!I don´t even know where to start as we are still so perplexed by this extraordinarily bad experience!Before the travel:We were travelling with our dog, so we specifically looked for places that would allow a dog. Cuba Auski advertises on the internet with being pet friendly. Due to bad experiences before we still contacted them before booking, specifically mentioning the dog and asking for a good WiFi connection, as we had to do some work there. They said both was fine, so we booked a room with private bathroom, as we are not to keen on sharing bathrooms.A day before the trip I contacted the host to get a mobile number in case anything would go wrong. First thing I got was a text stating "We have no room with private bathroom available". After making very clear that we booked a private bathroom and expect one, the host eventually confirmed that we would get one.Checki-In:When we arrived, we were not put in a room in the Cuba Auski but in a neighbouring camp, which was fine with us, because it actually looked cleaner. Upon arrival they already informed us that we would only stay one day in this room and would have to move again, which we did not like to much but agreed to. However, suddenly our dog was a problem. She was not allowed in that room and they suggested she could just stay outside... with no fences at all and easy access to the street. What?! Of course we did not at all agree. As they did not offer any solution, we demanded our money back and wanted to search for another place. The host tried to trick us into cancelling the reservation on Airbnb, which due to the hosts chosen policy would have left us with no money at all (we had made exactly this experience before in Dahab!). He did not agree to repay usin cash. So they left us hanging there for a while until they managed to give us a room in the Cuba Auski Camp, which was not the room we booked. We figured out in the end that the host probably overbooked his place, asked a neighbouring host for help but did not mention the dog, which turned into a problem. He finally moved someone else out of Cuba Auski so we could get the room there. It seems not to be the first time the host overbooked, reading the reviews here.The room:Unfortunately, the host did not take the time to clean the room (not that it would have helped a lot). The sheets were fresh, but that was about it. The room was crammed with three beds and barely enough space to even walk to the bathroom. The floor was not cleaned. There was only a single socket for a three-people-place! Not even enough to recharge everyones phone and for sure not enough to also work a little. The "Workspace" described in the amenities was not there (btw also no towels, toilet paper or soap, as state in the amenities). However, as there was also no functionable WiFi in the room (despite us asking before booking!), working would have been not possible anyways. The bathroom was beyond disgusting! Not only was it NOT cleaned and all the amatures where super rusty, but it also stank terribly. Unfortunately it was also not possible to close the bathroom door so the whole place stank like manure. B.t.w. there was also no handle on the front door, so when it fell shut we had to get help from outside to even leave the room.Conclusion:We hated every second there and moved out the next day, even without getting our money back. Please, even if you are financially tight, think about whether what you might save is really worth what you might get there! We ended up in Crazy Camel Camp which was amazing (!) and only few dollars more expensive per night and so worth it. Because, what good is a holiday if you hate being there?

reviews.title: TERRIBLE CAMP
reviews.text: THIEFS! HIGH ON DRUGS ALL DAY! NEVER STAY THERE.1) I paid two nights upfront to confirm my reservation, owner called on checking in morning to convince me to get a bed in another hostel as the hotel is OVERBOOKED! I refused and got my room after a fight over the phone.2) Hygiene is terrible. Bathrooms are unclean with a horrible smell all day.3) On checking out day, I agreed with the owner to leave my luggage till night. When returning back at 7 PM, he requested a 100 EGP as a cost of a one night stay at a room with a fan! NEVER NEVER NEVER STAY THERE.

reviews.title: Very good for budget travelers
reviews.text: its very good cozy and friendly place its near to everything in dahab its almost in the center of the city also they organize night parties you will have fun with them for sure but the only bad thing that it doesn't have an private area on sea.

reviews.title: One of the best in Dahab!
reviews.text: The Auski camp has a great location, right at the begining of the main pedestrian street. it has it's own restaurant with perfect sea views. The service in general is great. The AC in our room wasn't working, we told the room service about it. They tried to fix it, but couldn't manage to do it before our check-out dates, so they gave us the price of one night back. The restaurant is great and offers food with great quality.

reviews.title: Budget Camp
reviews.text: It's a great place if you don't want to pay for more than $15 per night for a double-bed room. The camp is in "Al Mashraba" place, and its in the middle of the market. You have an easy access to nearby restaurants, groceries, and bazars.They have an outdoor arabian sitting area which overlooks the sea, and the prices of the drinks are very cheap.The guys there can help you organize any activity you'd like to do.I highly recommend it to you if you don't want to spend most of your money on a place you only use it for sleeping.

reviews.title: A long time favourite of travellers
reviews.text: Auski camp has been in Dahab for many years and if the palms could talk I'm sure they would have some great stories to share. It is well located and the rooms are cheap and clean. Good for those wanting to stay a long time and really enjoy the dahab vibe. The main sitting area is where I have met some of my closest friends from all parts of the world- a travellers haven! The owner and staff are always willing to help out and organise trips/diving-you name it!

reviews.title: What happened to the Eel Garden Area in the last 1½ years?
reviews.text: Not sure what happened to that place / area but it's definitely NOT positive.The once calm and peaceful atmosphere has been replaced by a loud and rather aggressive vibe. Unfortunately, the “dog issue” appears to have gotten completely out of hand — continuous barking around the clock, dogs chasing or even attacking cyclists and joggers, and dog waste all over the place. The parties that suddenly take place here don’t make things any better — they simply don’t fit the Dahab spirit at all. Perhaps it’s due to the changing type of visitors, their nationalities or cultural habits? What used to be our favorite part of Dahab has now become an area we prefer to avoid. And we’re clearly not the only ones who feel this way...We truly hope that the “dog issue” can be solved and that Eel Garden will return to the peaceful place it once was — free of parties and the current “mass tourism” vibe, and back to what makes Dahab so special: its serenity, thoughtfulness, and distinctive character.

reviews.title: Best view in Dahab
reviews.text: I love the view , the room was good , the staff was so helpful and the rooftop view is the best in Dahab. The place in the middle of everything you need . The breakfast was ok before going to a trip in the morning.

reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.text: Triple Room was a decent size. Typically Overpriced tho. Breakfast was nice. Great rooftop view. Good place to go with friends. Live music at night. Restaurant was subpar. Used fake crab. Shouldn’t do that in a coastal town with an abundance of seafood.

reviews.title: Best Hotel in Dahab
reviews.text: The hotel has a great location and a great view (5 meters away from the sea shore), rooms are very clean, the owner is very friendly and very helpful. Also the restaurant of the hotel serves super delicious dishes of all types. I always stay there whenever I'm in Dahab.

reviews.title: Very friendly and helpful
reviews.text: The owner is so friendly and helpful the place is quite cheap not so clean but it was clean enough to fully enjoy my time there,almost in the middle of everywhere , good view from the window in couple rooms as well and the roof is beautiful if they only give it a bit more care tho

reviews.title: Little Gem
reviews.text: Didn't stay at the hotel but had a meal in the beachside restaurant. Lovely food , very good prices and excellent service.The restaurant is new and and is very clean . It's just over the bridge and has wonderful views of the bay.£7 for both of us which included a couple of drinks too !

reviews.title: Bamboo House Restaurant
reviews.text: I just returned from a trip to Dahab. I didn't stay at the Bamboo House Hotel, but I ate dinner in the restaurant several times. Wonderful food...wonderful selection...wonderful service...wonderful prices...wonderful view!

reviews.title: A perfect and enjoyable hotel, especially for children.
reviews.text: Staying at Carmina Hotel was truly an unforgettable experience. A hotel that perfectly reflects the calm and peaceful atmosphere of Dahab. The rooms were very clean and tidy, every detail had been carefully considered.The hotel staff were extremely helpful and friendly, ready to assist with anything. We felt like family, not just customers. Thanks to its proximity to the sea and central location, we were able to easily get everywhere. I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone looking to relax and have a good time.

reviews.title: Rooms Run Down
reviews.text: We came here to dive at the Blue Hole. Our stay was 4 Nights and the room we had was terrible. Musty smelling, light fixtures were dangerously wired. Water heater in bathroom had to be plugged in and wires on plug were coming apart. Light fixtures above our beds were haphazardly wired. Beds were uncomfortable. Food was not great and service terribly slow. Food was much better down the street at some of the various restaurants. A bunch more fun also, getting to barter with the local people. Would not stay here again.

reviews.title: Not that bad
reviews.text: The hotel is good , as it location from the "el mamsha el seya7y" (the touristique terrace) only and the view of the sunrise from the beach , but the staff isnt that good , the rooms dont get clean and not changing the towels, most of the room doors dont lock , the wifi isnt working even they have too many routers with different passwords

reviews.title: awful staff awful hotel
reviews.text: the hotel as a building seems good. but the stuff are very bad . the hotel receptionist and his assistant is talking about the guest with impolite way and they are the ugly face for the hotel with their way for orientation about the hotel . some of the rooms has a very old furniture coated with corrosion on the tables metal . stay away from this awful staff  to have a nice trip

reviews.title: Great staff and location
reviews.text: We stayed a week here after 2 weeks traveling around other parts of Egypt with our family.  It was a perfect location away from the main 'hub' of town,  but only a few minutes walk from everything you need. The 'Residence' side of Christinas is a bit run down, but our family room was spacious and clean. Breakfasts at the main hotel were excellent, my children looked forward to them each morning. We ate dinner at the hotel restaurant a few times which was also delicious and good value. There's so much to do in Dahab with older children (snorkeling, sand boarding, camel riding, canyoning), and prices were very reasonable  (coming to Egypt with $US). Highly recommend for families if you need good value for money in a small and friendly beach town.

reviews.title: Great restaurant!
reviews.text: Been here a few times for lunch & once for breakfast. Ordered Calamari, Steak with Butter and the Egyptian breakfast. All were very good. Since there's not a lot of tourist nowadays in Dahab, you need to go to the reception area and ask for the waiter so they can serve you. The breakfast was around 40 Egyptian pounds, Steak was 75 EGP and the calamari was 65 EGP. They also serve alcohol. I'm rating the restaurant and not the hotel.

reviews.title: Greatest place and stuff
reviews.text: Greatest hotel i had vieseted Nice room,restaurant,pool and beach When you need a rest from life pressure you have to visit christina hotel it's so calm placeSpecial thnx for Mr. MahmoudI will come back soooooooooonMy mail: zorro2050@hotmail.com

reviews.title: Nice hotel in clam but central location
reviews.text: Nice location very close to all shopping and food facilities. Friendly front desk (Mr. Mahmoud). Simple but good breakfast on their open air terrace. Everything so nearby. Natural small beach. Needs neopren shoes, but really nice.

reviews.title: Great Hotel with great staff
reviews.text: I stayed at christina hotel Dahab earlier this year, my first trip to Dahab.So happy with this great hotel, with such good value for money, with comfortable rooms, perfect beds ( firm and supporting but not hard ) and no nighttime noise so great sleep quality. Room attended when required. The hotel pooli is ideal size - for just dips or doing laps for fitness. The hotel food is great and very flexible to meet your food requirements. By no means least I should praise the great staff, always helpful and friendly and willing to help and advise any request. I was combining a holiday with post operation re hab after knee surgery with an extended stay over a number of weeks- the price reducing the longer the stay - just call the manager to discuss this as you plan your holiday and budget. Everything you need for your holiday is close by. So please support the local people and choose Christina hotel with confidence.

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: We always stay at Christina Residence when in Dahab. Across the road from the main hotel it is reasonably priced but gives you access to luxuries like a pool and good breakfast. Would always recommend the place. Although basic the rooms are clean and of a good size.

reviews.title: Budget Price, but VERY NICE!
reviews.text: First off, there are 3 separate types of rooms at the Christina: the Residence, the Pool and the Beach Palace. My review is for the Pool rooms only. Based on the website, these rooms are all different with different fee structures. Christina Pool is right in the middle. I would definitely call this a budget price but not a budget feel. I'm a foreigner (American teacher in Cairo) but I reside in Egypt, so I inquired about a different rate and I got it!  Yay for me! The room is quite large for a single, though my bed is a double. The bathroom is also large with a nice sized vanity area. There is adequate room for clothes, and all your personal belongings. Oh and there are lots of outlets to charge up all your electronic gear and gizmos. The room does not have a tv, but do you really need one?  But there is a small fridge for soda, juices, yogurt, etc. And the wifi in the room is free and fast! It always amazes me how upscale, luxury hotels always charge for wifi. My room had a pool view, and is on the first floor (I'm used to thinking second floor).  There is a breakfast buffet included...it's simple, but I don't need a big breakfast: rolls, croissants, fresh fruit salad, eggs, and a few other dishes. There was also fresh, cold karkada (hibiscus tea)...it's sweet, and cold and yummy. Since this is budget, please note to bring your own shower necessities. A small soap and shampoo packets were provided. If you don't bring any, no worries, there are enough pharmacies and markets to get what you need, just steps out of the hotel. Also, no hairdryer in room. While there is a safe in the room, it's not large enough to stash electronics.  There was also no hot water kettle or a few packets of tea or Nescafe. This isn't a huge deal breaker though. The bed and bedding might be the ONLY negative. But it wasn't a bother to me, I just thought I'd better share this. The bed is firm, again, not a problem for me. The sheets, while clean, were a little rough, though the pillow cases felt nice and cool. Speaking of cool, the room has a/c which is a BIG PLUS!  Some type of mattress pad between sheet and mattress would have been nice, but still not a big problem. I just thought it would be best to post the particulars. The location is excellent. If you leave the grounds by the pool area, this will take you to the beach and along the Corniche which has countless shops and restaurants. If you leave by the lobby, this is really the village side parallel to the Corniche. This side will also take you to the souk/marketplace and loops right back to the sea side. It's lively and colorful and yes, the business owners want your money. Tourism is down. Just be polite, say "no thank you," or "later" and walk on. They do take it quite well...but they will also remember you!The staff at the Christina are warm, and helpful as well without being ingratiating. Dahab is my favorite place in Egypt. I've been to two hotels in Dahab and the Christina is by far my favorite of the two.

reviews.title: simple, friendly, city center, comfortable rooms
reviews.text: week end trip with friends.  We were seeking a place with comforable rooms yet affordable price and we found that here. As a foreigner ... only cold shower can be a drawback sometimes but if you are ok with it then why not :-)Swimming pool is indoor and dark so dont expect to do sunbathing here.Shopping mall just 50 meters away

reviews.title: Avoid this place - the staff go all out to rip you off
reviews.text: My daughter stayed at Sea and C while my wife and I stayed at Dahab Paradise (highly recommended - see separate review).From the moment we checked in - when they challenged the price for the booking even though I had a printout of their emailed confirmation of the price - I got the feeling that Sea and C staff were going all out to rip us off.  The cocktails we had were poorly made, weak and nearly 3 times the price we paid in the centre of Dahab.  The evening meal we had there on our daughter's first night was badly cooked and outrageously expensive.  We tried to ask the price and they (the waiter's name was Ahmed) refused to tell us then said it would be nearly 700 egyptian pounds for fish for 3 people!  This is well over double the price at Shark where the food, atmosphere and service are far superior.  We eventually agreed to pay less (but still far too much) and even then he tried to add 12% for 'tax and service'.  As if there was any service...I strongly advise against Sea and C.  Don't be tempted by apparent low prices - they'll try to rip more money out of you some how some way. .

reviews.title: escaping Christmas in Dahab
reviews.text: Dahab is a great place for snorkelling, diving and also rock climbing, which is most important to me. The hotel is small and situated outside of the town center so it was really peaceful. There is a private beach where one can lay in the sun, snorkel right from the hotel doorstep or have a dinner.

reviews.title: Nice suite, good location, very good host
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I had a wonderful week at "the Castle", but it was not the main building. It is called "Villa 22" and it also belongs to Ali, who was a very helpful and nice host. Everything was clean and the suite has enough space to work with two notebooks.All in all I highly recommend this place and the people working here and it has a very good priceperformance. I will definitely come again if I will go to Dahab.Thank you very much for everything Ali!KRMaria & Stephan

reviews.title: Very friendly owner and beautiful comfy rooms
reviews.text: We stayed at the Castle 2, it’s 200m from the Castle. Very beautiful new building, has amazing rooftop. We had a room with queen bed, kitchen and bathroom. It was new clean and comfortable. Mr Ali is very friendly and helpful, he helped us with taxi and our luggage. And it was just nice to have a small talk with him. This made our stay in Dahab very comfortable and relaxing. Totally recommend. Thank you!

reviews.title: Fantastic place with a resnable price
reviews.text: I have stayed in The Castle for one week and I highly recommend the place. Its very clean, quite and well furnished with air-condition. And the price is resnable. All the Appreciation to Mr. Ali and his staff.

reviews.title: Quiet Comfort
reviews.text: The Castle is located in a secluded and quiet area that is a walking distance from the main street. Staff is really friendly and helpful. Room amenities exceeded expectations (fridge, stove, hot water, TV). Rooms are really spacious for big groups.

reviews.title: Worst dahab trip

The toilets don’t flush, the lights don’t work in two rooms and the whole apartment has 2 lightbulbs. Four people used one shower. Since the other shower doesn’t work. reviews.title: Dahab is such a beautiful place
reviews.text: I absolutely love Dahab, and this was my 4th visit. I never tayed in this house before and it was a good option. My friends found this place becaus with 5 persons it is cheaper as hotel and also much more fun.

reviews.text: Good apartment for if you like to have more freedom than in a hotel. We had a great time. It is only couple of nutes to the beach and we were able to arrange breakfast included in one of the beach restaurants.

Of course you have no breakfast included but the shopping street el mamsha is 5 minutes walk and has all the local restaurants where you can buy sandwich falafel and king chicken and a local bakery and other stuff

reviews.title: A standard apartment for groups on a perfect location
reviews.text: I stayed with friends and we were looking for something close to town. We didnt want to stay in a hotel so this was a great solution. The beds were comfortable, There was a fridge and a cooker so we had everything we neen

reviews.title: Good house for group of friends
reviews.text: It is actually cheaper to rent this apartment with  a group than staying in a hotel. It is couple of minutes from the beach and around there are plenty of restaurants for breakfast or food. It is nice to have your own space and your own little kitchen to hang out

reviews.title: apartments on the boulevard
reviews.text: This apartment is great for when you are with your friends or family and you just dont want to stay in a hotel. It i only a couple of meters from the beach ( sec. row) so the best location you cn ask for. The apt has everything you need.

reviews.title: Good value for money

Dahab is a beautiful place and I hope we can come back. I will definitely book an apartment in 3D house again!

reviews.title: THE WORST PLACE EVER

reviews.title: Best Hotel in Dahab!

reviews.title: Best place to stay in at Dahab
reviews.text: People there are really nice, not just friendly but also pure with beautiful souls, I wish I had more time to know them more, quality people!The place is very clean, rooms are very very cozy. I loved the private beach, the relaxing music there!..everything! every little detail!....  from now on this is my spot in Dahab!

reviews.title: Do not go here !
reviews.text: This was honestly one of the worst accommodation experiences we have ever had. The place felt abandoned — almost no one was there, the location was terrible, and from the moment we arrived, we wanted to leave.The bathroom had a strong sewage smell, and there was absolutely no soap, body wash, or shampoo in the room. We asked several times and only after repeated complaints did they finally bring us hand soap and tiny shampoo samples. When we asked for body wash, we were simply told they didn’t have any.There was no drinking water in the room, and when we asked for water, we were told we had to pay for it. There were also missing towels, and we had to ask and wait until they were finally provided. The air conditioning barely worked.The reception was basically empty except during the morning hours, and the breakfast was extremely basic.What shocked us most was the checkout. We were charged for water and even simple black coffee that we had with breakfast. We booked a stay that included breakfast, yet they told us that coffee and water were not included. Charging separately for basic coffee and water alongside an included breakfast was unbelievable.Even worse, several times during our stay they claimed that we had not paid for the reservation and asked us to pay again, even though we had already paid through Booking.com. This happened repeatedly from the moment we arrived until we finally had to show them the charge from our bank account to prove that payment had already been made.Overall, the experience was extremely disappointing. Poor service, bad location, unpleasant room conditions, missing basic amenities, barely functioning air conditioning, and repeated issues regarding payment.

reviews.title: Good price, but you have to make some deductions.
reviews.text: Basically, the price: We paid around 30 euros per night. The apartment is for 4 people; that means you pay less than 10 euros per person per night. That's very good. The apartment looks like the photos from the provider and has air conditioning. The pool is well maintained. There are 4 buildings with two apartments each, arranged around an inner courtyard with a pool. You can't hear the street next door. Mahmoud, who looked after the apartments (as something like a caretaker?), really tried hard and was always there for us. His very good service is the reason why we didn't leave early (reasons below). Unfortunately, he hardly understands English, so communication was sometimes difficult. Now for the problems: We booked the whole thing through Airbnb; but I should have looked at Booking.com too; given the reviews there, I would have chosen something else. According to the description, the accommodation should have:Bed linen, towels, soap, full kitchen with everything you need, washing machine, refrigerator, air conditioning, TV, check-in from 11:30.When we arrived at around 11 a.m., we had to ask 5 people where we could find the person in charge. There is no reception.We had to wait until after 1 p.m. until the room was ready. The information about the check-in times had apparently not reached them.The floor had been roughly mopped. The sinks and the kitchen countertops too.What was missing:- Towels and bed linen (we were given towels and very holey sheets when we asked in the evening)- Soap (we bought it because it wasn't expensive)- Almost all the dishes and cutlery (the coffee pot was so moldy that we couldn't clean it. We had one knife for three people. When we asked for glasses and cups, we were given two cups and some paper cups)- The TV remote control (we never got it; we couldn't use it)- Empty cupboards. Everything was full of the previous residents' rubbish.- Cleaning the kitchen cupboards: They are so full of dirt that we were very disgusted and didn't use them.- The sofa was full of holes and smelled very smokey.- The washing machine doesn't really wash. You run cold water in it and add detergent and it spins the laundry a bit. Otherwise OK.What worked:There was a refrigerator that worked. The air conditioning worked. The gas stove was OK. WiFi was OK. Mahmoud was very helpful.All in all, we had expected some of this. It's Egypt, after all, and we're students who are used to a lot.There are two reasons why we almost left:1. The ants. The apartment has a massive infestation of Paraoh Ants. They are tiny and get into everything (sealed packages!). On the first day, we had to throw away almost all of our food. Our things were only safe in the fridge. I constantly had ants in my clothes. I often had ants in my bed. They kept biting me at night (painful bites), so I had to spray the bed with insect spray at night. Sleeping with ants in your bed is not fun. 2. The courtyard parties. Every time we thought that a group of young Egyptians had finally left, the next group arrived, playing loud music at 2 a.m., shouting, smoking, jumping into the pool and screaming (and this has nothing to do with any dislike of Egyptians, by the way; a group of men of that age can be like that in any country).Until midnight, it's no big deal. We're all for people having fun. But the walls are so thin that they don't pick up anything. You sleep against the wall facing the courtyard. Even with earplugs, we had no chance of getting to sleep. One group was particularly bad: They partied for a long time for several nights. At the beginning, we were able to reach Mahmoud at around 2 a.m., who then chased them away (none of the landlords live on the premises. If you're unlucky, you won't get any sleep on a night like that).One evening they didn't arrive until around 1 a.m. and partied until after 4 a.m. After several requests to go to the apartment, which were laughed off by the men, I wrote to the landlord that we wanted our money back if things didn't improve. We were there to go diving and it just wasn't fun anymore. Apparently my message had an effect, because the group left the next day. The next groups were sometimes loud, but understanding when asked to be quieter at 2 a.m. In short: a quiet time from midnight onwards would be good for the apartments. It's only an 8-minute walk to Dahab's party mile... BTW: The shop at the entrance to the apartments is great and has fair prices for tourists too. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Very nice experience
