reviews.title: Nice chilled spot with great value for money!
reviews.text: I was very happy to find this place! The vibe is cozy and very welcoming.The managers are chilled and always willing to help. They got you covered with local recommendations for any taste and with trips to attractions close by.Simply a great spot to enjoy Dahab!

reviews.title: Last time in Gargabeta, Sadly
reviews.text: Let me just start by saying that I will probably always have a soft spot for Gargabeta, just because the owners & people there are always so nice and welcoming and it made a great impression on me and my friends when we first stayed there for a night or two in April 2018 (just 4 months after it first opened). However, I think after staying there a second time - it is probably my last.To be fair, we went in Eid so I know it was very busy. But nothing we asked for from staff was followed up on. For example, our room light burned out during our stay and we had to get our own light bulb because we knew it would take too long for any one to help us - if at all.Here are the good and bad things about Gargabeta upon experience.PROS:- Location is great, walking distance from Everyday Cafe, the famous Ghazala market and any bus stations (Go Bus and Blue bus).- Room rate is one of the cheapest you can find in Dahab.- The owners and employees there are such nice and friendly people.- Rooms and beds were clean.- The hotel and rooms are very uniquely styled and colorful.CONS:- The air conditioning (AC) is very weak in the summer.- The rooms that are in the sunny part of the hotel are so hot and were very hard to make cool.- There is absolutely no room service - you have to clean up after yourself and throw out your own trash.- The room lighting is SO weak it's almost blinding.- The hotel staff is rarely ever at the reception.- There are no towels or amenities.- The three-person room we stayed in only had 1 big bed blanket/duvet.- Because of the location, it is quite noisy even early in the morning.- I don't know if there was free wifi because nothing was reaching our room.

reviews.title: Disappointing accommodation, good location
reviews.text: The colorful building is right behind the bus station and 2 minutes away from the market and the sea. The room had no towels and the bed sheets were not clean. We asked the staff for towels and a sheet change a few times, but they were not able to provide them during our 4-day stay. The rooms were not cleaned at all during the stay. There are no mini bars in the room or wifi, however, you can use the fridge in the reception. They also do not provide any bathroom toiletries, the water is very salty and there are no window nets.

reviews.title: We call it home
reviews.text: Gargabeta the name come from south of Egypt which is mean the young beautiful girl, and it’s located in the heart of Dahab which is 2 minutes far away from everyday cafe and the sea as well, and less then 1 minuet to go Bus!

reviews.title: Again, the best place in dahab
reviews.text: Second time but this time we were there for Christmas. Great christmas dinner put on by sammy and rita. Lunas getting big but she rules the roost. This time we only stayed 11 days and then 4 more after israel. Highly recommend. I would and will make reservations in advance. The secrets getting out !!Chris and haleigh

reviews.title: Felt like home
reviews.text: This is one of the best guesthouses we've stayed in, ever. Mohammed and Rita are warm and welcoming, and their chef Ali makes incredible breakfasts. They helped us arrange tours, massages, and even provided breakfast when we had a 3am pickup to go to Petra. Views and atmosphere can't be beat!! We'll definitely be back.

reviews.title: Your new home in Dahab :)
reviews.text: Staying in Amanda Hotel was a great experience, the owners, Rita and Sammy are amazing people, kind, helpful, with a good humour. I really felt at home. The breakfast Ali makes will start your day, it's plentiful, fresh and delicious.The rooms are neat and comfy, the common spaces are super, beautiful exotic flowers everywhere, great for relaxing. Everything is closeby, shops, restaurants, still it has a quiet, calm setting. Right by the hotel the reef is great for snorkeling, stunning coral and marine wildlife, Eel garden is just next doors. On top of all this, they have a lovely, smart, playful puppy, Luna, whose company will always light up your days. Watch out, if you come to Dahab and stay in Amanda, you might find it really hard to leave (your new home and family :) )Thanks for everything guys, definitely see you next time!

reviews.title: Best breakfast.....EVER!!!!!!!
reviews.text: The common story in Dahab is "Come as a guest, leave as a friend" But at Amanda, it's .... come as a guest, leave as family !! Haleigh and Chris came for 3 or 4 days but ended up staying 18! Why? Well Rita (mom), Mohamed, and of course Ali and his amazing breakfasts. We even had Osama for a while and he was a delight. What can you say about this place. Every one we met staying there were repeat visitors as we will be next year too. Their new puppy Luna  was a real treat and we got to watch her grow up. I hope she remembers us next year when we come back.  Its clean and comfortable with delicious food. Great value, great people, great company, but the GREAT overall experience made it wonderful. Give Luna a pat for us!

reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.text: Clean, friendly owners, best value for money compared to at least 10 hotels we visited in the same category. Situated in a calm area on the pedestrian path. Will definitely go there again. The only remark: bungalows are not sound proof.

reviews.title: chillout
reviews.text: this is the most chill out place in Dahab, i loved staying there.. the rooms are a bit old and not so nice, but the owner helps with everything he can ... this is always our first choice when we go to dahab .. also the location is perfect, so close to all the restaurants and supermarkets and it has the perfect weather somehow!

reviews.title: Gorgeous, peaceful, clean and kind retreat in Dahab
reviews.text: I looked at many guesthouses when I arrived in Dahab. I discovered there was a big difference in offerings of guesthouses and hotels in the same price range. Amanda was in a more serene and private part of the tourist area but still within walking distance of the action. The rooms were bright and spacious and airy and the view and sound of the sea on the semi-private beach from my room was the best part. The owner, Said, was friendly and very knowledgeable and helpful. The beachfront lounging area was beautiful and comfortable enough to stay all day and the restaurant actually had healthy meals with a variety of vegetables. The yoga studio was not hosting classes at the time I was there so I got to use the whole space to myself for self-practice. This place is truly wonderful and unquestionably the best value for the money in the area.

Also, the place has a nice pool, swings, good music all day, juices bar and sometimes they make some events like BBQ parties or oriental nights.

reviews.title: Not recommended
reviews.text: The Sayala camp aims to provide for its visitors a place of quietness, relaxation and healthiness. The sea and the scenery provide for that but it's a shame to see that the other basic needs are missing: the toilets were in a deplorable state, the showers (when they did have water) were very dirty, having probably not been washed for weeks, and the food was bland and messy. The staff wasn't flexible at all with our needs and their sense of understanding didn't seem to go further the limits of their own lifestyle.The room's comfort was modest, to say the least, and anything we were asking seemed to be nothing more than a bother for the two owners (having to get off the hamac is tough, I know)I understand that one wishes to live a chilling life (who doesn't?) but I would suggest not to run a camp and a restaurant fully booked with travellers in that case.Overall, a strongly unpleasant experience. Would not recommend, except if you want to test your patience.

reviews.title: Extreme hospitality and kindness
reviews.text: The owners were so kind and I don't even know where to start with.We faced problems during our trip to Egypt. And failed to arrive on the booked date. We contacted with camp and they allowed us to arrive the next day without any penalty at all!Owners were so sweet and helpful all the time, always feed us with local food for free. And when they found out that we lost our money they also allowed us to stay for free and pay when we arrive next time, so sweet and hospitable we couldn't even imagine that it is possible. After all, when we were about to leave they also offer to give us some money for an upcoming trip, how is it even possible in the modern world?!We spent a beautiful time with their family chatting and playing frisbee.In addition to all this, the camp is very good, even the WIFI was great, which is almost impossible in Egypt.

reviews.title: Outstanding experience in the middle of nothing
reviews.text: Awesome experience in the most beautiful and natural camp. We liked the remoteness of the camp. Beautiful corals in fron of the beach and around the camp. Went to sleep with the stars above our head and woke up with the calming sound of waves. Super relaxed owners which give so much love into this unique place.

reviews.title: Spotlessly Clean, Great Location, Fantastic Owner
reviews.text: Sheikh Salem House is perfectly located at one of the BEST areas in Dahab. It has a lovely relaxed vibe at this side of town and in my opinion has a more authentic feel about it. (It’s basically at Eel Gardens) You’re within  literally minutes of walking to Assalah Square (for supermarkets and provisions) and maybe 10 minutes to the lighthouse area of Dahab (for the more tourist side of Dahab). Between the two areas you are literally spoilt for choice for places to eat, if you choose to eat elsewhere!! Nida, who owns sheikh Salem, however has a beautiful beach restaurant and we often had lunch or snacks there too (I can highly recommend their watermelon juice!!) As we were staying for the month in Dahab we chose one of the apartments. They are HUGE!! There were just the 2 of us but it would have comfortably accommodated 4 people (possibly 5!!). The panoramic views of the sea were just breathtaking too. Nida literally has thought of everything to ensure that your stay is as comfortable as possible. Within the kitchen every single utensil you could ever need is there. You are provided with far more towels than you could possibly need!! A Wi-Fi extender was also available (I’ve never had this before in Dahab and have been multiple times - it made a huge difference!!). Plenty of hangers were available in the wardrobe for our clothes as opposed to the 2 or 3 (often found in other places!!). The rooms were immaculately clean and any issues were literally sorted within a couple of hours of mentioning it. The showers had a good pressure and there was also warm water if you wanted it. The beds are super comfortable and I slept solidly every single night (which is a rarity for me!!). Lastly, and possibly one of THE most important things for myself coming from England (with a significantly colder climate) …. The Air Conditioning (!!) - I suspect Nida ensures this is regularly serviced and checked as it actually works and WELL!! It was sheer bliss.Nida is absolutely THE perfect hostess. She is so welcoming and friendly, super knowledgeable about the area and the culture and has exceptionally high standards. If you’re looking for a fantastically located, clean, comfortable, safe, very chilled and laid back guest house with a beautiful beach area then Sheikh Salem House in Dahab  (near Eel Gardens) is definitely worth checking out. I will definitely be returning as this is true Dahab.

reviews.title: Overpriced
reviews.text: The location is pleasant, facing the sea. The private beach is nice for swimming and chilling out. However, our room was not cleaned at all during the 4 days of staying, despite our request. We were expecting such service on a daily basis. The reason of not cleaning was attributed to the Ramadan period. Asking for advice for a day trip we did nor get a trustable answer. The price of the requested trip would have been around 3 times higher than the price offered by travel agencies. All our friends in Dahab spent less and stayed in better places. The service needs a serious improvement.

reviews.title: Rediculas minimum charge for nothing!!!
reviews.text: The place has nothing special at all. They asked for a minimum charge while they offer very bad food so it's quite hard to find something good to use your money for.service is below average.There are so many better places to go to in Dahab.Just a few meters away there are a couple of much better places with no minimum charge.It's a disappointment.

reviews.title: Welcoming place
reviews.text: Nice and clean guesthouse, modern with great facilities yet decorated with taste.  You can go directly from the guesthouse to the sea. Nice clean and warm showers. Very welcoming and helpful host. Recommend

reviews.title: Chilled with a unique view!
reviews.text: This place honestly made me feel a lot differently about Dahab this time, it was very quiet, my husband was able to work from there. The view from inside and outside the room is spectacular. The managers are very nice and they have a very unique taste, I really like the simple artistic touches on the tables and the designs, the place is very clean and tidy, the room couldn’t be closer to the beach,it is now my favorite part of Dahab. I’m definitely going to be there again soon♥️

reviews.title: Fantastic atmosphere, chilled, relaxed, great rooms
reviews.text: I travel to Dahab regularily  and have stayed at Sheikh Salem over 15 years. I was in Dahab, Sinai Egypt in March and I was very impressed with the renovation work.The rooms are all bright with names instead of numbers. They each have bright, clean modern showers and toilettes, Very comfortable beds. Safes in the room with fridge, kettle. Outside each door is a fire extinguisher. There are lower sea view rooms facing the Arisha.The garden has been beautifully renovated with garden rooms. The rooms are spotless, clean, fresh. With nice closets.and lots of space.My favourite part is the Arisha on the beach. Its cozy, relaxed, chilled and absolutely a wonderful place for reading, chilling, staying out of the sun, chatting.If the wind peaks up you can still sit out side or in the Arish. The beach is spotless and clean with great bedouin seating.Fridays are not to be missed when the entire community comes for Friday Market. Where food, crafts, art, clothing and many other things are sold.Most of all they have an incredible group of young dynamic people working as a team to give you an authentic Bedouin experience.Great place for children, famalies, couples, friends travelling together or solo travellers. Great place for a sunset, moon rise or sunrise walk, or just for gazing.New lights are  being installed along the entire beach area.Its a few minutes walk to an endless number of restaurants, laundry service, marketA few minutes walk to Aasala where you can eat fresh fish, buy fruits, a few grocerie stores, places to buy wine and beer. Egyptian bakery, German bakery. A vegan soup bar. Several places to eat fresh fish caught. You can buy grilled chicken. There is a pharmacy.A few minutes walk to the Light HouseWhere you will find other restaurants, bars, shops, snorket and diving places, bakeries, Indian, Russian , Italian and Egyptian Resturants. Another great Vegan Resturant near by.For those who like to run, walk , bike  and exercise in the morning or sunset. A few great places to run include from Sheikh Salem to Lagoona. Sheilk Salem is the most beautiful part of the beach area in Dahab.Ask Mohamed Amr and his team at the Soul of Sinai to organise day trips or multi day trips. To St Katherine, desert mediations, desert hikes and walks. Want to learn about Bedouin culture, music and food then sit in the Arisha and hear about the stories or take a trip with the team who will show you a truely authentic local experience.Yoga, Meditation and those who enjoy quiet calm and relaxed atmosphere:This a great place to stay if you enjoy calm, relaxed atmosphere away from bars and restaurants. Those who want to mediate, do yoga and have a spirtual journey. This is again a wonderful place to stay.I highly recommend Sheikh Salem for a truely authentic local experience in Dahab , the Sinai with a wonderul group of people  who will take care of you and make you feel at home.

reviews.title: Amazing place :)
reviews.text: it's clean.great hospitality.very good location and beach.they can get u anything u want and suggest where to go and make the needed arrangments for u.Felt home :)i don't think i will stay anywhere else.I loved the food market they organize every friday. The food is really good and the prices as well.

reviews.title: Oh My God!
reviews.text: Ha, I've never stayed in a hostel this far off the deep end before. Nasty dirty, there was a padlock on the door from the outside so we couldn't lock it from the inside and there was a huge opening above the door to the common area so privacy was non existent or anyone wanting to creep in could have. The one bed had such a curve in the middle that we had no choice but to sleep with no personal space. My friend and I pretty well slept in shifts it was that sketchy. Cheap, yes. Worth it, never! We checked out the next morning and found a really affordable spot half a kilometre down the same strip.

reviews.title: Perfect for the limited or low budget traveller
reviews.text: If you don't give much care for the room service and want enjoy staying in one of the best locations in Dahab this place is quite nice.It has nice arabian sit on the beach for tanning in the morning, and wounderful night time with friends for driniking and listining to music.Very close to the local market where you can get all your beverage, grocery and food in the very regular official prices.The place is very safe and owners are decent, friendly and not greedy.

reviews.title: Much improved
reviews.text: Great stay as a returning customer. Thank you Nicole and Hasan for making it memorable and enjoyable. What I asked for I got, Hamad was an outstanding waiter/ look after the guest in every aspect ones holidays should see fit. The front rooms have mind blowing views, great  price. Keep the news off the TV, stop the black dog barking at 3am, more chilled out music playing and I will be back. Safest area if you want to visit Dahab....

reviews.title: A little piece of paradise in Egypt!
reviews.text: This is already the second time I have come to this resort, and I think it is a paradise!! Kindness of the staff, precision, and super good food, and the entertainment team is friendly and helpful!!! Super!!!

reviews.title: The scenery takes your breath away
reviews.text: I am totally in love with this hotel because of where it is. situated on a lagoon with the forever changing gentle tides. A back drop of  the coloured mountains to one side an open of expanse of sea and beach on the other side . Its just perfect lots of watersports to watch.The hotel covers a large area bordered on one side by the sea  The buffet  restaurant  has an expansive indoor eating area   as well as an open air dining area looking over the lagoon. Food was ok , Im fussy and I always found something but if you want standard English food you wont find it here There is a bar at the far end of the neach which looks out over the spit , lovely place for a morning coffee At lunch time you can get delicious freshly cooked pizzas , burgers , chips etc ,from 2 cooking stations near the beach .  These  both opened up while we were there but one closed after one  day( possibly because the season hadn't really started)   The rooms were cleaned every day and towels changed.There was some refurbishing going on but it'll wasnt noisy. The 2 pools were spotless with adequate sunbeds nlbut the beach got used farmore than the pools .Not much around the hotel to walk to but there is a shop about 10 minutes away, but if youre after a real chilled, relaxing holiday in an idyllic place this could be for you

reviews.title: Beautiful peaceful 2 week hotel
reviews.text: We travel here in August as a family of 2 adults and 1 adult child who has a serious peanut allergy.We arrived late and was quickly checked in and shown to our room which was too small. This was quickly changed with no issues and we were able to eat the food left for us which was fruit, cheese and bread rolls.The rooms were cleaned daily to a high standard with fresher bottles of water given each day and could be filled up at the bars or in the restaurant.The food was outstanding freshly cooked with detail paid to ensuring nothing was empty and refreshed accordingly. There was a bbq section out every evening with the most beautiful chicken cooked on it.A huge mention to all the chefs but Nageh Radwan went above and beyond to make sure our son was able to eat and showed us the safe dishes for him.The resort itself self is simply stunning and well kept. The gardeners work all day cutting the grass and making it look so peaceful and relaxing.There is 2 pools which were both clean and well kept with a lifeguard on at all times. There was no issue getting a sunbed so none of the craziness of reserving beds.The beach is just a 30 second walk from the pool and is beautiful with sun beds and a lifeguard always on too.This resort offers a private taxi into the town which we used twice and highly recommended as we didn’t have to wait at all the driver even waited for us and took us back.Overall this hotel is truly beautiful and we will be returning.Thank you to everyone who makes this hotel what it is and I can’t list all the staff members as I would be here for ages.

reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: I recommend a vacation at Dahab Lagoone Club to everyone.  We are relaxing here for the first time. Everything was liked, Excellent hotel, large and clean territory, excellent food and a great big beach. The lifeguards Maher and Farez will always help on the beach and politely answer all questions. The beach is always clean and well-kept. Thank you very much to all the hotel staff.

reviews.title: Classical style
reviews.text: Five stars in the classical sense. Cosmetics only in tubes, beer in bottles, no high-rise buildings, only low-rise, you can see the sea and mountains. This is a general impression - very good.Details.Location - in the center of the bay, comfortable entrance to the sea, but no reefs. There is a little on the sides, but not really. But there's something to see, big fish flaws, super spectacle. A vortex of about 5-8 meters in diameter was swirling around me. This needs to be caught.The area is low-rise, well-kept, in Nubian style (semi-circular windows, domes, shutters), very aesthetic, I liked it. It is necessary to take into account - there is almost no shade, because of the wind all the palms have sparse crowns.The beach is full of places, the sunbeds are quite far apart from each other, a feeling of freedom. No need to book in advance, there are always places.Pool - I don't need it, but I tried. Small, little, on the sunbathing spot, local tourists use it and the music is the same. I don't care, but it needs to be taken into accountThe food is a very average choice (for a five), but everything is very tasty, and no more is needed. The barbecue is very good, and every evening tooCleaning - very good. Aziz Ahmed (that's what it said on the sign) was cleaning; while he was at breakfast (8:20-8:50), he was already managing to clean. The quality is super, we greeted him every morning, asked if everything was okay.By the bars. Beach – good, the guys are friendly and fast, thank you to them.A very unusual and pleasant lobby bar. It is called Island, opposite the reception. It's in a pub style, a wooden bar, very cool, not all hotels have this. All-inclusive, they pour everything, and in a glass. The bartender there, Muhammad Mahmud (an older man) – he's amazing, he makes cocktails from any ingredients you name. Special thanks and hello to him! The strangest thing is there are no people there, I was alone for a couple of days, don't tell anyone, it's just super.Conclusion: a classic of the genre, now it is my next (of two) favorite hotel in Egypt. Thank you to all the hotel staff for a wonderful vacation.Tip: always thank employees for their work (tips, 100 pounds is fine) they deserve it. And then there will be no need to write reviews about bad treatment.

reviews.title: A hymn to slowness!
reviews.text: That is how I wanted to title the splendid week of vacation spent at this resort: I was in the company of a friend, eager to enjoy tranquility and soft rhythms. The reassuring and harmonious setting, the quiet atmosphere, the background music, and the polite, discreet, and respectful behavior of the staff contributed to making me feel at ease (even though we were the only Italians present), relaxed, and even "pampered." The cuisine is typical, so varied as to allow one to taste particular and different dishes every day, which I tasted very gladly. The dessert buffet is a triumph of flavors and colors: they were so beautiful and perfect that they looked laser-cut!!!!The sandy beach, with a view of a bay with crystal-clear sea, also calm: I spent hours letting myself be cradled by the waves in absolute relaxation. The rooms show that the property has its age, but they are clean and spacious. Mine had drainage problems and after two days I was assigned another one, even nicer. I must thank in particular the resort Manager, Mr. Hossam Mohamed, a very kind, smiling, and very helpful person. In short: everything contributed to making me enjoy the vacation I wanted and that I really needed!!!

reviews.title: Safir Dahb Hotel
reviews.text: I had a great experience staying at Dahab Safir Hotel. The hotel was comfortable, the atmosphere was amazing, and the staff were very friendly and welcoming.A special thanks to Ahmed El Shazly from the Entertainment Team, who really made my stay more enjoyable. He was energetic, friendly, and always made sure guests were having a great time. His positive attitude and the way he interacted with everyone created such a fun and welcoming atmosphere.

And would like to mention bishoy the bartender near the lobby that was too nice.The rooms are a bit old but clean and everything worked well.The PR or guest relations were so helpful, they would come to you and ask if everything there is to your satisfaction.The front desk did their job so good, i had to change room because of the view and they just helped without hesitation and so many questions.I had an unfortunate event and had to leave the hotel few days earlier than my booking, and they were so understanding and sympathetic, even gave me a refund for the nights im not staying.The animation team were alright, but didn't do much activities as other hotels close by.

reviews.title: Great place for divers
reviews.text: We’ve spent 10 days at Inmo diving and really enjoyed our time here. Dahab is a great mix between stellar dive sites and enough “life” to keep things interesting in the evening or dry days. We’ve booked our stay via email which was easy and straightforward. Definitely going to come back here. Rooms: We had a terrace room and were really happy with it. Comfy bed, enough space and plenty of hot water for the shower. Rooms are swept through daily which is also nice. There’s aircon which we didn’t need in January. The breeze coming in from the ocean is really nice!Food: Breakfast is typical Egyptian - breads, cheeses, foul, falafel and fruits / salads. All tasty and plentiful. You can also have freshly prepared omelette / pancakes. We haven’t used the restaurant but others told us that the divers dinner is a great option to have. Otherwise there are plenty of restaurants and snack places around. Other amenities: Inmo is a small dive resort with really nice outside areas to relax and enjoy the sun. There’s a large playground for kids to keep entertained. There’s a pool too but it was too cold to use it in January. Lots of books in different languages available at the free little library. WiFi works ok-ish, some areas it works great, others have less reception. Airport transport is available at a really reasonable price too. Just ask anything you need and the team will be able to organise it for you. We didn’t have time to do any land excursions but they can also be organised through the hotel. Diving: Diving was a fantastic surprise. People talk only about the Blue Hole but there are so many more (and even much better) dive sites around. Definitely ask to go to Islands if you can. The whole dive operation is incredibly well organised. Rental equipment is good, staff really care about safety and everyone was super professional. We dived with the same guide all week who adjusted the program according to what we wanted to do. Dives are planed as two dives per day. All dives (apart from special excursions) are shore dives. Max. depth 30min, dive time always around 50min. Depending on the tides you can do a housereef dive in the afternoon too. Location: Great location just on the edge of central Dahab. It’s quiet, safe, calm but you are only minutes away from the main promenade. Lots of great restaurants, cafes and shops right around the corner. For us that’s the perfect mix of staying in a quiet location but still within walking distance of all the Dahab has to offer.  - - - - - We had a fantastic time at Inmo and will surely be back. Great team, stellar diving and lots still left to be explored.

reviews.title: Generations diving holidays
reviews.text: I stayed with my mother and son (10) for a week at INMO Divers Home. My mother has been flying to see Ingrid and Mohamed for several years and was always very enthusiastic. My son and I can understand the enthusiasm, for diving, the city and especially the very friendly and family accommodation now very well. It was a great stay for us, we did not miss anything. In addition to diving, my son, who has never really dived, had 3 dives with Ebrahim at that time. He was very enthusiastic and quickly took Ebrahim into his heart with his very nice, calm and competent manner, he was hardly to be taken out of the water. He also had a lot of fun with him. A trip to the White Canyon we can only recommend. Everything together was an unforgettable adventure! Many thanks to Ingrid, Mo and the whole team on site. It was not the last stay for us 😊

reviews.title: Like a big family
reviews.text: That perfect hotel for divers, great location right on the beach and less than five minutes from the center.So you have your peace but is not too far away. Staff is incredibly friendly and warm feels like inmo is a big family. For activities you can contact the hotel and it is booked quickly and easily. We had a trip to Mount Sinai & a Bedouin dinner under the stars. You can also take the dive license at inmo. reviews.title: Small and nice, with its own diving center!
reviews.text: Dahab my heart is always in the property, since 2003 we have been staying with friends! Once or twice a year we love to dive there and in between we dream about it with our pictures... The hotel complex is family owned and you can feel that everywhere!

reviews.title: Diver friendly hotel
reviews.text: We booked this hotel with a view to learning to dive. The hotel has its own in-house diving center, so this is easy because all your equipment can stay there. We got a simple but adequately equipped room with air conditioning and refrigerator. Although we didn't need this in January, this seems like a must for the warmer months. The room had a small terrace with a view of the Red Sea, which was beautiful. Nothing is more fun than falling asleep to the sound of the sea. In the bathroom there is everything you need. There is sometimes a long wait for the hot water in the shower, but this is more due to the fact that you are in the desert than the functionality of the shower. The room is cleaned well with new towels every day and new sheets every 2 days. Sufficient choice at breakfast with a choice of eggs and pancakes. The only thing we were not prepared for is that electronic payments are not possible in the hotel. Something to keep in mind if you have to pay for your PADI lessons!There is a family atmosphere and the staff is very friendly.We will definitely come back here!

Their willingness to go the extra mile truly sets them apart.The cafeteria and restaurant team—Karim, Mohamed, and Ibrahim—deserve special praise. They were consistently friendly, courteous, and attentive, creating a warm and comfortable atmosphere. Service was always prompt, and their positive attitude made every meal more enjoyable.I would also like to recognize Said, a young man in room service, who works incredibly hard and with great dedication. His effort, politeness, and attention to detail did not go unnoticed and truly added to the quality of the stay.Overall, the hospitality, courtesy, and genuine commitment of the entire team to walk the extra mile made Penguin Village Dahab feel more like a home than a hotel. Staff should realize that guests don't want went towels.  And while our apartment came with a nice kitchen, but it didn't include a lighter necessary to light the stovetop.  And while it had 10 plates, we were given only one drinking glass.  Etc, etc, etc.

reviews.title: I booked this villa through Booking.com. with the free cancellation feature
reviews.text: I booked this villa through Booking.com with their free cancellation policy. Their reservation manager, Ahmed, contacted me for a partial refund, but I paid the full amount because I trust Booking.com. He asked if I could book directly through them. I agreed, but I specifically asked if I would receive the same benefits I get from Booking.com, and they confirmed it. He then sent me a cancellation request from the website, and I trusted him and did so. It was a foolish move on my part to agree to cancel my reservation through the website.Unfortunately, a death occurred in my family, something completely beyond my control. I contacted the hotel management to cancel my reservation due to these circumstances. Despite their initial promises, they did not honor our agreement and instead deducted half the amount. I then received the number of the person I had agreed with, the hotel manager, Mr. Adnan. He told me he would contact them and that the amount would be refunded within two days. I called Mr. Ahmed again to find out when the refund would be due. He informed me that they would deduct the cost of two nights from the refund amount. This was not our initial agreement.Do they have the right to deduct this amount without prior agreement between us? I have yet to receive my reservation fee.I urge anyone considering booking this villa to exercise caution and ensure that all terms and conditions are clearly and in writing, as what is advertised on booking platforms does not always reflect reality. I also believe that Booking.com should take strict measures to ensure that properties listed on its platform comply with its stated policies.

reviews.title: Best accomodation in Dahab!

reviews.title: Absolutely unacceptable experience .Avoid this hotel at all costs.
reviews.text: Absolutely unacceptable experience .Avoid this hotel at all costs.My stay at Panda Hotel was a complete disaster and far below any acceptable hospitality standards. The rooms are in very poor and unhygienic condition, with serious plumbing problems and an intolerable smell, raising major health and safety concerns.I stayed for 4 nights, and housekeeping did not clean the room even once, despite repeated complaints. This reflects a complete failure to meet even the most basic hotel service obligations.Breakfast was by far the worst and most disappointing part of the experience. Although officially scheduled from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM, every day when I went down at 9:00 AM, almost all items were already finished, with no refilling whatsoever. The food quality was extremely poor and unacceptable, and it caused me allergic reactions and stomach problems, which represents a serious food safety concern.To make matters worse, the plates and serving dishes were visibly dirty and in very poor condition, with an unpleasant appearance that clearly indicates lack of proper hygiene and sanitation. This is clearly shown in the attached photos, and it raises serious questions about the hotel’s compliance with basic food hygiene and public health standards.Another highly concerning issue was the inconsistent and unfair pricing policy. I discovered that the same room, during the same period, was being sold at different rates to different guests, without any clear or transparent justification. This practice raises serious concerns about price discrimination and misleading pricing.The most shocking and unacceptable part was the behavior of a staff member named Mostafa. When I raised my complaints, he explicitly told me:“This is how it is for Egyptians.”This statement clearly implies unequal treatment based on nationality, suggesting that foreign guests receive better service. This is offensive, discriminatory, and racist, and may constitute a violation of hospitality ethics and anti-discrimination principles.Overall, this hotel demonstrates gross mismanagement, poor hygiene standards, lack of professionalism, and total disregard for guest well-being. The services and conditions advertised online do not reflect reality, which could reasonably be considered misleading representation.I will never stay at this hotel again, and I strongly warn all potential guests to avoid this place. This review is written to inform others and should be taken seriously by hotel management and relevant authorities.

reviews.text: Worst hotel experience honestly, and this was actually my second stay here.  The first time was already bad, but they told me the hotel had been fully renovated and asked me to give it another chance after the renovation… unfortunately, the experience was still extremely disappointing.  The pool was not clean at all, and the water clearly wasn’t being changed properly.  The rooms may look renovated, but there is a very strong sewage smell.  Hot water keeps cutting off and the water pressure is extremely weak. Their explanation was that the salty water damages the faucets and they “can’t keep up with maintenance.”  What was even more frustrating is that they turn the AC off remotely, then claim the electricity went out and that they “forgot” to turn it back on because we weren’t in the room.  The biggest shock for me was the staff. During my first stay, the staff were actually very kind and professional. After the renovation, the service and attitude became extremely poor and unprofessional.  Sharing my honest experience so others know what to expect before booking.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem in Dahab – Quiet, Beautiful and Exceptionally Welcoming
reviews.text: We spent 10 wonderful days at The Bridge Hotel in Dahab – and by the time we left, it was already clear: we will definitely be back!The rooms are spacious, quiet, bright, and very clean. We especially loved the beautiful balcony – perfect for winding down and relaxing at the end of the day. You immediately feel comfortable and at home here.The location is ideal: just a few steps from the beach, the famous bridge of Dahab, and the town center with its many restaurants – yet the hotel itself remains peaceful, and slightly tucked away. It’s the perfect balance between convenience and relaxation.Breakfast was a daily highlight: rich, varied, and prepared with great care and attention to detail.What truly makes this place special, however, are the people: the warmth and helpfulness of the entire team around Bassem are exceptional. You don’t feel like just a guest, but like a genuinely welcome part of the place. Bassem himself is a fantastic host who puts great effort into ensuring everything is clean, well-maintained, and in perfect condition.For us, it was a completely perfect stay – we wholeheartedly recommend this hotel and are already looking forward to coming back!

reviews.title: The Best Stay in Dahab – Comfort Meets Excellence!
reviews.text: If you’re looking for the perfect place to stay in Dahab, The Bridge / The Gate is an absolute gem. The staff is incredibly friendly and provides excellent service, making you feel welcome from the moment you arrive. The food is exquisite—every meal is a delight. Rooms are spotless, cozy, and well-maintained, offering a comfortable retreat after a day of diving. Overall, this is by far the best place to stay in Dahab. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: I came out to do a technical diving course at Liquid Adventures dive centre, based within the Bridge property.Everything about this place was just fantastic, firstly the people who work here are just the best  and go above and beyond to make you feel at home. The rooms are really well appointed, clean, comfortable and clustered around the pool and cafe, giving the place a very friendly vibe. The Bridge is located smack bang in the middle of the vibrant centre, paces away from restaurants, cafes, ATMs and the sea, but retains a feeling of peace & tranquility.Liquid Adventures, the dive centre on site is supremely well run and caters for everyone from novice trainees to advanced technical divers.As a diver I wouldn’t stay anywhere else in Dahab.

reviews.title: Amazing diving holiday
reviews.text: Great facilities, food and super helpful and kind people. The value for your money is very fair and therefore also accessible for students.Location is perfect as you can just walk from the Bridge, with there in house diving centre, into the sea. reviews.title: Filthy place & bullied for payment when leaving early & had already paid online website
reviews.text: We arrived at this hotel at 2.00 am. We booked two rooms for two nights for a group of 4 people. It  was awful!  Dirty tiny rooms, tiny bathroom, hair on sheets, fridge in rooms were grubby with shelves not cleaned, rubbish under bed, filthy floors, bedroom door that did not close - had to lock the other person into the room when going in and out of the room, A/C did not work, filthy swimming pool water. We decided to leave after staying 1 night instead of 2.  Things got worse at this point. The hotel owner/manager (Emad) would not let us leave without paying for the 2 rooms for 2 nights. I explained I had already paid through a well known worldwide online booking website. He insisted he had not withdrawn his payment from the online booking website & I must pay him directly. This confused me. I showed him my confirmation which said payment would be in advance on my credit card. He would not let us leave the hotel until we paid. I felt bullied and intimidated by this man. Would he have behaved this way if my husband was with me, and he had to deal with a man? After a long time arguing with him. I paid for the two nights. He claimed he was doing me a favour charging me what was the amount I had contracted to pay the online website. He claimed he was not charging me taxes, when in fact all taxes were included in my booking rate on the website.  I paid him the full amount due as per the online website. He said his system is to get payment directly from customers & not collect from the online agent. This is a scam.  Not once when he was bullying me for payment did he ask why I was leaving after only 7 hours in the place. He just wanted his money.  We moved to a lovely hotel around the corner and spent a blissful week. Emad subsequently sent me a text asking me why I left. We had a very polite exchange of texts. I explained things were dirty, and we were very disappointed. He acknowledged that some things could have been better, but in essence it was a cheap hotel for people “with incomes below average”, which I do understand explains why a room can be very basic, but not why it needs to be filthy, with unwashed floors, rubbish under beds, hair on sheets, no fresh top sheet, just a plain used blanket to sleep under. His explanation for the dirty and murky swimming pool water is that it was “natural  water from wells and we don’t use a lot of chemicals in it“. I have never seen natural well water look so bad. No way would we consider getting into that  swimming pool.  The overall filth of the place, the hassle and unpleasant treatment when we tried to leave is why I am leaving this review, not because it is a completely basic hotel, and not worth any amount of money. Avoid this place!

reviews.title: Stunning beautifully designed Villas
reviews.text: These Villas are really beautifully designed, their spacious and very tastefully designed with a earthy natural theme. The location is great for a more peaceful stay towards the edge of Dahab, still a short walk into town. Rio the site manager has been really helpful and very very quick to support with all our needs. Highy recommend, i will definitely be coming again.

reviews.title: I'll be back!
reviews.text: This was my second stay at Red C Villas, this time with my teenage boys. Maggie and her staff are so lovely, welcoming and helpful. Rio and his family do everything they can to make you feel at home including helping with questions about the apartment and booking taxis etc. The villas are comfortable and roomy - there were 3 of us in a 2 bedroom place on the ground floor and we had plenty of space. The kitchen was well equipped, there was always water to fill up bottles and the wifi was pretty reliable and strong.We didn't use the pool but we did hang out on the rooftop terrace as the sun went down. Could maybe do with some more furniture there.We enjoyed beautiful walks into town from the Villas - takes around 20 mins. Asala Square is not far for groceries and supplies.A taxi from town to the villas was 50 egyptian.We had lovely walks up the mountains at the back of the villas to watch the sunsets. Absolutely stunning.I wouldn't hesistate to recommend Red C Villas to my friends.Thank you Maggie and team for a wonderful stay - hope to see you soon, Inshallah

reviews.title: Lovely spacious air conditioned villa with beautiful pool
reviews.text: This is a villa complex, with four villas, two of which have been split into two apartments.  They have been built to a very high standard. The whole complex can sleep 28 people plus there’s a small studio on site for a further 2 guests. There’s a lovely pool in the centre of the villas with the apartments / villas facing into. Our villa also had a lovely roof terrace plus there’s a small patio outside of the main door, great for watching the early morning sunrise. We had two bedrooms in our 1st floor apartment; 1 with king sized bed and one other twin bedded room which we didn’t use. Plus two bathrooms, one of which was en-suite to the master bedroom.  There was a good shower, I found the bed comfy but my partner found it quite firm.  There is a kitchen / lounge / dining area with TV (although we didn’t use).  The kitchen is fairly well equipped but we didn’t dine in so didn’t attempt to cook as such but you could. There’s a decent sized fridge freezer plus a separate water cooler so you have everything you need. The villas do have Wi-Fi but it was patchy and sometimes not available so it’s advisable to buy a SIM for your phone. Rio and his family (who look after the villas for the owners) are on hand to help with any issues and he is very friendly. There’s also a communal washing machine which guests can use.  Although the villas are away from the centre of Dahab you can easily catch a taxi into town or better still hire a bike (as we did) and cycle in and out of town.  Although you do get a bit of road noise, once inside the gate, the villas provide a calming, relaxed place to stay with views of both sea and mountains. I’d  recommend earplugs as we found the air conditioner in the bedroom was a little noisy, plus it takes care of any background road noise. Overall we had a nice relaxing stay at the Villas and would definitely recommend.

reviews.title: Red C Villas
reviews.text: On arrival we were greeted and made to feel right at home, the flat was well maintained and well appointed, spacious and  comfortable The pool was refreshing. Great location, beautiful country, beautiful people and the scenery is to die for

reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.text: The Red C Villas are really quite nice and actually better than the pictures as the gardens have matured and are quite lovely.  The architectural elements and design create a beautiful, luxurious scene.  A few small touches such as a working TV and shampoo/conditioner with wash cloths included would push this place to excellent but in no way take away from the beauty.   The folks working here also demonstrate great hospitality and are very responsive which is appreciated.  One thing to note is those who are lighter sleepers and not early risers may want to reserve an apartment on the city side as there is fowl in the lot next door and the roosters crow quite loudly and early at dawn.  This is outside of the property, so hard to knock the place for this but it did cause me to wake earlier than desired each morning.  However, the pros outweigh the cons and we’d stay here again when in Dahab.

reviews.title: Exactly what you dreamed of
reviews.text: Stayed at the villas with a group of 16 friends. We exclusively hired it out. It is exactly like the pictures - simply heavenly with the views of the desert mountains and the sea, overlooking the courtyard pool. The rooms were big and spacious, each kitted out with a proper kitchen. Water coolers were provided. There is on-site laundry machines too. Pool was excellent, great rooftop terraces for some yoga practice. You can walk into town - it is not too far - otherwise plenty of taxis around. There is also a cute beach the opposite direction to town. You can also get a masseuse to come to the villa. The owners and cleaning staff were all lovely and helpful. Would definitely stay here if traveling in a group or you want to stay a bit away from the busier Dahab beach front - it really is easy and safe to get home from town.

reviews.title: Relaxed at Red C Villas

reviews.title: Exceptional quality and service
reviews.text: We stayed at Red C Villas for 10 days during a diving trip to Dahab and absolutely loved itI cannot recommend the Red C as an accommodation venue enough. After booking, we communicated directely with the management who helped arrange our transfers from Sharm El Sheikh, helped organise a dinner in the desert under the stars and were simply on hand for any queries that we needed. During the day, Rio, the onsite manager was there to help whenever we had a query. The accommodation itself is simply stunning. We stayed in a Studio apartment and were very happy with the space, the quality of the bed and the facilities. The poolside is a great way to while away an afternoon and a welcome place to rest after a day of diving.Massive thank you to Dom, Maggie and Rio for helping make our trip to Dahab incredibly memorable once again,

reviews.title: Going downhill

Another customer asked them to clean it which they did not and by the time we left the pool had turned green in colour. Disgusting. The rooms are getting run down and they supply you with limited linen and towels. They want 8 euros each time to change the sheets or clean the room. They even had a problem with us hanging our clothes to dry on our own lines. On top of all that they charge you extra for electricity . That in itself is not a problem, except they charge nearly quadruple the normal.rate. When we approached the manager ( Bota ) about this he informed me that if you don't like it , we can leave. All in all it has the potential to be a nice place, but for that to happen they will need to refurbish the room increase levels of customer service dramatically , and just be genuinely more nice and approachable. I would Nott recommend booking in to Canyon Estate. You can find much nicer rooms with clean swimming pool.and better customer service in other parts of Dahab
