reviews.text: Highly recommended for anyone who seeks to have a great time in Dahab, great place that has all the essentails you will need in a room, very clean, kind, very nice people and so helpful. Thank you for the experience

reviews.title: Amazing hotel!
reviews.text: Once we stepped into the hotel, we got a very warm welcoming from the owner.In general, the hotel is very clean, has an outside area and roof to chill around.Also, during our stay there the owners were helpful to recommend and book few trips for us for adequate prices.Definitely will recommend for families and a small group of friends.

reviews.title: Great staff
reviews.text: I just got an awesome experience with them.Great and friendly staffClean rooms Quite placeIf u r looking for a place to stay with quite and clean for chilling or study or doing ur research I think it’s the place for you.

reviews.title: Dahab
reviews.text: Best place ever in dahab..Mr Ahmed and Mr Yasser are so freindly ,nice and cooperative...place very clean Quiet near to beach restaurants diving centers any service you need..you feel comfort there I recommend it for any visitor..thanks fullmoon❤️

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: Fullmoon is an amazing hotel, it has clean rooms, friendly staff, a very nice and helpful owners and a lovely rooftop it's one of my favorite places to stay in Dahab and I would definitely stay there again in the future.

reviews.title: Happy client
reviews.text: Thanks to mr. yasser and Ahmed very welcoming and amazing hosts room was very neat , hot water and all details about room was excellent .About location so calm and near to everything you need also the bicycles available to rent as well as helping with ordering taxi if needed , will sure come back already missing  the  morning coffee in the terrace , full moon thanks to all staff and owners

reviews.title: I am very lucky that I got to this place
reviews.text: I took the hotel because it was good place - for exactly my requirement - (3 min walk from diving center, 3 min walk from, and not inside touristic zone).The place is nice and clean. Simple place.The best is the staff.Very nice people - Yasser the owner is a great person - you will understand what I mean after you are here and speak with him.Do not expect “Sinai touristic-like place” - no one will try to sell you here something unless you request a specific thing, they will help in whatever you need.As I wrote in the title, I am so happy I got to this place.The best that I am taking from here is knowing Yasser.

reviews.title: Great value for money
reviews.text: Hotel is simple and cozy. Owner is superb and friendly, extremely helpful. Definitely going back there on my next visit.Hotel is very close to the beach, and also close to downtown. Walking distance to restaurants and cafés.

reviews.title: I was lucky to be in that hotel
reviews.text: He was truly wonderful in every way, and Mr. Osama was a very friendly person. He helped us with everything. We loved Dahab because of that hotel. Ahmed Tarek, friend of Hussein El-Shahat, Mr. Osama 😂😂

reviews.title: Going from strength to strength
reviews.text: Since my last visit to the Bedouin Lodge 2 years ago there has been significant refurbishment of the rooms and public areas on an ongoing basis.So it looks and feels fresher and furthermore it was very busy due to my stay coinciding with a national holiday. The management continues to provide a friendly ‘can do’ attitude  and I’m sure this lodge will prove more and more popular with foreign clients too.

reviews.title: You found your accommodation!
reviews.text: When you go to stay in Dahab you can’t do better than The Bedouin Lodge. Respectful, professional and warm hosts will help you for whatever purpose. Ahmed at the Diving School, Abu Shari & Saad in the kitchen, Osama & Mohammed at the reception. When you’re doing an activity everything is taken care of. (My first experience going to the Moses Mountain, some people who came from different hostels ran into issues at passport checkpoints, not the ones who were from Bedouin Lodge, due to being cared for properly) I arrived at Bedouin Lodge for the first time three years ago, it’s been a home away from home ever since.

reviews.title: Wonderful first stay in Dahab
reviews.text: This was our first visit to Dahab and bedouin lodge was just great!Everyone was very friendly and giving us good advice what activities we can do in the area.The food was also very tasty, with great tea and fresh juices.I did my first dive there and had a great experience, there's a lot to see under the water.Next time I'm in Dahab I'll stay there again!

reviews.title: Best place to dive, explore, dine and relax in Dahab
reviews.text: I have been a frequent visitor to Dahab for over a decade and no longer stay anywhere else, as I have found a home away from home at Bedouin Lodge. It's a truly exceptional place in Dahab. For luxury, go to a resort and for everything else go to Bedouin Lodge.

reviews.title: Excellent value for money and such a lovely, genuine group of people in attendance!
reviews.text: The Bedouin lodge is tied to the dive centre on the sea front with a wonderful relaxing view of the Bay of Aqaba and Saudi Arabian mountains in the distance. The room is clean and air conditioned and just a few steps from the dive centre and restaurant. I have visited a number of times for diving and each time has been fantastic , always with new sites to explore and excellent dive guides. For me it feels like a second home as the staff are so friendly and really go out of their way to make your stay as wonderful and stress free as possible.

reviews.title: Wonderful stay at the Bedouin Lodge
reviews.text: I made the reservation through Bedouin Divers, the dive center attached to the lodge, and they also arranged for my transfer from and to the airport.The lodge is in the perfect location, as it it not exactly in the busy center which can be reached by ten minutes walking, and it is near the end of the beach strip, so a little more tranquil and can reach the lagoon by 10-15 minutes on the bicycle. Just outside the lodge there is everything: markets, bakery, bicycle rental, food.My room was spacious. Yes, it could use some maintenance on some details, but everything worked. It even has air conditioning, a small balcony, a refrigerator and a closet. The room rate was very affordable and it included breakfast and my very own room cat. This sweet cat was dedicated to keeping me company.The restaurant has one of the nicest terraces on the strip. The atmosphere is really chill, with lots of friendly cats, a couple of sweet dogs, beautiful colours, breeze. And of course the food! Everything I had was very good, and the portions are generous (as I found them to be also in other bedouin establishments). But the best part of the Bedouin Lodge are the people, from the reception, to the restaurant, to the owner, to the dive center. Everyone was so nice and accommodating. It was very easy to make myself at home and leaving already wanting to come back.  Thank you for a wonderful stay.

reviews.title: Amazing service and great value-for-money!
reviews.text: The perfect hotel if you're looking for the true Dahab experience and want value for money. We stayed for one week and loved it. The highlights are the service, which is incredible, and the restaurant sitting area, which is beautifully decorated in the traditional Bedouin style and is the perfect place to chill out after a day of diving. The location is ideal too, a 5-minute walk to the town centre but very quiet and relaxing and right by the beach. The people are extremely friendly and everyone went out of their way to make our stay as good as possible, arranging a taxi to and from the airport, letting us check in at night, and planning day trips to tourist sites. We always felt extremely welcome and cared for.As for the accommodation, we stayed in a double room on the second floor with a balcony and a beautiful Arabic domed ceiling. The room was the perfect size for us, and we loved having the balcony to sit and read in the evenings. If you're looking for a spotlessly clean room then this place probably isn't for you (you might struggle to find that in Dahab anyway), but we didn't mind it so much. After all, with free breakfasts and amazing personal service it's great value for money!We especially recommend this hotel to anyone going to Dahab for diving. There’s an amazing dive centre (Bedouin Divers Dahab) at the same location, which was so convenient. There’s even a great diving spot right in front of the hotel: we just walked straight into the ocean in our gear!

reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.text: The bedouin lodge was recommended by some friends of mine. As it should be! First of all the vibe is very relaxed. As soon as you arrive you experience the Egyptian hospitality. You easily feel part of the community because of all the good people there! I went there to learn how to dive at the bedouin divers. If you’re lucky you have Ahmed to teach you. Great teacher, he always reflects calmness and peace of mind, I always felt safe underwater. But it’s as good as a place for non-divers too. Close to the sea, Dahab center, bike rental, shops and the lagoon. Pricing is also very good (I’m a backpacker on a budget) but that doesn’t really matter, what matters is that after staying in the bedouin lodge you can call this place a home away from home. Last of all whenever you don’t feel like going out to eat you’re in luck because the food at the bedouin lodge is very good. The Egyptian breakfast is definitely the way to go!

reviews.title: Best place ever
reviews.text: I just came back from there ,  i can not give enough credit for mr - osama , he is the most professional person  in any place in dahab , i really like the place and wish them all the best in life , sea view is great , lication is wonderful,  the hospitality  and professionalism of the reception amaze me everytime , i just feel like home there .

reviews.title: Disappointed in Dahab!
reviews.text: Paid $85 for one night stay, didn’t get the room I was promised with a junior suite with a Mountain View … room 7was dirty hand prints all over mirrored walls , bathroom not cleaned , toothpaste over taps , shower with lime scale, empty toilet roll left ,bedroom curtains hanging off the rail, ( bed was fresh and clean ) draws dirty and no handle . I heard a female shout at the staff approx 10pm nothing here is working This isn’t a hotel more of a hostel… she is right . I have stayed in Dahab many times and spent far less, and had a far better experience

reviews.title: Just Waw ! Amazing villa!
reviews.text: It is villa is more than incredible, it is breathtaking, it feels directly good, the rooms seen by the pool are majestic. I slept like a princess. Not to mention the team always with the little care they are wonderful. Thanks for everything. I would definitely recommend this villa!

reviews.title: The nicest hotel we stayed in in Dahab.
reviews.text: What a magnificent place! Slightly withdrawn so super quiet. The rooms are very comfortable. Large bathroom. We were upgraded to a larger room, which is always nice.Finally, how can we not talk about the team.Especially Ahmed, who was our advisor but also a top concierge! For everything !It’s a stone’s throw (5 minutes walk) from the center of DahabWe will come back for sure, and surely with friends…

reviews.title: Paradise in Dahab
reviews.text: Everything was perfect: the place, the calmthe swimming pool is sublime and the rooms are large and comfortable. Casa d’or a stone’s throw from the center of Dahab.Ahmed made our stay unforgettable!! We will come back to this little paradise

reviews.title: Absolute gem
reviews.text: , A unique boutique hotel in Dahab that keeps high standard year after year. Rooms are beautifully decorated, a nice swimming pool and an excellent breakfast. Thomas is a great host and together with his team makes you feel at home.Diving experience with the service the hotel offers is superb.We come back every year-!!

reviews.title: Wonderful Staff
reviews.text: Thomas, Mohammed and the team could not have done more to help. They organised our diving (which was incredible!) and airport transfers very smoothly. The room & pool area was always meticulously clean & we were left alone to enjoy the peace of the pool & sunloungers in the afternoon. Incredible breakfast too.Dahab is more developed since we were here last 24 years ago but it has still retained its charm. A perfect holiday, thank you!

reviews.title: Wonderful stay
reviews.text: Absolutely fantastic!Thomas and the team make this lovely place a home away from home.The rooms are very spacious and well kept, pool area is inviting and comfortable.The hospitality, caring and big heart of Thomas making Casa D'or a place to return to.

reviews.title: Unmatched hospitality but has issues
reviews.text: We stayed at Casa d’Or for 3 nights including New Years’ Eve and had an overall positive experience. The owner and host, Thomas, is extremely friendly – he makes his guests feel like they are being welcomed into his home. He served us fresh orange juice on arrival, cooked up dinner and shared many drinks with us on New Years’ Eve, helped us schedule transportation from the hotel, and was able to collect our laundry when we were away from the property. That said, the hotel leaves a lot to be desired. It is seemingly a passion project built by the owner and is run more like a guesthouse than a hotel. For instance, the design is unique and incohesive, though it may appeal to others. There is no formal reception, we just interacted with Thomas via Whatsapp prior to arrival. The hotel is tucked away from the main strip of Dahab and there is no road leading to the property, which made it confusing for our taxi driver to find. Because it is situated a ways from the main road, there isn’t much of a view from the hotel, just desert and construction sites. Finally, we had some issues with the room itself such as dusty floors on arrival and no hot water for 3 days. Overall, the host made our stay very enjoyable by making the experience personal instead of purely transactional but without Thomas, I don’t think we would recommend the place.

reviews.title: Making the fairytale come true!
reviews.text: We loooved staying at Casa d’Or. I mean, you truly feel like you are in a fairytale, the house is just sooooo magical! As well as the rooms, they are super spacious and beautiful. Also, the team working there is so truly welcoming, especially the amazing Dina!! These guys will make sure your stay will be amazing, that’s for sure. They truly put their heart into their work snd business and you can really feel it.The breakfast was really lovely and generous, and the diving program they helped us signing up for was really good!I can’t wait to come back. Dahab is such a special place and staying at Casa d’Or  will make it even more special!! Thank you again for the wonderful hospitality and this amazing hotel that you have built up!

reviews.title: A stay full of wonders ♥️
reviews.text: Astonishing hospitality. Impressive style. Firm standards. High hopes. Homey atmosphere. Unblended silence in the night. Wonderful stay. Will be back. P.S. Thomas, you are really exceptional host, thank you 🙏

tripadvisor.streetAddress: Peace Rd. El Mashraba, Dahab 46617 Egypt

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: We have just come back from another fantastic holiday at Dive Urge. This is the second time we have stayed here and I think this time was even better than the first! We were really looked after by Attwar and the rest of the staff. We came to dive but I think that this place would be a great place to stay even if you didn’t. It is very chilled the food is good and you are right next to the beach. Hammed, our driver took us on the dessert meal which was included in the package and it was a fantastic experience spending the evening under the stars in the silence of the desert. The diving was excellent. Youstina, Shereen, and Ben were our dive leaders over our 10 day stay and all were very good. We particularly appreciated Youstina’s underwater photos of us!A huge thank you to everyone at Dive Urge for another wonderful stay. We’re already looking forward to coming back!

reviews.title: 6th time here
reviews.text: Another GREAT stay with Dive Urge. No diving this time but they took care of us. I wanted to go to St Chathrine Monastary, no problem. We were able to just really chill and visit.I really enjoyed our stay in the Garden Rooms. They had been updated with new showers. And the lounge pit was wonderful for relaxing. The food was still outstanding.

reviews.title: Two Weeks in Paradise at Dive Urge
reviews.text: My family and I spent two wonderful weeks at Dive Urge, and it truly felt like a home away from home. This family-run boutique hotel offers everything you could wish for if you’re looking for a relaxing stay combined with incredible diving and snorkelling.We booked a dive package and also made the most of the beautiful house reef right on the doorstep. The dive guides, Youstina and Ben, were outstanding – knowledgeable, professional, and incredibly patient with me since it had been a long time since my last dive. Thanks to them, I felt confident again and got to experience some amazing dive sites, including the iconic Bells at the Blue Hole.The manager, Attwa, deserves a special mention for always being so warm and helpful. He arranged taxis for us with Hameed, who not only drove us but also doubled as the dive driver. Hameed’s friendliness, local knowledge, and passion for the sea made every journey enjoyable. He even snorkelled alongside my son on the house reef, pointing out fascinating marine life – a highlight for him!One of the most memorable experiences of our stay was the Bedouin meal included in the package. We were driven out into the desert canyons, where we enjoyed a wonderful cooked meal under the stars – with Hameed once again multi-tasking as a chef. It was an unforgettable evening that made the trip feel even more special.The hotel rooms were excellent: air-conditioned, with fridges, plenty of storage, and fresh bottled water provided daily. We especially appreciated how peaceful it was – the garden area with shady hammocks was perfect for unwinding between dives. The stay also included a complimentary airport shuttle, which was brilliantly efficient and made arriving and departing completely stress-free.We ate at Food Urge during our stay (I’ve reviewed that separately), and it was equally brilliant.All in all, Dive Urge offers incredible value, genuine hospitality, and a truly welcoming atmosphere. If you’re looking for a super-friendly place to dive, snorkel, and relax in paradise, I can’t recommend it highly enough.

reviews.title: Best dive holiday I've ever had
reviews.text: We have just spent 10 very relaxing days here and would love to return. Having breakfast on the private beach was an amazing way to start the day, and there were a large variety of restaurants very close if we wished to eat elsewhere in the evenings.The rooms themselves were clean, had good facilities and were cool. The hammock and Bedouin areas were a good place to chill out if you did not wish to sit on the beach and the whole place was very peaceful.Ben and Youstina were our dive leaders, and were very thoughtful about our dive needs and wishes, making sure we visited a variety of sights. Youstina was very thorough taking our son through his PADI Advanced Open Water.The Bedouin meal in the desert allowed us to experience the silence of the desert, including a Birthday cake under the stars………..awesome.The staff and guides were always friendly without being intrusive. Atwa, who runs the restaurant was always there to assist us.Thank you to the team at Dive Urge for making this such a great holiday

reviews.title: Amazing accommodation and diving.
reviews.text: My second stay with Dive-Urge was just as fantastic as the first, and I can't wait to go back.  You can do lots of nearby dive sites with their jeep to see eye-popping fish & coral.  The instructors are the greatest- I've done PADI Open Water and Advanced Open Water there.  The staff cannot do enough to help you and the food is freshly prepared.  It's stunningly peaceful.  Being served breakfast on the private beach is magical.  I've found my paradise.

reviews.title: Amazing stay - all thanks to the incredible team
reviews.text: We had an amazing week at Dive Urge! The location is perfect, it’s within walking distance to all the restaurants and shops, while being a quiet area for those looking for a peaceful nights sleep. Lynne, Helal and all the team are so friendly and always happy to help. We really felt at home, so much so we stayed an extra night! The rooms were clean, comfortable and equipped with everything you need. Atwa went out of his way to check on us throughout our stay - always with a smile.The diving was fantastic, Youstina and Ben are incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about what they do. We are still relatively new to diving, and the extra guidance they gave has really helped us build on our skills and confidence. If you’re not a diver, there’s incredible snorkelling directly in front of Dive Urge’s beach. Hameed’s mountain dinner is also a must - the food and tea is delicious. We highly recommend Dive Urge and will definitely be back in future :)

reviews.title: Relaxing and tranquil
reviews.text: My daughter and I have have just returned home from the most wonderfully relaxing holiday at Dive Urge. From the moment that we arrived (at 2am) where they had provided some bread and dips for us in case we were peckish ( we definitely were)!! to sorting out Doctors appointments and helping us to feel most at home. We were both treated like princesses throughout our stay and the staff are all so friendly. The Mango Smoothies and banana and chocolate pancakes are to die for! Our room was clean and cool and the outside areas shady and tranquil. I would recommend this perfect spot and hope to return again very soon.

reviews.title: The best holiday I've ever had
reviews.text: Honestly the best holiday my girlfriend and I have had, hands-down. Yes there is incredible diving, scuba diving, free diving, mountain fun etc etc, and lots of cool restaurants, beach time and epic scenery to see. But more important than anything, the world class hospitality and genuine love & care we experienced whilst we stayed with the family-run Dive Urge is something that will stay with us forever. They treated us so warmly, and attended to our every need. I consider everyone at Dive Urge to be my friend now, and have re-booked to go back and continue my diving journey with them in September (Youstina their senior dive instructor is next level - trust me she is so good at what she does). Anyway, thank you Lynn, Helal, Injie, Ben, Attwar, Mahmoud, Youstina and everyone else at Dive Urge that showed us some much love. My girlfriend & I cant wait to hang with you guys again...

reviews.title: Relaxing stay by the beach.
reviews.text: Lovely stay at Dive Urge. The room was clean with a comfortable bed. There were tea and coffee making facilities and a fridge with snacks. The Egyptian breakfasts are recommended, the coffee is good and the service was friendly. Being able to get into the sea straight from the beach is great.

reviews.title: Fantastic Diving Experience
reviews.text: Dive Urge provided an enjoyable and professional service.  My friend and I had a fantastic time exploring different dive sites, including the Blue Hole.Our scuba instructor was friendly, professional and went the extra mile to make our experience truly memorable.The rooms were clean, comfortable and secure.The resort staff were very friendly and so keen to make our stay enjoyable.Aside from the great reputation Dive Urge has for scuba diving, they also have their own, private beach with drinking and eating areas.  You can sun bathe and stare at the turquoise magic of the red sea whilst sipping a mango lassie.  The food provided by the restaurant is reasonably priced and good!  And the beach was only a 30-second walk from the guest rooms!We were also so impressed with the complimentary Bedouin dinner.  Good food, friendly people and stars above us.Thank you for a wonderful stay!

reviews.title: Misled by positive reviews: the hotel suffers from poor basic standards in various areas including hygiene..
reviews.text: The hotel was close to everything, right by the sea, which was incredible.The state of this hotel suggests a management more focused on revenue than the guest experience. Parts of the upstairs terrace are dilapidated and potentially dangerous. I pointed out two obvious maintenance flaws that had been neglected for some time; although they were fixed within hours, it is disappointing that such simple, cost-free repairs weren't handled sooner.Hygiene was also a concern, specifically regarding a staff member serving breakfast. Furthermore, poor communication led to unnecessary inconvenience. While the staff apologised profusely, the exposed electrical cables running past our balcony and the damaged masonry are unacceptable for one of the most expensive hotels in the area.One should realize the high price is purely for the location, which has its own drawbacks. The hotel is opposite coffee shops that play very loud music late into the night; since the windows are not soundproof, sleep is difficult. In our 'high-category' room, the extractor fan was as loud as a compressor, and the sink leaked through a hole, which they merely patched with silicone after I complained. Between the low-quality amenities and the poor breakfast, I had to apologise to my wife for booking us into Club Red Motel for three nights.

reviews.title: Very Recommended
reviews.text: Place full of vibes Very friendly stuff, professional, care about details, hospitality, the keep the old dahab vibes with modern styleFood is delicious, pool cafe making amazing drinks.Rooms have amazing view pool view or sea view Centre of the city, so everything is nearby

reviews.title: Great hotel.
reviews.text: The hotel is located in a central area in dahab close to the beach, cafes and restaurants. The staff is very friendly and helpful. Hagar, Fatima and Bebo are very decent and knowledgeable. The facility is very clean and well maintained and offers a very laid back atmosphere.

reviews.title: The best bet in Dubai
reviews.text: My first visit was a pleasant choice to stay at this hotelIts prime location amidst a lively street and wide size of sea view rooms The cleanliness of the rooms, bathroom and facilities are impeccable and this is one of the most important things to choose a home while travelling so my next visit to Dubai will be the hotel itselfThe hotel staff is friendly and friendly to thank you

reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.text: To summarize,it's home away from home. We love this place. Booked twice here. The staff are really amazing and you feel very welcome. The rooms are spacious and clean with a nice view.  The location is perfect next to supermarkets and cafes. The area is lively.

reviews.title: Nice hotel in a central location with amazing staff
reviews.text: Booked a room with ocean view and that i got...really nice view from the 1. floor balcony over the ocean and the city lights at night.The room has a good size, refridgerator, good size cabinet, safe, aircon, the usual coffee/tea/water and comfortable beds...all you need.The wobbly sink and other things could need a touch up, but it's not the Ritz Carlton and everything works and is clean :)Since it is a hotel in the middle of the city with the promenade and restaurants right outside, you have to expect noise day and night time, but that is expected when you want to be close to everything with a view...earplugs did it for me :)If you want less noise book a room with garden/pool view or the bungalow on the top where youre just a little further away from everything...downside is just the missing ocean view.The garden is really nice, with a covered breakfast bar, pool, poolbeds, lounge area and toilets...ask for towels at the bar.It's not a night bar where you can buy beer and tequila sunrise, but you can bring your own beer to the garden and if you need more everything is really close :)The staff...amazing!Bibo: friendly funny lowkey guy who managed it while i was there.Hager: always helping, really sweet and with a charming contagious laughter :)Mogley: the guy that everybody in town knows and the entertainment and fixer...if you go out with him, watch out he does not fall in a ditch :)If you see 2 staff people who sometimes sound like they are an old married couple, even if they are far from, it's Hager and Mogley :DAll staff is really great and always ready to walk that extra mile for you, no matter the time of the day!They even arranged a bbq night with plenty of good food and good atmosphere and can also arrange tours :)The balcony doors could be thicker to keep out noise, the annoying guy downstairs room 2 could stop playing with and irritating his dog some mornings at 6.30 and some minor cosmetic details tells me to give 4 stars...but your in Dahab in Egypt and the experience and the staff makes me give 5 :)If you want a good, cosy, chill, reasonably priced hotel with a lot of features close to everything, with a view over the city and ocean and with an amazing staff...this is the place :)

reviews.title: Best vacation and celebration of my birthday
reviews.text: Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for relaxing and safe place , it’s family friendly and i like everything, they’re taking care of you and do their best to make you comfortable and happy.Thanks everyone work here specially Bebo .

reviews.title: Discovering Club Red Dahab - A Simple Motel with Exceptional Heart
reviews.text: The Club Red Motel delighted us with its warm hospitality and thoughtful service, proving that genuine care and a welcoming atmosphere can elevate a stay far beyond conventional star ratings. This blend of modesty and quality made our time not just satisfactory, but memorably pleasing, highlighting the essence of true hospitality and earning it a five-bubble rating experience.From the get-go, the staff at Club Red were incredibly welcoming. Their approach to hospitality was effortless and professional, making it clear that they were there to make our stay as comfortable as possible. Booking through Booking.com was a breeze, and the communication with the motel was impressively swift.Our room came with a balcony that offered a stunning view of the sea—a feature that quickly became our favorite. The trade-off was the noise from the nearby seaside restaurants and bars. During the off-season when we visited, this was manageable, but I could see it being more of a concern during busier times. Thankfully, the motel offers garden-view rooms for those seeking quieter nights.The room itself was cozy and just what we needed. As nights in January through March can get a bit chilly, the availability of quilts or duvets was a thoughtful touch that we appreciated.Breakfast was simple but satisfying. It was good to see that there was some flexibility to tweak it to our liking. While it catered well to our tastes, our youngest, who's on the pickier side, would have loved some cereals or pancakes.Reflecting on my stay, Club Red Dahab is a reminder that the heart of a good motel doesn't lie in its star rating but in the experiences it offers and the memories it helps create. For those looking for a place to stay that serves as a comfortable base to explore Dahab, Club Red is definitely worth considering. Despite being a two-star motel, the experience felt much richer, proving that sometimes, less really is more.

reviews.title: Basic - but good value for money
reviews.text: Fairly basic - but clean and friendly staff - Dahab is a centre for diving so really just a place to sleep.  Staff were happy to do a pack up breakfast for us.Enjoyed drinking  tea with the staff in the evening.If your room does not have a safe - they have secure boxes in reception

reviews.title: Very nice stay in the centre of Dahab
reviews.text: Last minute booking (10mins before check in!). Hagar and her team did admirably in getting the room cleaned and ready for us very quickly. We got a good sized seaview room. Staff was super friendly and accomodating.Accomodations were clean and functional, albeit basic. As we were there for a diving holiday, this fitted us perfectly. The room came with a large fridge which came in handy for chilling drinks and keeping fruit. Airconditioning worked well. Wifi was unfortunately too slow for anything other than basic messaging/emails (we used 4G for everything else - SIM card from Sharm airport was cheaper than in Dahab). Water pressure will disappoint those into american style showers.Location is good - smack in the middle of town on the promenade between the two halves of town (Masbat and Mashraba). Plenty of good restaurants in the area, plus a major supermarket 50 yards awayHotel had a pool and dive centre but we did not use either (no time - Dahab is quite charming). Free breakfast at 9am, but they were happy to provide a packed breakfast as we were already out for the day by 8.30am.There wer also evening activities pool side but were were usually asleep by then.We would be happy to use again when next in the area.

tripadvisor.streetAddress: on the waterfront in Mashraba area, beside the Police Station P.O. Box 12, Dahab Egypt

reviews.title: ♥️We had an amazing stay and truly loved the experience
reviews.text: A very comfortable, family-friendly, and clean hotel. The staff are excellent and incredibly tasteful. The hotel has a unique location, very close to the promenade, yet very quiet. The designs are distinctive, and every place is suitable for photography.It will definitely be our permanent hotel in Dahab ♥️♥️

reviews.title: #top hospitality
reviews.text: i went with my friends booked 2 rooms with my friends they were absolutely spot on clean , the breakfast was delicious, the water isn't salty at all ,both the drinks and activities they provide are 👌🏽

reviews.title: Very nice hotel
reviews.text: Very nice hotel, very clean rooms and utilities.. All hygiene measures are considered.. Staff is very nice, friendly and comforting, The place itself is very cozy.. Hotel is close to all shops, restaurants and Cafes.. I very much recommend this hotel..

reviews.title: Excellente accommodation (cosy, helpful staff and good location)
reviews.text: “Everything was great:- The location is good; quiet and next to the Delta Bus Company Stop that can take you to Sharm.- in a couple of minutes away you can reach the main street in Dahab with plenty of shops, cafés, restaurants- In front of the Hotel there is a bike rental store- The breakfast was big enough and delicious, and every day was slightly different- The staff is super nice and they are there for you if you need something (Mohammed is a super good guy and helpful)- The swimming pool is a plus and it is cleaned every morning- I would indeed go back there in case I am in Dahab- I felt really at ease at the hotel- It is very safe down there”Well done guys, keep it on :)

reviews.title: Spacious rooms.
reviews.text: Enjoyed my stay there, rooms are spacious and clean with reasonable prices. The room had a kitchenette with a partition, making it more comfortable to stay in. The water was filtered and not salty at all which is uncommon in dahab. Totally recommend it.

reviews.title: Amazing experience!
reviews.text: The hotel staff are very friendly and flexible. We actually had to adjust our stay more than once and they were very flexible and understanding. The rooms are clean and practical. The ACs are excellent. The pool was great and they clean it twice a day. We had unlimited access to wifi, huge smart tv, and huge bluetooth speakers. We enjoyed several movie nights and pool parties! It’s located in the heart of Dahab, just a walking distance from Dahab’s main street and everything we need. Also just a 2 minutes walk to the sea. 30 minutes walk to the Lagoona, which is the best beach in Dahab in my opinion. It’s also a 5 minutes walk from the bus station. The prices were super affordable for a group of young adults like us. Amazing experience. Will definitely go again. Totally recommend this place!

reviews.title: Wauuu🎉💐 see soon
reviews.text: I really wanted to congratulate you Mohamed Dahab I recommend it! A small hotel in the heart of Dahab where you are greeted with familiarity cleanliness and courtesy bravo bravo we will be back to see you soon heartfelt thanks we stayed 4 days in full relax 🎉🎉🎉Patrizia and Shady from Italy

reviews.title: Totally recommend it!:)
reviews.text: Don’t look any further!:) The place has great location (way more quiet than places near pedestrian area), still very close to the anything you may need (markets, restaurants, bars, etc.). The room are big, have high ceiling, AC and fridge.Beds are super comfy with hard pillows - never slept better:).Pool is being kept in a good condition all the time.Service is way beyond your expectations and Mohammed is as helpful as your Mum;).You can communicate in English of course and he knows anything you are interested in.The place is tidy and secure. The rates are affordable and competitive taking into account what you get.As I wrote in the beginning: don’t look any further - if there are availabilities book and you are all set to explore Dahab and the surroundings!:)

reviews.title: Great Hotel Outstanding Manager
reviews.text: Stayed for 11 days really enjoyed my stay. Mohammed is a great host, nothing to much trouble and always genuine concern for my well being and enjoyment. Location great near local top rated restaurants Yum Yum and King Chicken ,shops and supermarkets. Beach is around 5 minutes stroll. Rooms have a/c, hot water,TV, fridge and Mohammed provided a kettle for morning cuppa, many rooms newly decorated. Pool was great and very clean, nice sitting areas to relax. Mohamed arranged trips for me which where excellent and very good value. Really enjoyed my stay came as guest left as friemd

reviews.title: Excellent hotel. Muhamed is excellent host.
reviews.text: We stayed for a week. The room was big. It included 2 bed rooms (3 bed + double & single) . It was great for family of 2 girls, 1 boy and parents. The room has nice entrance with minimal kitchen and big fridge. We used the fridge to cool 2 giant mineral water and had supply of cold & fresh water for our stay. Muhamed is excellent host. Friendly and helped us a lot to organize activities around Dahab.The hotel pool is great. The location is 5 min walk from the Lighthouse. We loved the place and hospitality.

reviews.title: I don't want to return them at all
reviews.text: Of the worst experiences unfortunately and the breakfast was not good at all, the rooms were sweet, the bathroom was old and new and the hotel is a 4-star hotel on my booking and is one-star and just as much as the price for a stay you could have loved the most beautiful hotel in Kairo But they first claimed he wasn't on Poking, and after they discovered he was dead by an independent host, he was in a floating hole and two in a lounge.

reviews.title: Excellent location
reviews.text: Stayed here for 2 nights with my group tour. Great location at the end of the tourist strip.Old buildings with rooms needing a well overdue refurbishment.My room was spacious and clean. The fridge and TV worked fine but the lighting was sub standard. As it was winter I did not use the aircon.The bed linens were clean and afforded a comfortable sleep.The bathroom was small. Excellent consistent hot water with adequate pressure.My balcony provided great sea views although both days it was blowing a gale along the coastline.I don't know the room costs but what I gather from reading reviews it is a budget hotel.Overall, it served my needs but as a group tour hotel I was not impressed.

reviews.title: Bad bad bad horrible
reviews.text: A very bad hotel and the reception changes its words every little bit and something is suffocating and the manager has a negative response and the place is literally not suitable for any trip. They want any money and that's it. I was booking the Sea View room and went to find her looking at the cafeteria and saying, sorry, what is the sea there?

reviews.title: Great pools and location
reviews.text: Great value hotel at the end of the promenade 15mins easy walk into the centre.  Excellent reef out in front for snorkelling.  Can be noisy around the main pool if large groups are staying, but there is a great smaller pool behind for children and relaxing. Very good helpful service.

reviews.title: Dyarna♥️
reviews.text: I loved this Hotel too much and i found Comfort and Rest at this place specially with good staff and Good Restaurant.....Every time i come to Dahab i Book with Dyarna and i feel like Home ..Rooms are clean always and viewing well ..Thanks for all Staff

reviews.title: Good value for money
reviews.text: Review for the hotel:Location : 5/5Near everything, centrally located at a quite and relaxing areaRooms: 2/5Rooms are super old, mattress are the worst, windows and doors are passing wind because its too oldSleeping quality: 2/5Mattress is aweful , you can hear everyone moving or talking at the hotel from your roomStaff: 5/5Very helpful and nice staffBreakfast: 3/5Limitied food varities, it was okayOverall experience 2/5The hotel is a good value for money but it needs to be renovated in terms of rooms at least since it has very nice location

reviews.title: Fantastic location
reviews.text: We have been visiting this hotel on and off for the last 15 years. It has had a lot of money spent on renovations and new TVs and A/ C systems. The buffet breakfast by Omar is superb. The only problem we had was groups of people talking around the pool at 1.30am when we trying to sleep. Maybe we are too old! Still our go to hotel in Dahab.

reviews.title: Great place for relaxation and enjoying the beautiful city of Dahab
reviews.text: Very cozy hotel, at a perfect location for being very near of the main attraction area of the city, meanwhile not too close so it's a very quiet areaStaff are very friendly and cooperative, and the place is quite cleansome maintenance need to be taken care of, especially the mattresses

reviews.title: Good hotel stay in Dahab
reviews.text: Good hotel near the sea ,clean rooms  ,on the hotel areas three is good diving center ,rooms have ac and tv,you can get room with sea view it’s really beatiful in 3 min walk nice German bakery with amazing coffee and pharmacy ,shops Swimming pool also nice Diving center here  offer diving courses and they really good ones if you have never dive before you can get open water padi or advanced or etc Really nice place to stay in Dahab

reviews.title: If you want average cost for sea view
reviews.text: The room was directly on the sea view and i were looking for view like that Water was good , A/C was good Pool is open 24\7 and this is nice for me to do after party with some friends Don't ask Room service after 12 clock ⏰

reviews.title: The place was very disgusting
reviews.text: The room was disgusting , the toilet was very dirty and they didn’t change there filthy toilet seats for a long time , every thing was smelly it was a very bad experience for me , place i will never go again  and I don’t recommend it to any one at all .

reviews.title: Bad Experience - Elrayga Camp-Dahab
reviews.text: I had a very disappointing experience. I initially booked one night and informed the receptionist that I might extend my stay. However, the neighborhood and the room were both unclean, and the room itself was in serious need of maintenance. I was genuinely concerned about hygiene, especially with the bed and bathroom—the flush tank wasn’t even functioning. After I raised these issues, the receptionist moved me to another room, which was slightly better. Unfortunately, there was no electricity or water early in the morning of the following day. I decided to check out rather than extend my stay, and no one collected feedback or seemed concerned about my experience. I do not recommend this place at all.

reviews.title: i had the best 2 weeks every in my life with you guys. thank you soo much <3
reviews.text: if you really want to feel Dahab Vibes, ElRayga is the place , its not just a camp , its fully equipped camp if your solo traveler or with friends, they have many room options, private and shared, i was in a hut as in the photo , its very safe i didn't even have to close the door while i was away, the staff if incredibly friendly and helpful,The shard WC and kitchen is very clean and convenient, the rooms are very clean and beds are very comfy, very hospital and the vibs is amazing in this place, i have checked more than 30 resorts, camps , hotels at Dahab, and i found Elrayga have the best Value / money / Vibs in the town.The also Organize trips so you will have every thing u need in the place. The location is very unique its very close to El mamsha, and the sea and the main road.Thank you For ElRayga team and management for keeping it the way it is.Special thanks to Mr Emad: El Rayga owner, Mr Farghaly camp manager , Mr Anas and Mr Nouby from the reception team,Mr Mohamed, Mr Aly, Mr Ahmed and Mr Malek , and every one else i my for get to mention.i had the best 2 weeks every in my life with you guys. thank you soo much <3

The only person who was somehow decent in the management was hajar, the rest were terrible and they were literally fighting in front of our rooms. The air conditioners broke down every now and then. The breakfast was inedible and literally samples not actual food. To conclude, I wouldn’t recommend this hotel for anyone looking to enjoy their time.

Never stay there again waste of money and time.

reviews.title: Best hotel in DAHAB
reviews.text: This is my second stay in this hotel. The accommodation price is reasonable and the staff is very friendly and welcoming us in very decent way specially mr.joe. I highly recommend this hotel. The food quality was amazing and the restaurant service was great and overlooking the sea ,also they are 24/7 available having a varied menu. Ask for Mr.mohamed if you would like exceptional service he assisted us in having  a trips  and car with very special rates. The hotel location is very central and very cozy that made us feel home! We are definitely going back again.

reviews.title: Ghazala Dahab
reviews.text: A nice small hotel. My Husband, Bella (our pet) and I had a wonderful experience. Every staff member we encountered, from the reception to the restaurant and beach workers were friendly, delightful and eager to help! If you do not like dark bed sheets and towels, bring your own.Thank you! Will recommend to my colleagues!

reviews.title: Ghazala Lounge/Restaurant
reviews.text: The food was very nice. Most of the guests have been working on their computers which was not very supportive for a nice ambiente. The service personnel was present but not really interested in offering a good service. 10% service charche was included in the bill so it didn't seem necessary to be friendly. We didn't really feel welcome or like in a lounge, it felt more like an open working space which we aren't looking for in our holidays.

reviews.title: It was my first time to visit Dahab ♥️
reviews.text: I travelled to dahab in November And I was a little bit nervous as it was my first time as a solo traveller..but it turned out to be unforgettable.. you really get to know yourself when you are alone.So I started my trip at athanor lounge.. which is in a perfect location in Al fanar street , the neighborhood feels very familiar and people are nice.. right down the lounge there is a restaurant and Caffe called athanor pizzaeria and it is one of the best in Dahab ♥️I have reserved some amazing trips to abou galoum, blue hole and the blue lagoon and stayed for 1 night in el omda camp Price for night was 100  egp and the dinner was for 100 egp breakfast for 50 egp I also visited the 3 pools , enjoyed some amazing places on beach like ghazala cafe and restaurant ( I didn't like their food) I visited wadi star ( twilight mountains)I also enjoyed my stay at planet oasis for 3 nights  , But if you are going to stay there , stay away from the budget room

reviews.title: Worst Camp ever
reviews.text: One of the worst if not the worst hotel in dahabStaff treats guests in a rude way and they kept staring at us from the moment we arrived which made us feel very uncomfortable

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: You basically pay for what you get ...if you don't mind wherever you sleep or if facilities are clean or not then this place is for you but if you want clean facilities and a descent sleeping room then this place is Not for you. I would rather sleep in a tent than this place ..it's noisey, very dirty outside shared  bathroom and rooms  are Not secure ...I definitely would not recommend this place to anyone.

reviews.title: Home sweet home
reviews.text: It is a nice motivating place we enjoyed all the activities and I feel like I am living with my family

reviews.title: The best hotel 🏨
reviews.text: The best hotel ever in all dahab , service atmosphere value of money and great friendly staff,  highly recommend 👌

reviews.title: Planet hotel
reviews.text: It was really great place to stay the hospitality was amazing and the rooms were great also the location

reviews.title: Was nice
reviews.text: Was a great place to stay close to everything

reviews.title: The reception guy is very nice
reviews.text: Let’s start with the receptionist who been super nice , welcoming, friendly and cooperative , he gives you that home feeling from the 1st moment , rooms are clean and I really like it as it’s great value for money , then let us go to the restaurant ,  breakfast is nice , BUT the chef is a bit weirdo  , however the hotel overall is amazing and we will go back whenever we can

reviews.title: Good choice
reviews.text: We stayed for 3 nights in the sea view suit ... enjoyed it of course The hotel has a perfect location in the center of the town , luxury , has a small pool . They serve a good breakfast ( open buffet) The suit was spacious ,air conditioned , 2 toilets- despite the bad smell from both  - and amazing terrace view The staff were friendly , polite and helpful.

reviews.title: Good Experience
reviews.text: Was my first time there , I stayed for 3 nights , Overall it was good location was perfectBreakfast was poor no varietyClean rooms & nice staffLoved the cats there , they were soo nice and neutered ;)

reviews.title: Good option:)
reviews.text: Clean, spacious, close to everything. Rooms are big and convenient. Staff is extremely friendly, breakfast options are varied, location is prime. Prices are very reasonable. The pool adds a nice touch. Cleanliness is truly noteworthy. We will be back:)

reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text: I stayed for 2 nights. The room was clean, except some mold in the toilet. The FCU was loud, and didn't cool the room very well. The staff was good and friendly. There were several families there, some from Sharm El Sheikh. It was fun for the kids. It's close enough to the main walk, but far enough that you don't hear it.

reviews.title: Good one
reviews.text: The location was excellent , the atmosphere was perfect , the ppl were friendly the breakfast was very good But there wasn't shampoo at the bathroomOverall the quality of service equal the paid money

reviews.title: Beautiful Walk of God
reviews.text: My family and the refu Hotel have been so helpful to me, the couscous and its impeccable amenities in the middle of the price are now actually more than a delight.

reviews.title: Worst experience
reviews.text: The dirtiest hotel anyone can go to, seriously, if I would never enter it again, there is no cleanliness, the dirtiest rooms are unchanged, and the furnishings are not changed. After every time I go in, I find the mattresses dirty and with hair on them, and the air conditioning is flooded. The room is not clean, the service is not at all, and the clothes do not shed their filth. Really, no one should be deceived by the pictures because they are different.

reviews.title: Very bad
reviews.text: Summary of reviews on Google3.0295 reviews5 ★4 ★3 ★2 ★1 ★Reviews on other travel sitesReviewsSearch reviewshany farouk1 out of 5Now on GoogleOn 7/21/2023 until 7/24/2023, what is called the Sea Sun Hotel in the city of Dahab was booked, and we were surprised that the pictures published on the hotel’s page are completely contrary to reality, starting with the minimum need for towels instead of bathrobes, through to the lack of refrigerators in the rooms and rooms with refrigerators. It is only skeletal, has a clear glass, and is attached to the pictures, and it does not work at all. The bed mattresses are torn and full of insects. The floors are not clean at all. The hotel reception is dark at night. There are no security personnel from the hotel entrance to the beach. There are no surveillance cameras. The kitchen is substandard with rusted and broken equipment. The walls are broken and there is no electricity outside. Without coverage, access to the fire alarms was charred and burned, as shown in the attached pictures.... We were a group of about 25 to 30 people with children in the rooms and elderly people, and with them insulin medications that had expired due to the lack of refrigerators, and all those in charge of the hotel were completely unqualified, both in their place and after many attempts with them. To remedy these existing negatives, they pledged dozens of times to solve them, to no avail or appreciation, so 2 reports were made via 122 Rescue. Quickly, a number of those in charge of the place contacted us after a period of complete neglect and made the final promise of a solution. However, after waiving the second report, nothing was resolved. .Note: The pictures are for room No. 102, for example, and the mat is worn, and there is a group of pictures showing the situation as it was in nature.

reviews.title: Best hotel
reviews.text: One from the best and quite hotel so comfortable to stay we like it so much the people there are very nice. friendly and helpful so for sure we will recommend it to everyone as we like dahab so much and now we know where will stay❤️

reviews.title: Comfort stay
reviews.text: It’s very nice and comfortable cozy hotel ; in blue hole way road and we feel quite and comfortable ; we stay in sea view room amazing one ; and staff are very polite and helpful ; I do recommended and sure we will back soon

reviews.title: Dirty
reviews.text: First of all ,the staff are very decent,although they are about 4 or 5 in all the hotel . the hotel is very dirty , there is no service at all , cleanlinees is absent as i found a hair on the bed sheets from the previous guests and the plumbing is damaged even the breakfast is very poor , there is no any beverages except tea only and even the tea you have to make it  by yourself by kettle,dirty two plates with sugar and tea and dirty water cups . it is really a bad experience in this hotel.

reviews.title: NO SERVICE AT ALL
reviews.text: NO toilet papers,NO towels, sheets are dirty, toilet leaks water on the bathroom floor.Breakfast is ok nothing fancy, but no coffee only black tea It is short-staffed that is why there is no care for the hotel or guests

reviews.title: Cannot believe this place is still open
reviews.text: I wrote a review on this hotel around 5/6 years ago and it wasn’t a very good one at all, out of curiosity I thought I would have a look at recent reviews written. I know there are genuinely good and bad reviews on most holidays however on this one the bad reviews are genuine it sounds like this place has not changed at all a lot of things are still the same, one of the things that stood out when we visited was that they put myself and my husband in a villa on the sea front for us to share with someone else  , we expressed our thoughts on this as we had booked a room for just us two then they put us in another room classed as superior then tried to get us to upgrade for more money, if this has happened to anyone recently visiting it is a scam, the food was disgusting, staff were consistently arguing with each other in front of guests, they kept running out of beer, issues with broken plastic around the pool and lots of other issues were consistent and sound like they still are. I am writing a review again as I don’t want anyone to waste their hard earned cash on this dump as there does not seem to be any changes going on.

reviews.title: Zeft
reviews.text: It’s terrible place I have ever seen No one comes to cleaning 🧹 Room without lights only 2 The 🚽 is terrible and no light 💡Service oooooh what this world means there is no service at allAnd about pools it’s very dirty there

reviews.title: Worst hotel i've ever seen in my life
reviews.text: There room was dirty as a public toilet, i've found hairs on the matress from the previous guests, there was a gum stuck in the toilet floor, no air conditioner,no wifi and the pool is as dirty as a sewer.I haven't seen anyone get into the pool during my stay.The part that made this stay near bearable was the sea view.

reviews.title: Budget hotel in downtown
reviews.text: Last week I spent 5 nights there. I choose this hotel because it's located in downtown nearby everything you need supermarket, pharmacy and restaurants. I think it's new building the furniture is new, my room existed flat tv,Mini bar, a/c and hot shower. There isn't kettle. The breakfast is okay. The staff is friendly and helpful I asked them for sèche cheveux, soap and they arranged for me the trip to wady weshwashy. It's a nice accomodation for whom has plans for morning or diver will spend most of time in activity.

reviews.title: Clean and comfortable
reviews.text: Very clean and best budget friendly hotel in Dahab. This hotel has more good reviews then all the hotels together in Dahab. I always check to make sure if everything is clean and comfortable and indeed it is. The staff is super friendly and very helpful in everything you need. They arranged everything we asked always with a smile. The beds are very comfortable and there is a television and coffee and tea in the room. They actually have a lot of services I didn't expect so definitely know where to come back next time. Thanks guys!

reviews.title: Budgetary Hotel..
reviews.text: It is a budgetary hotel, you can use it to spend the whole day outside and come back to sleep..Blankets wasn’t too clean nor bed cover..You have to ask for towels too many times, (better to get yours)Some rooms have kettle, you have to be lucky..Noise at the morning by workers and night by other clients :))

reviews.title: Very Good Experience
reviews.text: Very nice and quiet place and good location near everythingEverything is cleanStaff are Very friendly always meeting you with a nice smile, always showing willingness to helpGood room service / hot shower available/ and nice breakfastThanks Mr. Osama & Mr. Saeed for everything💕

reviews.title: Great place!!
reviews.text: This place is great! The rooms are simple but very clean and things seem new. The staff are the best part, helped us with so many things after we arrived super late at night. They really wanted us to have a great time and cared about us. The inner courtyard with the pool and the breakfast are all very nice. Stay here even if just for some good Dahab hospitality!

reviews.title: Amazing experience!
reviews.text: Staff is very hospitable and friendly, they let us leave our bags here for the day, gave us tea and picked us up from the taba border. The rooms are clean and safe and the breakfast was delicious! Amazing experience!

reviews.title: Best hospitality in all of Egypt
reviews.text: This place is great! Its a little walk to the main hub in Dahab but you get to experience all of Dahab in this walk, so its pretty nice. The staff here are so nice and friendly. They always want to help you and are very accommodating. They turned my Egypt trip around and i had a great 5 days here. If i come back to Dahab i am definitely stay here. Thank you to the whole staff.

reviews.title: Modern, clean facilities & great staff
reviews.text: We stayed at Golden Plaza Dahab Resort for 5 nights and it was a really pleasant stay. The hotel is fairly new, there is warm water in the shower and free drinkable water at the reception. The staff is super friendly and attentive - they provided us with fresh bed sheet and towels on request. Otherwise the room gets cleaned every time you leave a sign on the doorknob when you leave. The breakfast is good, but it needs a bit of variety (during our 5-day stay it was the same breakfast each morning). Overall, we had a really nice stay and we would come back if we find ourselves in Dahab again.

reviews.title: Special Atmosphere
reviews.text: Perfect location on the main road just a walking distance from the hustle of the center so that you get a bit of both relaxation and activities whenever you need. Staff are very welcoming and friendly. The owners are at the hotel most of the time ready to make golden plaza your second home. I immediately felt as part of the family. Rooms are newly built giving you a modern brand new experience. Very clean with daily room service.  Free Hot drinks in the room and mineral water at the reception. The roof gives you a relaxing opportunity to watch the sun as it rises from the sea from the comfort of your hotel.

reviews.title: Perfect stay
reviews.text: Couldn’t have asked for a better stay. It’s clean, comfortable, and in a great location. Nina is very helpful and friendly. Couldn’t recommend it enough!

reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: A very nice, clean and fully sufficient coach house for a diving trip.Only 7 rooms a small central courtyard, a main office/lounge with soft drinks fridge you use and write down what you took!Some rooms are double beds and some are two single beds. Specify what you want.Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel in quiet & convenient location just a few minutes' walk from everything
reviews.text: Stunning hotel in a quiet street just a few minutes' walk from all the hustle and bustle of the Beachfront Promenade in one direction, and the recommended breakfast spot, Ralph's German Bakery, in the other direction.The room has really comfortable beds, spacious bathroom, refrigerator, tea/coffee-making facilities, TV and lots of different lighting which make it easy to relax and unwind.There's a few communal areas such as the rooftop terrace, tables in the small courtyard, and some indoor seating. You can help yourself to soft drinks, tallying them on a whiteboard so you can pay on checkout. Beach towels are freely available to borrow, and the wi-fi is superb!The owner leaves you to freely enjoy the hotel so you feel really at home. But he is always available whenever you need any help or advice for any aspect of your trip.Highly recommended; it really is a home away from home.

reviews.title: A gem!
reviews.text: I only have good things to say about my stay here. My room was spacious and well equipped, bathroom was big and clean, the location was good and so on. They have taken great pains to ensure that all needs for short term and long term rasidents are taken care of.  The place has a well equipped common kitchen  and a common utility area. The part I liked the most  was the 3-4 sitting areas in the property , where one can just relax.Khaled was kind , responsive and gracious. Will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Wonderful place
reviews.text: For the second time I stayed at coach house in dahab. Such a welcoming lovely place. It’s everything that I need. Close to the beach and the diving centers. Lots of small terasses if you need some space. Lovely clean room. I will come back!

reviews.title: Always great to be in Dahab - and at Coachhouse!
reviews.text: I was already for the second time in Dahab and at Coachhouse and I will do it again ;)It's a great place to stay, everything is clean, the owners (Nina and Khaled) are very nice!Can only recommend it!

reviews.title: Best place in Dahab
reviews.text: Thanks again for a lovely stay in Coachhouse. I stayed here for 3 weeks and loved the place. The Coachhouse is located in a quite area but within one minute you reach the beach promenade with all the restaurants and shops. The rooms are very cozy and nicely decorated and the housekeeper does an excellent job keeping the rooms clean.  I will always return to this place. See you again soon.

reviews.title: Saved me during the last few days!
reviews.text: First off, Nina was great checking me in.  The shared spaces make for a communal feel and meeting the other guests was very seamless.  The room itself is wonderful- good space, nice clean bathroom.  Khaled totally saved me a few days before check out.  I had come down with severe food poisoning and was planning to just wait it out.  He recommended a trip to the doctor's and I'm glad I took his advice.  The food poisoning was accompanied by a 39C fever and the local doctor prescribed a few things that took away the agony that same evening.  I was good to go the next day before my long flight home.  Khaled also arranged the taxi to the doctor's, in addition to the follow up visit (the driver stayed with me, so I didn't have to worry about the ride back to the Coachhouse).  Khaled even handled a transaction with a restaurant I had booked with the night I got sick- he made sure the money I owed the restaurant was properly transferred to them.

reviews.title: Perfect place
reviews.text: Thank you for yet another wonderful stay in Coachhouse. I must have tried most rooms there now, all very nice, comfortable and with different décor.  I especially like that it is small place with only eight rooms. The housekeeper does a very good job keeping the rooms and surrounding areas clean, and the staff is very helpful and friendly.  I enjoyed spending time in the beautiful courtyard or garden with all its plants. The place is very quiet even if it is just a around the corner from the beach promenade and everything you need.  I don’t mind not being served breakfast as the famous German Bakery is just 2 minutes walk away, or I will prepare myself some breakfast in the well-equipped  and spotlessly clean kitchen.  Airport transfer can be arranged and the owners will help if you wish to book trips or answer any questions you might have. For quality like this I do have to say the value for money is great. I will definitely be back!

reviews.title: Wonderful located accomodation with a beautiful atmosphere
reviews.text: The Coachhouse is located in a quiet area of Dahab but within one minute by foot you already reach the beach promenade. It is a very familiar relation with the owners, Khaled and Nina. They take very good care of the customers and always try their best to satisfy their needs. The Coachhouse itself has a very nice ambiente. You can relax in the backyard or the front entrance. The kitchen is very clean as well as the rooms. The rooms are equipped with AC and very cozy. The transfer to the airport was managed by Khaled and went without any problems. If you go diving I would recommend Sinai Divers Backpackers!Very very beauftiful house! Thank you for the wonderful time, Khaled and Nina!

reviews.title: Great staff with nice rooms
reviews.text: It's a very nice place with a great staff that cares About their guests.

reviews.text: Very bad hotelIt is not clean and the bed sheets are torn, the room is very dusty, the bathroom is more than bad and smells bad, air conditioning.A broken refrigerator and insects walking in the roomI was home for a week. I walked away the second day because I found a mouse in the roomHe is actually the worker of the abandoned houseHowever, I had booked two weeks before that from Booking, and when I went, they had no knowledge and there were no rooms ready.Worst experience ever

reviews.title: Four star paradise
reviews.text: The staff was very excellent and truly made my stay here enjoyable. The location was perfect if you want to be away from the crowd with a pool and private Beach that was nice. The price was very affordable, really decent price on the Agoda app. A free breakfast with a very large variety of quality food made it one of the favorite Hotel stays I have ever had.

reviews.title: The worst hotel ever
reviews.text: This hotel doesn’t even deserve one star. There is no cleanliness at all, room was full of insects. Air conditioning in the room was not working. The food was awful, me and my husband stayed there for 4 days and everyday breakfast was exactly the same and very limited, food was no washed. I definitely do not recommend staying there. Bad location and terrible service which is equal to zero. No tea, coffee or even water in the rooms, for the 4 days we stayed there nobody came to clean the room or change the bedding. To get to the town you need to pay 100 Egyptian Pounds to go and come back. The pool was not cleaned, green from the amount of urine in it, the worst experience ever, avoid this Hotel

reviews.title: Thanks to the most energetic GM I have meet
reviews.text: I would like to extend my appreciation to the hotel GM Mr.Ayman and his genius team members for the great hospitality that they provide me during my stay at Amigo Hotel Dahab, the hotel features are equally the 5* properties and the team are well trained.The hotel is great choice for families and friends travels, even they have night life at the beach.The view from the room is marvelous, the public areas are super clean and green.

Hotel is so bad
reviews.text: REVIEW HERE in ARABIC & ENGLISHالفندق سئ جدا او الاصح ان لا يطلق عليه فندق لاسباب كتير :-١- التكييفات لا تعمل بصورة جيده و لا يوجد صيانه لها. و غالبا الريموت ليس له علاقه بالتكييف الموجود بالغرفة.٢- لا يوجد نظافه يوميه.٣- الاستقبال يعتبر غير موجود اصلا.٤- البوفيه و المطعم و الاكل و المشروبات سئ جدا جدا٥- تجربتي تم ادخالي غرفه ليس لها مفتاح و مدير الفندق بلغني ان في خلال ساعتين سيتم تغيير الكالون و ذلك لان المفتاح ضاع !!!!٦- الحمامات اسوأ مما قد تتخيل .. من حيث التغذية و الصرف.٧- التليفونات في الغرف لا تعمل.٨- بعض فيش الكهرباء لا تعمل.٩- حمام السباحة لا تتم نظافته بالشكل الذي ينبغي و مليان كلور.١٠- لا يتم استخدام المطهرات لتطهير المكان في ظل الظروف الحاليه.١١- بعض الغرف، الحوائط تشطيبها متهالك و لم تتم معالجته.انا لا ارشح الفندق ده لاي حد✋🏻، حافظ علي فلوسك و روح فندق تاني.Hotel is very bad, actually it can'r be called as a hotel for a lot of reasons:-1- ACs are not working well and there is no maintenance for them. often the Remote has no relation between it and its AC.2- NO regular housekeeping3-Reception is considered as not existed4- Food and drinks are so so bad5- My experience, they gave me a room without a key and the GENERAL MANAGER of the hotel told me within 2 hours the key will be available cuz he is gonna change the key cuz he lost the key6- Bathrooms is soooo so bad, water feeding and plumbing.7- The landline in rooms is not working8- Some of electric sockets are not working.9- Swimming pools is not getting cleaned as required and full of chlorine.10- No usage of sanitizer in this circumstances.11- Finishing of some walls is not being repaired.✋🏻،I don't recommend this hotel to anyone, Save your money and go to another hotel.

reviews.title: Dirty Hotel
reviews.text: I'm really shocked to find positive reviews on this hotel!!! since we arrived, we have found many أبراص in our rooms during our stay, when we reported it to the receptionist, he said that all hotels in Dahab are just like that, and when i asked for insect killer, he said they don't have and sent me a housekeeper with sanitizing spray instead!!!the food quality is the worst ever!!!the rooms were not cleaned even once during our stay for 4 days!!! I don't recommend this hotel to anyone!!!

reviews.title: Quiet little gem in Dahab
reviews.text: Was booked at the hotel as part of a low cost trip from Cairo... Was really worried from the mixed reviews I've read over TripAdvisor and other travel websites, but I can confidently say that what I found exceeded my expectation..Location:It's about 5-7mins by car from the promonade and taxi costs around 50egp which is a fair price specially if ur a group sharing the expenses.Hotel is literally beach front offering breath-taking views of the red sea and the opposing mountains in Saudi Arabia with a back Sinai mountain views as well.Rooms:Rooms are good size offering double and triple occupancy as well single being accommodated in a double room.Almost all rooms have seaview and a balcony over the gardens.Some rooms offer both seaview and pool view with their balcony overlooking the gardens and pool.The rooms have en-suite with toilet and shower including toiletries.Note: toilet/shower are basic but clean and functional.Room had a double wardrobe, suitcase table, fridge, bedside table, armchair and a small coffee table and a crt TV with basic TV channels.Facilities:* Pool with good size and clean, there was a place for pool bar however was not operational hope next time it will be working!There are beach loungers around the pool and a music system where u can play ur own music!* Beach with loungers, pergolas, swings and a good area for beach football or volleyball.* Restaurant good size offer a basic open buffet breakfast only. By basic I mean limited variety and quantity however the quality is relatively good.Staff:They are the stars of this hotel. Super friendly, herlpful, respectful and polite. They are willing to go this extra mile to give you the best possible experience they can for your satisfaction.Omar was one of them and he is super friendly and polite don't hesitate to ask him for anything u want he'll do whatever he can to help.Cleanliness:Fair to good for the price you pay and u can always ask for the room service at anytime.Points of improvement:Pool bar to be fully workingRestaurant menu to be variableWiFi availabilityMore digital marketing and offering the hotel on online booking platforms this will increase the flow.

reviews.title: one of the best places to relax in dahab
reviews.text: the hotel is very quite ,the room was clean ,the breakfast was good   but is not the best and i didn't expect to get an fabulous breakfast due to its cheap price, the place was very good i will come back again.

I love Dahab and all but to be honest, this hotel isn’t even worthy to be in a place like Dahab and this man who he calls himself manager doesn’t know anything about managing or dealing with clients who came to take a vacation from stressful job in London, ROCKETTA HOTEL IS MUCH MORE BETTER, I recommend it.

reviews.title: Great holiday
reviews.text: Friendly owner and I would like to thank him for his efforts Mr. Hosam, clean rooms with air conditioning and fridge, great breakfast, efficient & friendly staff and an on-site dive club and hotel located near to city center what else do you need! Thanks for coming to Dahab next time!

reviews.title: Clean, welcoming and calm
reviews.text: The hotel is clean and cozy, the management and staff are so friendly and helpful. They provide beach towels and prompt room service. The hotel location is 10 minutes walk from Dahab main walking promenade so it is close by everything and still calm and not too noisy. The hotel is also facing the German bakery which is a great breakfast place.My main recommendation to the management would be to allow swimming in the pool at night since no one actually will leave the sea during the day to go to the pool. However being able to swim at the pool at night would have made us spend many evenings there and not get out.

Any staff member would come out of thier way to fulfill your needs and ensure satisfaction. very quit and peaceful. One of my favorite activities was reading near the pool. Definitely would choose to visit here again.
