reviews.title: Bare minimum service
reviews.text: Its a hotel that has the basic, dont expect too much, the staff is easy going and friendly.The problems faced were the water heater is inefficient and old, the breakfast offers the bare minimum and the room itself is old, there isnt a cattle in the room nor a hair dryerHowever, it was a satisfying stay

reviews.title: Best place to stay in Dahab
reviews.text: Absolutely incredible. Literally 20 steps from the beach, and the pool there is fabulous as well. Alex and David are great hosts, they make you feel welcome, tell you the good things around town, but also give you your space and privacy. I plan to go back at some point and will definitely be staying in one of these condos again.

reviews.title: Fantastic Beachside Oasis with Pool and a rooftop Jacuzzi
reviews.text: We had a great time at Redrock Apartments.  The complex only has 6 very roomy and well kitted out apartments around a deep Freeform swimming pool.It's also designed to be totally sheltered on Dahab's windy kite-surf days.Loved the jacuzzi and bbq areas on the roof, the comfy beds and the easy contact and lots of activity and history insights from the owners Excellent choice Highly recommended

reviews.title: Truly amazing!
reviews.text: I’m absolutely blown away by this place! So beautifully curated, spacious, and accommodating. We enjoyed our stay so much and will always stay here when we come to Dahab!

reviews.title: An oasis within an oasis
reviews.text: What a joy it was to stay here. We will definitely come back one day.The communication with Rochelle beforehand in the booking proces was smooth, and the caretaker, Amr, is always helpful and available, either in person or by Whatsapp.Red Rock Apartments is located a 20 minute walk from the town center. We rented bikes there, so we could get around quicker with ease. A lot of people use bikes in Dahab, and you can make the trip from the southern part (Laguna Beach) to the north (Red Rock Apartments) in about half an hour.There are four apartments, so a lot of the time you have the whole place for yourself. The pool is huge, our apartment had e v e r y t h i n g we needed, and it is also suited for longer stays. Cooking facilities, a huge fridge, a freezer, microwave, an oven, a washing machine, dishwasher, even a Nespresso machine. The interior decor is also very, very tasteful. The roof terrace is a bliss. There's a jacuzzi and plenty of opportunities to enjoy a 360 view of the surroundings. We loved kicking back during the evening listening to the sounds of the city. People walking by on the street below laughing or arguing, a barking dog, a waiter dropping a plate, the nearby ocean - the atmosphere here has middle east written all over it, since Red Rock Apartments isn't situated in the more touristy part of Dahab. So you feel you live amongst the locals.There are plenty of local restaurants and small supermarkets nearby. The well reviewed Ralphs' German Bakery is also close by, if you opt for a more traditional western breakfast.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: The place is amazing. Very clean. Kitchenware is decent. Quiet neighborhood. Very nice pool that is somehow always warm. Our host, David, was always available and made things very easy.I highly recommend this place.

reviews.title: Great place, service, atmosphere and location
reviews.text: We arrived at the David Hotel and immediately felt wonderful and funThe hotel is Irish-inspired and the entrance has a huge and luxurious pool with clean water. The apartment is very spacious and luxurious and contains everything a family needs to spend a few days there.There is a huge, luxurious bathroom with a stream of mascara. Fridge and freezer, washing machine, dishwasher, microwave, huge cooking gas, kettle for ovens and basic cooking utensils.The apartment with a strong air conditioner in the rooms, the living room has a slightly weak air conditioner. The apartment does cool, but as soon as you open the door you feel warm. The apartment has an attic for a fun corner for hookah and barbecue, as well as a hot tub. The atmosphere itself is very pleasant, which is what the hotel owner David and immediately getThe apartment itself in the area is very rested, with an amazing beach suitable for diving, very close to the city and the marketIn conclusion,Highly recommended hotelExcellent ratioI'm sure I'll be backIt is very useful to pre-arrange according to the season that the hotel is always occupied

reviews.title: Exceptional
reviews.text: Everything about this place was perfect - starting from the communication with Rochelle, the trip management, the place itself. Its very peaceful, the street is well lit at night, so it looks charming both during the night as well as the day. Apartment is equipped with everything one may need, but even if any extras come to mind or unexpected situations appear, manager Amr is there for it all. There was a welcome kit which helped a lot as the transfer times were crazy late. Views from the roof are mind boggling. Our stay in this lovely place made the whole experience very special, we came for the family get together, and we had the best time. A true gem in Dahabs diverse but yet very specific apartments offer. Thank you!

reviews.title: 4 nights at Red rock
reviews.text: we had a very amazing vacation at Red Rock , the apartment was very ready , everything was so perfect. the facilities , the rooms , the whole place. we really liked our stay there and i would definitely recommend the place. The host , Rochelle , is also a very sweet person who was always asking if everything was alright.  It was my first stay there , but definitely not the last. Thank you!

reviews.title: My great vacation at Red Rock
reviews.text: One of the best memorable vacation through the kind hospitality of Rochelle & her fabulous apartment. Really we enjoyed alot, we found all what we need over there, the view, location all are great. Many thanks dear Rochelle for everything & sure we will repeat it in near future.

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: Last year we stayed in Red Rock Apartments for 2 weeks with 2 families. It was amazing! Beautiful apartment, amazing rooftop and great pool. Upon arrival there was food and water in the fridge and a baby bed for our little girl. The area where the apartment is situated is quit, but still near to all facilities. Also walking distance to the beach. All in all we had a great time and we would love to come back one day.

reviews.title: When you feel at home and no turist°
reviews.text: Write a review for Dar Dahab bring some many emotions because I keep come back year after year and take out the first years stay in other hotels and camp must be at least 12 years I am back at Dar Dahab! For me its home a home where you feel like to be part of a family. Management and personal feel all equal ready for any help in the residence and informations to explore around Dahab and find the best price for anything. I don't need an alarm clock but every morning I wake up to see the sunrise because its spectacular every day and then go diving or snokerel with a beautiful laguna so close or for a early swimm. The management is always very open to suggestions for improving standards . Personally as an Italian as a chef been a pleasure to cook italian food for everyone including guests. I remember once preparing fresh pasta early morning and guests coming down see what I was doing suddenly to see 7-8 people making pasta!! Or again making granita and becoming an Egyptian granita adding fresh fruits honey so less sugar!! A granita for all to share. Until you leave can be a great memory!! So good staying HOME that this not even a week back already booked for next year!!  I been told German Bakery is also at Dar Dahab !! I can't imagine to have a cappucino with a fresh croissant without going to town.  Its home not a residence and take the opportunity should be respected as a home. Caring each other in this modern world is being human and you will treasure when you back home and feel at home when you back and no a turist. Come back is a must for me!!

reviews.title: Your home away from home
reviews.text: This place is outstanding,  location , view , cleanliness and most importantly the peopke who make you feel home and are always around and accommodating to all requests .You dont feel you are in a hotel , they make you feel you are staying in a family home with feiends

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: We had a great stay in dar Dahab. Very friendly staff and nice location in a quiet and beautiful area about 30 min walk from the center. They have upgraded our room to a sea facing one with a great balcony which was amazing. The only thing it’s a bit pricey.  Anyway I will come back in the future!

reviews.title: It's home it's family is Dar Dahab
reviews.text: I look forward so much to come back to Dahab to Dar Dahab for my diving holiday but also because Dar Dahab for me is home and all the management and personal is a family!! The location is amazing for me starting the day with the sunrise and if I don't go diving there I a great coral area buzzing with with from nemo to piper fish to lion fish! I come back every year always for longer periods because take visiting trips to Cairo and net trip to Luxor in winter time...The management will help with any requests if they can and if they are some problems and need some attention for some problems they will respond even in the middle of the night!! They work very hard to keep the place as you except to be for me is like a temple to care for like your own house...it's very close to local shops very friendly and local market away from the tourist area and after a while you will feel at home...I will not look fir any other place in Dahab because is home and family and somehow is always than the year before!! So I am coming back in January and send a great thank to all at Dar Dahab...Strongly recommended!!

reviews.title: The place to stay in Dahab
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed at Dar Dahab for a week in August 2024 while doing a freediving course with Dahab freedivers.The hotel is very well placed, in the bedouin side of ther city. It takes about 20' to reach the Lighthouse with its promenade, restaurants and where most freediving clubs are located.Tom and Mustafah were extremely friendly, offering help for anything we wanted to do and keen to ensure our wellbeing.Mustafah prepared fresh, delicious -and plentiful- Egyptian breakfasts and even woke up in the iddle of the night to help us with our taxi when it was time to leave.The snorkelling in front of the hotel is also worth a dip.We will most certainly come back!

reviews.title: Dar Dahab Hotel & Red Sea Tribe Dive Centre
reviews.text: Our daughter is living in Dahab & booked us to stay at the Dar Dahab & it was amazing.On arrival we were met by the owner who offered us drinks, information about the hotel, the area and what room we would like.We stay in a single self contained first floor flat, sea facing with fantastic salt block walls that naturally let the sunshine through with beautiful colours.The kitchen/lounge have everything we needed, the wet bathroom was great and a fantastic shower.Bedroom with salt brick bedside tables interesting lighting and comfortable bed.Lounge & bedroom have A/C & both have doors out onto the balcony looking out over the beach.Breakfast was server downstairs, had more than we could eat or drink, all freshly made and very tasty.Off to the beach, towels, seats & beach shoes all included.Totally recommend this hotel, not in the centre of Dahab, but close enough to walk or cheap taxi ride. Quiet area very friendly, and you have keys to come & go as you please.Whilst there check out the local diving centre Red Sea Tribe, great staff, super friendly, and totally professional.Night life in Dahab is real Egyptian, many restaurants, cafes & bars plus the shops & bazaar.

reviews.title: Dar Dahab is unique..its home for me where every stay is somehow better than last time!!
reviews.text: I come back every year and somehow is always better than last time..Since 2015 is home for me...I miss can't come during Covid time..So was a pleasure be again at Dar Dahab back and this year even better than last time!! All the team work very hard to make your stay as comfortable and helpful with any requests..Ammar is not just a manager but can help with any requests and arrangements you want to do from trips to the desert , breakfast or dinner in the house or in Dahab..to even cook a great typical bedouin dinner!! Any arrangements Ammar is your person always with a smile!! Mustafa an Ahmet keep the place always very clean and very good with maintenance repairs at any time of the day!! Lady Nahid as the owner always very helpful and without Her Dar Dahab is like a sky without the stars..Great understanding and helpful for any personal problems even She is on vacation keep running Dar Dahab because She talk with Her team and this reflect also of all of Them interface with the Guests!! I honestly believe some guests don't deserve to be at Dar Dahab!! No respect for this very caring and loving place!! I love to cook sometime at Dar Dahab for everyone and as a chef is a pleasure  over the years to have an Italian dinner with the team and guests...So if you stay at Dar Dahab think as your home because this is what make Dar Dahab unique..Everything else look its architecture, great views for a wonderful sunrise..I don't miss a single morning!! A terrace where you can sunbathing in peace and relax...I know and already planning for my next visit!! I strongly recommended to catch the real Dahab with close shops in Assala with great selection for every day needs.. At Dar Dahab there is no problem because there is a solution!! Thank you to all the Team to make my visit always so special!!

reviews.title: The gem of Dahab where you feel at home and will come back again and again..
reviews.text: There is so much I can say about this unique place where I come back again and again because you feel like at home..Back after few years due to the Covid restrictions its a pleasure to be back. Offer great sea views and during my stay i don't miss a sunrise alwyas different and sometime going for an early swimm even just after the sunrise...The apartments are have a kitchen  where you can cook with local shops offer everything you need and a fishmonger just few minutes u will away...But if you like they can organise breakfast and Ammar the manager can cook a great beduin dinner you will never forget!! Ahmad and Moustafa'too work very hard to run any cores to keep the place at very high standard and always ready  for any requests as Ammar can arrange e any request and suggestions what to visit in Dahab...Lady Nahid the owner is the soul of Dar Dahab and working as Ammar ralways helpful with any requests or any problems...Maintenance is at very high standard and if something is not wprking properly will be repaired in very short time...The peace at Dar Dahab is broken only by children at sea playing even football !! Guests should be more caring  when stay at Dar Dahab because its extra work if come back from a swim and come iand should be n without taking off or washing their sea shoes in the basket water outside!!! Dah Dahab is like home: I have seen the staircase been washed 3 times in a day!!! If you like to sunbathing there is a great terrace well stock with chairs and  there are cushions where at the end of the you can see a sunset over the mountains...This year was very special to be back and as a chef its a pleasure to do some cooking for the guests..Lady Nahid also try to help ;new people come ti live in dahab and doing their roots cooking food but also they can suggest places in town or have take away...Any problem at Dar Dahab is not a problem because there is a way!! the wish to make your stay very relax without any issues of any sort....There si much more to say about Dar Dahab for its eco furnitures with a booking area too!! Dar Dahab is home for me and the only bad time its leaving time because you feel like taking a piece of Dar Dahab and want to give back when you come back with a great new experience vacation!!! i love it!!! And will come back...Thank you Lady Nahid, Ammar Moustafa and Ahmad....Will be back...its a homecoming...

reviews.title: Best place to stay in Dahab
reviews.text: This hotel is an amazing residence in Dahab with unique architecture and beautiful lighting.  Each unit has a small kitchen, many have sea views and the lobby area is gorgeous.  My family stayed here many times and enjoyed snorkeling in front of the hotel as well as walking to the Light House area. Ms. Nahed, the owner, is present daily and always friendly.  Mr. Gamal( fabulous cook) and Mr. Walid (excellent service man) make every guest feel at home.  It is the best place to stay in Dahab.  This New Year’s Eve,  Ms. Nahed hosted a delicious dinner for the guests.  It was perfect.  Dar Dahab has my family’s highest recommendation.

reviews.title: Small tiny hotel with budget friendly price.
reviews.text: The hotel is small and cozy, in a white-blue style. Very affordable price. The room also is very small. Very quiet place. No TV in the room, but big fridge. No problem with hot water and air-conditioning. They can keep your luggage after checkout. Nobody speaks English well, that is sometimes the issue.

reviews.title: Relax in Dahab
reviews.text: Very clean hotel located in a quiet area of Dahab but close to every comfort. The staff and the owner are very attentive and satisfy every request. (they even moved all the tables to a shaded area for us to do yoga!) ❤️ the strong point is the swimming pool (never seen such a clean swimming pool!) exposed to the sun until sunset.

reviews.title: A great hotel in a great location with a few minor flaws
reviews.text: The hotel was recently renovated. The external image is more Greek than Arabic, but it is still very pleasant to spend summer days. The employees were very kind: they allowed us early check-in and late check-out. The location of the hotel is excellent, a good fifteen minutes to the center of Dahab and about twenty minutes to the beautiful lagoon on the other side of the city. It is located in a quiet neighborhood. The only drawbacks we noticed are the rather poor cleanliness of the rooms and the fact that the pool closes very early in the afternoon. Everything else is great!

reviews.title: Very poor!
reviews.text: First, most of the pictures here are old and don't show the real thing there!We stayed there for two nights and it was really tough!The room smelled horrible, and a cockroach was there the 2nd dayThe bathroom is extremely small that in order to use the toilet you have to put your feet inside the shower!! The TV was not working and they fixed it a few hours before our checkout after asking them more than 3 times we even offered to buy the wire ourselvesDont even think of checking the kitchen there! Its not clean I even saw a sheep head thrown on the floor!The only good thing about it is that its close to the sea and El Mashaya and that's it!Very poor but if some good efforts are exerted it'd really be a good place for a quick cheap stay.

reviews.title: Worst Hotel ever
reviews.text: It's not even a Hotel ,Rooms are not good at all there is no view ,toilets are really bad ,water is not clean ..when we wanted to leave the room they asked us to pay 50% of the total amount knowing that we asked to leave after 4 hours from our stay so he wanted us to pay 50% of the night price for the 4 days we reserved ..also while reserving online he didn't tell us this information ..

reviews.title: Such great vacation
reviews.text: We felt like family in this hotel sea horse the owner "Abu Salma" such great person that help us for everything i had great time there. He help us in everything he know every thing there so if you want a great trip in dahab just ask about "Abu Salma" the owner of sea horse hotel

reviews.title: very good place
reviews.text: i had 3 nights in this hotel and i relay like it clean closer to the see with small garden air conditioning hotel with good Location and very good Service and the price also was very good at the end i had 3 amazing nights at this hotel

reviews.title: the place is very good for it is price
reviews.text: the place is very good for the price , but any trips made by the manager costs more than the usual just take the hotel as only a hotel , if you want to have a trip there is cheaper prices out there the hotel is a little far from the sea , but you can wake you will spend like 10 minutes to reach the sea

reviews.title: Amazing  hotel!!! Very nice people!!!
reviews.text: We met the owner in the bus station,  we traveled  with him to see the hotel, it is clean, quiet and lovely place, everybody are very friendly. Yaser is an excellent person, he help us all the time, also when we had a problem with the visa.I recommend this hotel, and to go with them to the blue hole, we went with Mohammed, he is an excellent tour guide!!! Excellent holidays in a lovely place!Dahab is the best city in Egypt!!!!

reviews.title: Very pleased!
reviews.text: The hotel and room were both good but very basic. Considering the price though I cannot complain. The room I stayed in consisted of two beds, a couple of tables, an air-con unit and an ensuite with toilet, shower and sink. There was an outdoor courtyard area in the middle of the hotel and a shaded area which was great for relaxing and watching films in the evening. In the morning myself and 12 others I stayed with were provided with breakfast which was much better than I was expecting. The staff were polite and easy to talk to. On one occasion, I broke the room key (which was very weak, be warned!) in the keyhole. Upon awkwardly telling the owner what happened he was very easygoing and fixed it later that day!  Seahorse was a really relaxed hotel and I found it good value for money

reviews.title: Great place to explore Etosha
reviews.text: We stayed for one night in August and loved it. The staff were friendly and the braii was delicious - such a great idea to have a range of different game to taste. It’s handily located for Etosha’s Andersen Gate and was a grate base for us to explore the national park.

reviews.title: Food and photos didn't vote at all
reviews.text: Not as expected, the pictures should definitely be upgraded, not much like, very disappointed, not the best food unfortunately, seemed like a lot went on half 12, ordered a foccacia b.l.a expected it a little juicy and good, what came was a flat little pizza🤔 no this was not so good, very disappointed summarum, not a place I recommend

reviews.title: Most amazing food ever
reviews.text: We all had pizza on day 1- enthusiastic! We had pasta, salad and sausage  on day 2 - equally enthusiastic about the quality and creativity of the dishes....Last lunch on day 4 at Eldorado before we headed back to Cairo - so yummy, so good! I love the puglia pasta best of all 😋 my son really loves the rib eye Steak- ordered it second time today, my son's girlfriend favorite were the Ravioli and our shared favorite is the panna cotta😃😃😃

reviews.title: Quality Italian restaurant.
reviews.text: This is a chic comfortable modern restaurant. So impressed with this place, lovely service, fresh food, great homemade pizzas and the best tiramisu. It’s worth a little walk from the ‘downtown’ places. Authentic Italian food creative combinations of ingredients.

reviews.title: Perfect accommdation
reviews.text: We spent a perfect week relaxing at Eldorado. The accommodation was perfect for us as the rooms were very nice and clean.There is also a nice private beach at the front.We would also like to thank Sad,the owner and most of the staff for making it a perfect stay.We would stay again and recommend to others.

reviews.title: Best Pizza in town!
reviews.text: Best pizza in town!Really nice and quiet place. Good italien restaurant with pizza, pasta and huge steaks.Pizza was perfect and you have to try the desserts! Tiramisu and panna cotta are on point!! We will come again!

reviews.title: Top relaxing place
reviews.text: Best Italian restaurant in Town, professional staff, amazing food. If you wish to stay over night a cozy is waiting for you. Near there is a laguna and blue hole.Sure we will come back soon.Thank you to everyone.

reviews.title: Home from home
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of staying here for four nights and it felt like being at home thanks to the warm hospitality of the staff and the owner (and Eldo the cat) and the positive vibe of the place. The room was comfortable and clean. A sandy beach with deck chairs was literally right outside, where you could witness an amazing sunrise over the Red Sea. The lodge rooms surround the lovely restaurant area, which means the rooms are not quiet (though the music playlist is excellent), but this also means being able to eat some of the best Italian food I’ve ever had, including in Italy—the current owner of Eldorado is Italian from Puglia and is an excellent chef who obviously trained his attentive team well. Every day I was greeted with smiles and I was also delighted to find some vegan items on the food and drink menus. The location is perfect, walking distance from the Lighthouse area but in a quieter neighbourhood, and the setting gorgeous. Airport pick up and local tours can be arranged, just ask. Thank you to the whole Eldorado team for a really pleasant stay and I hope to be back soon!

reviews.title: Peaceful and friendly atmosphere
reviews.text: The stuff are very nice and friendly specially Sparter who is not only so friendly, but very helpful as well. The manager of the hotel is very nice and he checks on everything by himself. The restaurant offers a great selection of pasta and pizza. The rooms are very basic and they are near to the restaurant so it is sometimes noisy a little bit for people who wake up late.

reviews.title: Amazing food
reviews.text: Food heaven this is what this place is about, don't ask for their best item go and try any and you will be indulged, had 2 pizzas, pasta and lasagna 😋 for 2 persons only, sauces and doughs are real Italian, one of the reasons to visit Dahab.

reviews.title: Nice camp in Dahab
reviews.text: Very nice camp. Central location. Nice people, close to the diving clubs and restaurants. Friendly staff and tasty food prepared by chief Rania. Access from the beach side and from the market street. The rooms are simple and basic but very authentic and Dahab style design.

reviews.title: Dolphin camp is the best place you can enjoy your stay in that
reviews.text: It's amazing I love it stuff is very very helpful they are professionals and try hard to make you happy ..The place is very clean food is wonderful I like it. I appreciate every minute and I'll be there as soon as possible again

reviews.title: I want to share my experience at Dolphin Camp in Dahab – one of the best places I have ever visited! The place is
reviews.text: I want to share my experience at Dolphin Camp in Dahab – one of the best places I have ever visited!The place is clean, quiet and perfect for relaxing and enjoying the beauty of Dahab.The staff is friendly, helpful and always there with a smile for guests.A special thanks goes to Michael, the owner of the camp. He is extremely professional, very experienced and takes care of everything with a lot of passion. You can tell immediately that he cares about the well-being of the guests.Thank you, Michael, for the great hospitality and excellent service! I will definitely come back and can highly recommend the Dolphin Camp to anyone traveling to Dahab.

reviews.title: A rather intimidating place
reviews.text: Absolutely appalling situation, having been promised and upgrade for free we waited for over two hours to get into the room which was tiny and then offered another slightly bigger room, after we left I gave a painting worth $40 to the poor girl that worked there as a gift, I need to be messaged by the manager that they wanted to charge an excess of $70 and if we didn't pay they would take it out of the receptionists wages.  I've never in all my time known such shocking mismanagement and I absolutely recommend all of you to go to Coral Reef instead

reviews.title: Outstanding comfortable camp & vibe
reviews.text: Outstanding comfortable atmosphere, active staff, friendly environment, neat & clean, chill pool, private beach, strong WiFi 🥇Micheal is very supportive and generous,Hosny the best receptionist assiting you in regards to all your inquiries,Rabie &Mohamed are active 24/7, Rawash best breakfast chef and coffee maker🤗Came As Guest & Lived As FAMILY 👪 Highly Recommend👌

reviews.title: It really felt like home.
reviews.text: the place is very cozy and Michael is very helpful and so friendly, he's always keen to ensure that everything is going well.The camp and the room were very clean and neat.The room was well cleaned before i checked in.The AC did a great job though the weather was extremely hot.I admired the location of the camp were i had an easy and quick access to everything i needed in no time (market, pharmacy, restaurants)The idea of the open kitchen was so lovely as i was able to prepare my own breakfast by myself using the main camp's kitchen.

reviews.title: Comfortable and the most helpful staff
reviews.text: This is 100% the best places to stay if you want somewhere comfortable and affordable to stay. The owner is incredibly kind and attentive, even going as far to book my bus for me and escort me to it. The hotel was wonderful and want to go back asap

reviews.title: Excellent price-quality ratio
reviews.text: We stayed 5 nights in the large kingsize bedroomPros- price to quality ratio (283€)- friendly staff - cleanCons- zen music played in loud speakers across the camp (should be stopped much sooner than 11pm)- cannot connect to wifi in our room- very absent service (would walk around camp without finding anyone) although quite responsive via WhatsApp

reviews.title: Dolphin 🐬 saves your time
reviews.text: It’s value for money; I believe many venues around are the same. However, it’s good for accommodating use.It has multi varieties of rooms, such as single, double and triple… with private bathrooms and sharing one, depends on your choice and budget.I can’t say it’s close to center; as it’s on center of DAHAB; every public place is near to you.

reviews.title: Highly recommended 😉
reviews.text: The best camp ever we feel at home the moment we entered the camp .Michael the owner was very helpful and friendly the place is very comfortable and cozy , the rooms are very simple and amazing , all the staff is very respectful and friendly 😍😍 highly recommended . Special thanks to Hady who helped us alot there and Emil also they are the best ♥️♥️was plessure to stay with you the past few days I Love u guys 🥰
Wonderful, in the heart of the promenade, a very special location, a fantastic atmosphere.

reviews.title: Worst experience ever
reviews.text: The receptionist was rude plus the AC was not functioning well terrible bathroom and there was insects on the bed it was one of my worst experiences ever.

reviews.title: One of Dahab hidden gems
reviews.text: A cute and cozy place. Rooms and beds are clean. Each room has a small terrace where one can sit and chill, rad a book, listen to music or play a game with friends. A quiet area that is walking distance from everything: 2 minute walk to the bus station, 3 - 5 minutes walking to restaurants, supermarkets, cafes, dive centers and the beach.Management and housekeeping is friendly, present and helpful.Prices are reasonable.

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: This is one of the worst experiences I ever had in life. The hotel is owned by a crazy old man that interferes in your life and ask you to lend him money and ask you where are you going and talk too much. He asked me for money and I told him I will pay in the check out and after two days he asked me to leave the room and I shouted to him to stop knocking on me. He is a weird Man. Called Dr. Ishak Danial. A big liar. Don’t go there at all.

reviews.title: Avoid at all costs – this place will ruin your trip
reviews.text: Avoid at all costs – this place will ruin your trip.Echoing many other reviews, our stay at Perla was nothing short of horrific. We booked three nights and were met with constant discomfort, invasion of privacy, and outright hostility.The property itself feels more like a rundown hospital than a hotel or camp. But worse than the setting was the treatment by the owner, 3ANTAR, who was shockingly rude and aggressive. He acted as if we were a burden, snapping at basic questions and refusing to help with anything. To make things worse, he hiked the prices to nearly 4x what was originally agreed upon – a blatant scam.The most disturbing part? The staff made us feel deeply unsafe. The men working there stared at us constantly, followed us around the property, and made us feel so uncomfortable that we filed a police report. Instead of showing concern, the owner became even more hostile.On the last morning, one of the staff tried to force open my door while I was still inside packing – at 9am, a full hour before checkout. He then locked the door from the outside repeatedly, clearly trying to push us out. It was threatening and completely inappropriate.As soon as I stepped out, they rushed in a new guest without even cleaning the room – unsanitary and unacceptable.Do yourself a favor and stay anywhere else. This place is a nightmare. Unsafe, unclean, and run by people who clearly have no respect for their guests.

reviews.title: Worst experience ever
reviews.text: Worst experience ever, rooms were dirty, staff were short, no service, bad treatment, i most importantly the owner did not address our issues and he treated me and my mother badly, i would not recommend to anyone to go there because you will not have fun at all

reviews.title: Not recommended
reviews.text: The place is so dirty, the bed, sheets, toilet, floor and walls are dirty. The toilet stinks, the windows lock is broken. The water pressure is low and the shower is broken. The experience was awful at all aspects.

reviews.title: Friendly staff, good place to stay
reviews.text: A good place to stay in Dahab. the most friendly and helpful people feels like home (Abdualla, Adel and Ashraf) If you decide to book a hotel, just for sleeping and spend the rest of the day outside, this hotel will be a good choice .Very good breakfast.

reviews.title: Worst hotel experience
reviews.text: Rooms are dirty, dirty walls and sheets are filthy, no door lock or even knob for the bathroom. Toilet is disgusting. We had to ask for the sheets to be changed and toilet paper 3 times. No towels, soap or shower gel. Don't stay there it's a waste of money!

reviews.title: Excellet
reviews.text: Excellent rent amazing place the most friendly people and mangers feels like home good room space nice air conditioning very good food and decorations Special thanks to MR. Abdallah &    MR. Abd El-Wahab

reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.text: The only request to this hotel from me was a good air condition, but it failed it. It was hot as at hell. They have very old air condition that couldn't cool even one square meter. Hotel is cheep but I would never recommend it to visit specially in summer.

reviews.title: Fantastic place at a fantastically low rate.
reviews.text: Stayde 5 nights in this hostel run by Mr Hassan and his brother, who don't seem to pay too much attention to the number of guests they have or whether they've paid or not. I stayed in a single ensuite room with A/C and paid less than half of what a dorm bed in Cairo cost me. Location isn't great, but what do you expect at such a low rate (I really cannot stress enough how cheap this was). The staff organised several "parties" in the evening, and the atmosphere was great. You can use the kitchen for free and rent snorkels and masks for 5LE a day. The staff are very helpful and eager to talk and spend time with you. All in all, a great place to stay in, especially if you're a solo traveller.

reviews.title: This hotel made the trip
reviews.text: The guys that work there are amazing. I stayed there three separate times and they made my trip. They helped us set up diving sessions, snorkeling, and even a hike up Mt. Sinai. We became good friends with the owners and I highly recommend staying there.

reviews.title: Not such a clean place after all
reviews.text: The hotel is located on a  back street (not overlooking the sea).  We arranged for a pick up and no one showed up so we had to arrange our on way from Sharm in the middle of the night. Room was very dirty, no proper bed linen, no towels, no toilet paper and on top of that the place was very derty. Breakfast was not included, the aircon was so ancient and noisy we were unable to sleep all night,  we stayed in cheap hostels before and I have to say this was really bad.  We booked this place for 5 nights we only stayed 6 hours. The only nice thing about this place were the 2 receptionist very friendly and apologetically  about almost everything and  they were ok when we told them  that we were leaving and only paying for one night !  This hotel could be nice if they could clean the rooms and at least provide the minimum.

reviews.title: 0/10 very very bad experience and i don’t recommend the hotel
reviews.text: I don’t recommend at all booking this hotel. Very rude staff, i came in May 2026 spending four nights, rooms weren’t even ready when we arrived and even after we claimed the room key there were several problems including problems with the air conditioner that wasn’t working, uncleaned room…etc. Staff unprofessional and putting unprofessional the top main problem. If there was a zero i would definitely go with it.

reviews.title: Bad experience. Wouldn’t recommend.
reviews.text: Non professional & impolite staff. We went on a trip there as a group and the staff were neither helpful nor friendly. Rooms are not good and the air conditioning was not working well. The whole experience was awful. I would not recommend going there. There are better options in Dahab.

reviews.title: Nice hotel DAHAB BEACH Lodge
reviews.text: Nice hotel, near by the center of Dahab, with a wonderful breakfast place near the sea , a beautiful swimming pool and a terrace on the top with a beautiful view over Dahab. You can chose between 3 kinds of breakfast and they can make you a real good cappuccino!The rooms are a little bit sober, not very modern but clean.The personnel attention was good and very friendly, you can ask for cleaning of other things and they help you.Not everybody can speak English but that is nog problem.The WIFi is not available at your room but inside the little office building.In the rooms are no chairs, but if you lucky you have an little balcony with view of the sea, and there are 2 chairs.AndYou can swim in the sea from this place if is it not to windy!

reviews.title: Good value for money
reviews.text: Very friendly service, they are very helpful with questions and solve problems quickly. The rooms are basic but fine for the price. And the delicious breakfasts and the hood opposite the hotel on the beach in the morning sun are a party!

reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.text: A wonderful place to relax and celebrate your holiday in Dahab. With swimming pool. Fine breakfast, made with attention. Mega beautiful views of the mountains and the sea. Roof terrace. Super helpful and friendly staff who are always ready to help you.

reviews.title: Great location and the best attention
reviews.text: Staff is amazing, they are charming and willing to help you on anything you need. They do everything for you to feel welcome. They are one of a kind!  You have the breakfast included in the restaurant and is delicious. The pool is amazing to relax after a long day. The room is good although the bathroom is not that nice.Location is great to enjoy Dahab. Definitely I would come back.

reviews.title: Good time
reviews.text: Very good stuff good breakfast at Rastrant location very nice in morning can see the see in breakfast all Day caller the pool all day cilling all hotel out said we have big market for food Dirnk can eat chicken salad fish good ice cream Dinner pizza

reviews.title: Not Worth It
reviews.text: • My experience was not good at all. • I went with my friend in December 2022. We had a double room garden view. • First of all the stuff there were not friendly at all and not welcoming. • They didn’t check on us at all or asked to help us. • The room was okay but the bathroom has a horrible smell. • I didn’t notice at first as they added so much air freshener. • After our first night they didn’t clean our room and when we asked to clean it. They said the worker left and will clean it in the morning. • The room window was on street not the garden as promised. • The street was very noisy and they had like arcade games infront of the hotel and it was so loud all night long. • So we had to stay an uncomfortable night between the loud noise and the horrible smell. • The value for money was not worth it at all. As I payed the same or even less money in way better places in Dahab. • I will never go back for there sure.

reviews.title: Absolutely amazing place!
reviews.text: We had an absolutely fantastic stay and couldn’t recommend this place highly enough. From the moment we arrived, the host went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and ensure everything was perfect throughout our stay.The location is outstanding  ideally situated with beautiful surroundings and easy access to everything we needed. It was the perfect base for exploring the area while also providing a peaceful and relaxing atmosphere.The food was exceptional and genuinely exceeded our expectations. Every meal was fresh, delicious, and clearly prepared with great care and attention to detail. It was one of the highlights of our trip.The accommodation itself was spotless, comfortable, and had everything we could possibly need. The combination of excellent hospitality, amazing food, and a perfect location made this a truly memorable experience.Thank you for such a wonderful stay  we will definitely be returning and recommending it to friends and family.

reviews.title: Asma
reviews.text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐We had a wonderful stay at Beit Theresa. The place has such a cozy atmosphere that immediately makes you feel at home. It was peaceful and relaxing—the perfect escape from the busy city.The food was absolutely delicious, with every meal prepared with great care. The warm hospitality of the team made our experience even more special.If you’re looking for a quiet, cozy place with amazing food and a welcoming atmosphere, I highly recommend staying here. We would definitely love to come back!

reviews.title: So memorable, so beautiful
reviews.text: Beit Theresa is such a beautiful and unique place. It is wonderfully located, and also private. It has great amenities and every inch of it is stunning. Very picturesque.

reviews.title: Peaceful and relax stay
reviews.text: Beit Theresa is the perfect place to relax, close to the beach and Eel Garden. The rooms are cozy, beautifully designed with natural materials, and surrounded by a lovely private garden. Great for couples, solo travelers, and families. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a unique stay in Dahab!

reviews.title: Best place in Dahab!
reviews.text: What a wonderful stay .. 10 days at Mimi's. The place is perfect , located qlqs minutes from the tourist area.We open the curtains and sea view .. breakfast more than amazing!!!! Mimi's treating you. If there is one place in Dahab , it is this one! Thanks for everything and caressing Simba and Mufasa

reviews.title: I love  this place soooo much ♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️
reviews.text: With great pleasure I want to write about this magical place!!!!!This is a little fairy tale in the cozy city of Dahab. At first we decided to stay at Mimi's for a week, but we liked it so much here that we decided to stay until the end of our vacation, and extended it for another week. Mimi you are miracle.♥️I felt at home! Ibrahim and Ahmed are the people who were there every day and always ready to help with everything! Their smiles, their presence is unforgettable!!! Nermin is the best cook, she prepared the most incredible breakfasts. Thank you very much for the delicious food. It's unforgettable !!!! And the way she brought coffee was cute! Mimi!!!!! Your place will always remain in my heart!!!! But I believe that we will definitely return to you!!!! You are an incredible person and I wish you all the best, brightest and happy!!!!

reviews.title: Beit Threesa: A Sanctuary of Serenity and Romance
reviews.text: The experience was exceptional. Upon entering Beit Threesa, one is immediately struck by the meticulous attention to detail and the harmonious blend of nature and romance. The staff exudes genuine warmth and affection, ensuring that guests feel valued and cared for. Beit Threesa offers a diverse selection of breakfast options, and I highly recommend indulging in their culinary offerings. I had the privilege of spending five memorable days there during my honeymoon, and it undoubtedly ranks among the most cherished experiences of my life. Beit Threesa left an indelible impression on me, and I eagerly anticipate the opportunity to revisit it in the future.

reviews.title: The Best Place in Dahab
reviews.text: Beit Theresa’s location is perfect, directly on the beach with a walking distance to everything. Their hospitality is amazing, their food is the best and the rooms are the coziest. I didn’t want my vacation to end and I can’t wait to visit again.

reviews.title: Paradise in Dahab!
reviews.text: Beit Theresa has something special. The location is perfect. It was only a ten minute walk from the main boardwalk but out of the way enough to have quiet nights. The hospitality and friendliness of all staff makes you feel like this place is home. They organized our tours and took us to the desert for tea and stargazing. Their homemade breakfast is incredible. The grounds are magical! I’m so happy that we were lucky enough to find this place and spend a few days in paradise at Beit Theresa. Thank you for making our stay in Dahab unforgettable.

reviews.title: Beyond amazing
reviews.text: The place is beyond amazing really no words can describe how beautiful it is loved all the details in the place everything was more than perfect. Mimi and Mamdouh are more than Super Hosts, they treated us like family and pampered us all through the stay.The food was amazing and changing the themes of breakfast everyday gave a great effect. Definitely recommend the place for anyone looking for a peaceful stay .

reviews.title: Wonderfull relaxing holiday
reviews.text: Had a wonderfull time. Staff can't do enough for you. Rooms clean and tidy. Good value for money. Great location to the sea and restaurants. Lively atmosphere from evening. Can't wait to go back. Very helpful manager Mr atef.

reviews.title: The worst place to stay ever
reviews.text: One of the worst places to stay starting with inconvenience and poor room facilities and old non working AC that was the worst experience that actually made me not to sleep in the room for the day and the stuff just said “ we can do nothing just wait till 7 or 8 am when the owner wakes up and asking for an alternative room for the night was answered by “we can do nothing “ such a lousy hostel that is combined by a lousy services and even the private toilet of the room is of zero hygiene and in a very bad condition

reviews.title: Nice Hotel
reviews.text: Simple hotel ,nice atmosphere ,I stayed 3 nights with some friends.Swimming pool is clean but quite small surrounded by few palm trees look like an oasis . The hotel has a dive center and a nice reception man able to organize any trip in dahab.

reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.text: I went to dahab to spend my birthday there with my friend The hotel is surrounded by everything u could do ,buy or need .. bus stations,restaurants,cafe , super markets, atm,diving centers ....Room was good , bed was clean , ac was okPepole there are very nice  special thanks to mr mahmoud from reception he was so helpful and politeAlso the pool was very good .. when we check in and told them that we might try the pool  they clean it and change water for usThey always welcome u with smile and help u all the time .. just Don't expect so much and u will find everything is okey

reviews.title: An quet and relaxing place to stay
reviews.text: Artyf and his team made me feel very welcome for my 7 day stay in Dahab.The pool in the centre of the courtyard and the central location of the hotel made access to all that Dahab offers ameadt to get to by walking

reviews.title: Aweful !!
reviews.text: The sheets on the bed had holes and some of the holes were burned, the toilets weren’t clean and the shower wasn’t working, the room had insects and cockroaches everywhere, also the night was expensive considering all the comments I wrote above.

reviews.title: Ok for a cheap stay
reviews.text: Relatively clean, an average bathroom, lumpy bed, and no breakfast. On the bright side, a lovely pool and a good AC!Location is quite close to the boulevard, and a couple of feet from a good supermarket. Their dive center looks ok; have not tried it though.

reviews.title: Had a great stay!
reviews.text: Don't expect anything too fancy, if you've been to Dahab before you'll know what I'm talking about. Rooms are clean, have air conditioning and a balcony. We stayed in a double room and as 2 female travellers we found this hotel to be very safe and welcoming. Front desk is very friendly and both check in and check out went very smoothly. Rooms do need slight renovation and you need to get your own towels, shampoo, soap. Good for those on a budget. You're right next to a mini market and the hotel can help you organise activities. Room has a fridge so you can store juice or fruits and quick tip: If you get coffee from the mini market there's a kitchen downstairs that has a kettle you can just ask any hotel staff member and they would gladly assist.

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: Had a lovely couple of weeks at octopus hotel.clean room.fridge.tv.en suite.lovely pool and sunbathing areas.ziggy the manager was amazing.so friendly and helpful when organising trips at good rates.the staff were so friendly and welcoming.

reviews.title: good for budget
reviews.text: the location not that bad. near the mini market for you to buy mineral water.. Its really HOT!!! Do not expect more for this hotel but i guess its still OK. the swimming pool really nice but i didn't spend my time in the swimming pool because of the water is too salty!! luckily i buy a lot of mineral water and used that to wash my hair. Or, my hair will be very terrible.....Somehow, its nice and cheap. Not really fancy but if you have money go find the expensive hotel a little bit.... oh not to forgot.... the keeper is too nice and very friendly...i like.. :) since the view around dahab is nice...i forget about the disadvantage of this hotel.. hehehe

reviews.title: Best hotel in dahab
reviews.text: A great place to chill and relax with a beautiful sea view. Excellent service, delicious food, and a very friendly manager, Mr. Walid Morsy 🤩🤩

reviews.title: An amazing experience
reviews.text: The staff are friendly and helpful.The rooms are clean. It has a stunning and breathtaking view where you can see the sky,the mountains and the sea.I really enjoyed my stay there and I wish to go there again .I do recommend this hotel to everyone. staff are friendly

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I've been visiting Dahab for the last 6 years in different locations and this is the first time to recieve such a disappoitend treatment. The man who called himself the owner of the place which he is not and also called himself a retired pilot which doesn't apply on his manners and way of dealing with guests that proofs he doesn't have any idea how to treat people with respect his name is Ali. He doean't even care to ask how was our stay and if there is anything we need like other places do. Everyday we stayed almost 2 hours without water and they were renovating the place so workers start at 6 am in the morning to drill on our heads.Will never visit the place again for sure.Prices are overrated with no service in return.

reviews.title: Nice & cozy
reviews.text: The hotel is a nice hotel in Dahab with perfect location & sea spot where u can swim , do snorkeling or diving.My room was so cozy , clean and nice , the view out of the window was amazing as well. Ayman at the reception is so caring friendly & helpful & mr. Waleed the owner was extremely caring and nice, they did everything they could to grant me a pleasant stay. The breakfast also was tasty and nice. Would visit again definitely .

reviews.title: Best vacation ever
reviews.text: Brilliant location in the middle of Dahab , with accessibility to all facilities , the staff is very friendly and they do their best to make your stay enjoyable , they tailor their services according to your needs , the theme of the place is very cozy and friendly .The food is good and the rooms are clean .Thanks to the owners ( Mr.Walid & Mr.Hisham ) for their hospitality ,it was one of my best vacations ever .Definitely I will come back to the same place , and hopefully to the same room with the magnificent view .

reviews.title: Great and friendly place
reviews.text: The perfect location where everything is available from the great lighthouse reef to restaurants of all kinds, mixed with the most friendly people surving at any time lead by an extremely understanding general manager who is always present.

reviews.title: Great Location but nothing else
reviews.text: At the beginning I thought it will be more than that, but unfortunately I found out that they have the worst service I've ever seen.I won't go there again under any circumstances. Sorry that they have such wonderful location and not use it properly.

reviews.title: Magician spot
reviews.text: Perfect place, perfect staff and elegant services where you can really feel at home in paradise.Enjoyed everything there as the whole staff are so friendly.I really had a non stop extreme feeling there. #Sea Soul Hotel ❤️.

reviews.title: Convenient Hotel
reviews.text: Very nice location friendly staff convenient bedroom all my family liked this place. Rooms very clean, breakfast as Egyptian style. Hotel sea view also near by restaurants and coffee. Hotel has diving center very professional

reviews.title: port said
reviews.text: very good to stay at  it staff very friendly  unique  view on the beach  and back to the mountains great roof  view for relaxtion and taking your meals , coffe....and so on room is air conditioned the hotel is on the light house area it's the most beautiful place in dahab

tripadvisor.streetAddress: El Fanar Street Light House Area, Dahab 21251 Egypt

reviews.title: The best place ever
reviews.text: We had an amazing stay at Sky Rock! Everything about this place was excellent — the room was beautiful and very clean, the food was delicious, and the location was perfect.The staff were absolutely wonderful — friendly, kind, helpful, and always ready to assist with anything we needed. They made us feel very welcome, comfortable, and safe throughout our entire stay.In my opinion, Sky Rock is one of the best places in Dahab, if not the best! Amazing service, great location, beautiful rooms, excellent food, and an incredible team.Highly recommended! We had such a great time and would definitely come back again.

reviews.title: A Hidden Gem in Dahab – Highly Recommended!
reviews.text: A Hidden Gem in Dahab – Highly Recommended!An Unforgettable Stay at Sky Rock Dahab⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐I had an amazing experience at Sky Rock Dahab. The place is absolutely beautiful, and the rooms are very spacious, exceptionally clean, and highly comfortable.The breakfast was beyond incredible—honestly, the best breakfast ever! A special and huge thank you to Chef Samar for preparing the most delicious breakfast in the world every single day.The entire staff is wonderful, friendly, and provided top-notch service throughout our stay. I would love to give a special shout-out and extra thanks to Hamza, Tarek, and Manga for their outstanding hospitality, and to every single beautiful soul working there. They truly make you feel at home.Highly recommended, and I will definitely come back!

reviews.title: Beautiful small charming hotel
reviews.text: Hotel full of charm on the beach. Very nice bosses, attentive staff, good advice. Spacious rooms, very clean.  Hearty and good breakfast served on the terrace facing the sea.... Restaurants and shops nearby. Wonderful week.  WE RECOMMEND...

reviews.title: Overpriced and Poor Facilities
reviews.text: This property is overpriced for what it delivers. Having traveled in Egypt for a month and enjoyed significantly better properties for less per night in Aswan and Luxor, this property should rent for more like $60 USD/night, not $90/USD, especially during low season. It is small, wifi was basically non-existent, the sea view was a sliver and the sea view balcony was only a small portion of a public walkway, not private. The space is tight and the shower head, which was only taped on, fell off and plumber never repaired. Breakfast however were beautiful and tasty and staff were nice, though pickup communication was poor as I had to repeat pickup time and location multiple times before confirmed accurately. I would not return and we feel cheated.

reviews.title: Simplicity and charm in Dahab
reviews.text: A hotel of great simplicity and full of charm.Fully dedicated team.Proximity to the beach is very appreciated.The breakfast is just perfect.The small swimming pool is missing, but the aquarium in the Red Sea quickly makes us forget this inconvenience.

reviews.title: Fabulous experience
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful experience.  Stellar service,  great breakfast and more food than you can eat.   Even making bagged breakfast the day before early morning dives.  Clean rooms, ac, fridge, hot water very nice roof top sitting area, main courtyard is cute and comfy.  Large ginger cat will steal any bread left alone for a second.   The staff also insisted on making us dinner on the beach one evening at no charge.

reviews.title: Best experience and people
reviews.text: Skyrock Dahab is, without a doubt, the number one place to stay in Dahab. The staff are all extremely friendly, kind and helpful. They helped us out with restaurant recommendations, with Kayaks and towards hiking routes. They also recommended Red Sea tribe diving (best in town). The breakfast is delicious, different everyday and varied. The rooms are kept clean and tidy. There’s also lovely communal areas on the beach and roof which are great to hang out in. Skyrock is a 10 min walk from the main strip of restaurants, however we also found great spots closer to Skyrock including Darwish fish and Zanooba slow cooking which we would totally reccomend over the beach front restaurants in terms of authenticity, taste and price. Skyrock is also near Asala square where there are local eateries and shops.

reviews.title: The hotel that serve All what you need to Stay in Dahab
reviews.text: ALL what you need in one place 1. THE STAFF: , freindly , respectful very very hard working ( Ayman, Tarek ,Bibo,Hamza,Manga) 2.Room: very simple yet very clean , Comfortable with all what you need inside it with amazing sea view and very spacious 3. Food : Balanced , healthy , tasty and soooo fresh as if it was cooked by mother at home exactly😄4. Location: The best in Dahab if you are looking for peaceful,calm area Yet it is 10 min to the busy crowded and shopping area 5. Prices: It worth every single dollar or egp you pay I would like to the thank the beautiful team to make our vacation experience unforgettable Till our next stay with them.Mostafa El TawilCEO OwnerCoppermelt for food

reviews.title: authentic Dahan experience
reviews.text: If you are looking for an authentic Dahan experience set aside for the main bazaars which are very busy!This is the place! The rooms are cozy, clean and comfortable. The rooms with sea view are amazing! The staff are beyond nice and friendly... they are available 24/7 to take care of all your needs. Incredible!!! The beach is a bit small and the local children come to play all around. The snorkeling is fantastic!!

reviews.title: Incredible staff
reviews.text: If you are looking for an authentic Dahab experience set aside for the main bazaars which are very busy!This is the place! The rooms are cozy, clean and comfortable. reviews.title: Chill out at Chillax ( we did!)
reviews.text: Amazing chillax (perfect location with parking)I cannot say how nice this place is it certainly is a Chillax staying here, owned by a lovely husband wife team who are on site and always happy to help ( Nahad & Ahmed ) nothing is too much trouble… they also have a cafe opposite the hotel.Basic but very comfortable rooms with ensuite rooms with fridge and tv.Thanks for an amazing stay 🙏

reviews.title: Quiet and atmospheric
reviews.text: Nice little hotel with an atmospheric communal pool area and a sofa in the shade for each room. The rooms are not large, but it works fine and there is quiet. Very friendly staff. The associated Chillax Cafe on the other side of the street is a lovely place to enjoy breakfast overlooking the ocean. The staff is very helpful and friendly. We had a great stay.

reviews.title: Green Oasis in Dahab
reviews.text: Centrally located yet very quiet. Nahid and your team are passionate about this green oasis. The rooms are very clean and the outdoor toilets are arguably the cleanest in all of Dahab. The daily cleaned pool was the highlight for the children. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Oasis
reviews.text: One of my favourite places so far ,staff were super helpful and kind ,couldn’t done enough for you .plus food and awesome coffee .A little oasis from tej hustle of main strip sat back with a pool and lovely garden ,and very clean .i will definitely return ,thankyou

reviews.title: Chillax
reviews.text: We just love this place..Ahmed and his beautiful wife Nahed make us feel so welcome as all the staff do..Family run, right on the prom, situated in a perfect location.This hotel is clean and comfortable, with double rooms up to family room..The rooms are basic yes but are so cute, beautiful ceilings!Well appointed.Every room has a comfortable sofa outside of the door. A lot of people sit out in the sun or a night. This makes for a great atmosphere with the guests just to relax have a shesha, read a book, it just lovely.Opposite Chillax, there is Chillax restaurant/coffee shop, very clean indeed , selection of food and excellent coffee. You can also sit on the decking that is on the Red Sea .. just perfect..We have been 4 times now and feel so at home..Chillax is a wonderful hotel with a great team an owners .We would 100 pc recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: Friendly and relaxing place
reviews.text: This ia a cozy place in a central location on Almamsha in Dahab with its own cafeteria at the sea.   Rooms were clean and comfortable.  Saff very friendly and check with you to ensure they meet your needs.  You feel at home there and relaxed.   We loved the stay.

reviews.title: Our new year was different
reviews.text: It is very well located at the center of the light house it’s new and very clean, it has a decent swimming pool with really nice seatings around it. The rooms are small so I don’t advice it for double. I took the double room for myself which was barley fitting

reviews.title: Cozy and great located Hotel
reviews.text: Great small hotel on the main street in Dahab. You can't get more central than this!  Staff is very friendly and the next door diving center (Sea Dancer) is great. Enjoyed my stay there and the beach access just across the street.

reviews.title: Staying here will ruin your Dahab experience
reviews.text: Absolutely terrible place. They charged me 1500 egp when you can easily find somewhere better for 500 egp per night. For your own enjoyment of Dahab please avoid this place. A campsite stay in Dahab should cost around 500EGP. I booked Dahab Square hostel before coming to Dahab. The owner of this place charged me 1500 per night. I thought it is expensive but hopefully worth it as the photos look good. I paid deposit. I arrived and the place is DIRTY, DIS FUNCTIONAL, DISGUSTING. normally I don't bother to write reviews, but I feel it is important to tell people to avoid places that will ruin your stay in Dahab which is a really lovely town. The sheets were unwashed and had brown stains on them, the AC was broken, the rooms were covered in dust, the fridge was filthy, the bathroom was unhygienic, the outside area was a mess. After seeing the photos online, I was really disappointed. I asked for a refund but I was told this was a good price because I am here during Eid. I left immediately and found somewhere much nicer for 500 egp. PLEASE DON'T RUIN YOUR TIME IN DAHAB BY COMING TO DAHAB SQUARE HOSTEL

reviews.title: Daytrip to Dahab
reviews.text: On a full day trip to Dahab, with Amr Ahmed & Gitte, a really fantastic DanishEgyptian couple whom arranges the best private trips. We had a great day with homemade eqyptian cheese dish at a beduin stop on the way, and local egyptian lunch, at a dinner, away from the tourist area downtown. Really tasty 👍 We give the best recommondations to them 😊 Contact info Arm Ahmed +201013620119

reviews.title: Relaxed place
reviews.text: This place fits the dahab vibe well. Very relaxed and chill with my only qualm being that there’s not always someone at reception but usually they’ll respond to your Whatsapp message within an hour so it wasn’t a major issue, and in fact she was super hospitable and I could tell she really did want my time in dahab to be great and went above and beyond to help me do so. I definitely recommend it. I’m a solo traveler, but because of the pandemic there wasn’t much of a social vibe but I could see it being a chill place to meet people during other times. Also, they have hot water

reviews.title: One of the worst of the Golden Heights Aquapark
reviews.text: From the worst hotels to ever-visited, it’s too poor for every need ZeroWoo Clean with respectful service for the hotel From the worst to the best, end-of-the-best, poor rooms, clean bedding, flat-screen TV, reception room, and no remote service.

reviews.title: amazing
reviews.text: The stay at the Dolphin Hotel was excellent and the management was cooperative.

reviews.title: Greaaaaaaat
reviews.text: 🐬🐬Very   nice location....clean and close of beach ...relaxing and calming atmosphere...wonderful design....the staff was very  friendly and kind specially Mr. Youssef the owner....I will definitely  choose it on my next trip inchaellah ♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️

reviews.title: anti women safe
reviews.text: Wasn’t that bad , there is one man to clean and take care of the place hygiene and one man also to take care of place in general booking , asking for something regarding the room etc , the place gets really dark and not safe at night so we women didn’t feel safe enough especially that the doors were easily accessible like you can still open the lock with a fork , sheets and beds , ac and the small bar weren’t the worst but there was for sure better but not there , do i will recommend no.

reviews.title: Worst hotel ever
reviews.text: This is for sure the worst experience I’ve ever had in dahab , no Hygiene whatsoever, the pool water was yellow and when we asked the manger to clean it up he said by the morning and he filled it up with cidim to cover the color and smell without cleaning nor refilling the pool , they tricked us into making this booking with false advertisement of free trips ( which when u arrive and pay in full the will tell you u can only get if you book a paid trip with them ) which is totally misleading and false advertising, bathrooms are extremely unhygienic and smelly

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: This hotel is definitely one of the worst in Dahab, the shower was broken and have not been fixed during all of our stay, even the bathroom door was broken, the pool wasn't clean they only thing that was partially working was the AC, wouldn't recommend this hotel to anyone.

reviews.title: Terrible experience
reviews.text: Stay was horrible. Non of the basic service were provided, They just gave room. No dustbin , no towels, room was untidy, bed was full of dust, bathroom was horrible.As if all this  was not inf, when I opened the tap it had salty water as if it was directly coming from sea. I couldn't take bath, didn't brush my teeth. Got fever. upon requesting several times they didn't provide blanket. Finally I was tired and had to shift my room to some other hotel wasted money for remaining days.Terrible experience. They ruined my holidays.

reviews.title: Total scam!!
reviews.text: Literally the worst place I have ever been to in my life. There is absolutely no organization, no cleanliness, no water, and no proper reception. The rooms are extremely dirty, and we genuinely cannot even sleep. This place is completely unacceptable and inhumane.Do not come here, even if they offer you money to stay. I will be contacting the relevant Egyptian authorities, including the Tourism Police, to report this place.

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Good experience but needs better air conditioner

reviews.title: Appreciation post 🙏
reviews.text: Amazing place with the hottest spot in Lighthouse, very friendly and cozy camp i spent two weeks over there and it was more than a home , i highly recommend it for short & long term stays .Thanks to Ahmad for his professional customer service & hospitality 🙏

reviews.title: Loved  it
reviews.text: The pleace is beautiful and quietClean and well kept.Achmed in the reception was a kind host .We  made the eecervation by wattsup a 2 weeks before our arivle , and they where ready for us . It was good valio for the price  . We had the family room with the kittchen so we were cooking  for ourselvs.The location is great  .Thank you for  a nice vissit

reviews.title: Yes, Yes and yes again!!
reviews.text: Marine Garden is amazing! Its not the rooms (which are perfectly fine) but the atmosphere. Ahmed is a great guy who wants to help you with just about everything. You can sit in the garden or the pillow area and pet all the lovely cats. Sometimes there will be a fire and you can just huddle around it. It is hard to find the words to describe Marine Garden its a tranquil little garden of Eden close to everything. Great tips for Dahab and just allround gezellig! Thanks so much to all the staff but especially Ahmed for making us feel so at home😄 I miss the place allready!

reviews.title: Very good place
reviews.text: We came with 2 kids and had great time here, ahmad and the crew are halping with everything we needed, We are very close to the beach and the center of dahad(light house),defenitly will come back here next time.

reviews.title: Everything I need
reviews.text: I stayed in Marine Gardens in various sessions, winter, spring and this August was the first time I stay there in the summer. The best thing is they have many options for my stay, room, room w bathroom or suite. And they r all clean and convenient.The location is gr8, if you use the street access u find the busy lighthouse restaurants, and from the seaside entrance, u find the calmness and the quiet beach.In the location there is a beautiful coffee place and v good restaurant as well.The staff are friendly and always helpful.My favorite place to stay in Dahab

reviews.title: Great choice
reviews.text: Marine Garden is the kind of place you can book for three nights and suddenly find you've been there three months. Great location with its own beach, close to restaurants, bars and bike rental places, but still very quiet and relaxed. Management are super helpful. Whatever you need, they'll help you arrange and there are people on site who run freediving and rock climbing excursions. Rooms range from very basic with shared bathroom, to more upmarket en-suite options. All are clean and comfortable and prices are extremely reasonable.

reviews.title: Beautiful Relaxed Stay by the Egyptian Red Sea
reviews.text: We spent a month in Marine Garden. The atmosphere was chilled and relaxed, the staff were friendly and kind and the rooms were clean and well furnished. They arranged our airport pick up and drop offs for us and were happy to help us in every way they could. The location is perfect, right in the centre of Dahab's lighthouse area, close to lots of nice shops and restaurants, but also a short walk from peace and solitude by the sea. A great place to stay in Dahab!

reviews.title: Amazing and peaceful place
reviews.text: Marine garden is one of the best places I've been to. The beauty of the camp relies on its simplicity and safety. It's so peaceful and everyone is so respectful and they respect your privacy. They have different types of rooms and accommodations. Ahmed (the manager) is so nice and he speaks really good english. The place has good vibes and positive energy and has its private beach. It's in the heart of Dahab, so everything you need and want is walking distance. I love the place and can't say enough.

reviews.title: Word of mouth
reviews.text: Hello, I come here over 5 years because I feel that’s my second house, dealing with Ahmed, the guy who manages the camp push you to feel that you are more than welcomed He is humble and kind and he is respectful in the matter of the moneyThe camp is a real Heaven by the sea, you are in the middle of every where, you can go outside for the city and for the sea in minutes and you wouldn’t be affected by the chaos at all, it is quiet and clean and specialThe people there are almost the same mindset, free souls and adventurers ❤️ Go go, that’s will be your home

reviews.title: You will definitely love this camp
reviews.text: Probably the nicest camp in Dahab. Perfect for nomads, it's cozy, clean and Ahmed will greet you and make you feel like home. The location is perfect, with a private beach two steps away.Thank you guys for being my second family during my stay in Dahab 🤗

reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.text: nice hotel and we will come back here soon the stuff is nice and the animation team is so friendly❤️❤️❤️

reviews.title: Room & Double bed - 2026
reviews.text: Nice room size with everything you need , really friendly service here as well, would really recommend to anyone staying in the area!

reviews.title: Nice stay in authentic hotel
reviews.text: Simple hotel, with nice authentic rooms opening on a courtyard. The rooms have a fridge, good mattress and authentic bathroom. It is not next to the beach, but everything is a short walk away. Calm at night.

reviews.title: Cute hotel in need of a make-over
reviews.text: I have seen this property from the outside for many years and always wanted to stay there as it seemed to be different in style.The Alf Leila features a cute overall boutique design with mosaic tiles and an oriental touch. Rooms don’t have numbers but names. I really liked my bed built into a niche on a pedestal. The room featured a fridge, aircon and a comfy chair. The bathroom had a large shower.I appreciated that I was contacted in advance to check if I needed transport or anything else. reviews.title: Absolutely Fantastic Location and Extremely Friendly Hotel Staff
reviews.text: DownTown Dahab hotel is located right in front of the water. It is in the middle of everything in Dahab. There are grocery stores, restaurants, shops all around the hotels but yet it is quiet inside the hotel. The exterior of the hotel has a theme of a ship with a sailing mast. The view from the hotel top floor is breathtaking. You can see the entire bay of Dahab from the roof top. There is a sitting area in the very front of the 2nd floor overlooking the street and the bay. It has some soft and conformable chairs and sofas to enjoy the view.This hotels is a small boutique hotel with less than 15 rooms so each guest gets a very focused attention from the staff. The rooms are not that small. It is adequate for 2 people and is clean. The beds are comfortable and the beddings are clean. Each room has air-conditioning, closet, refrigerator and a TV. The windows are not properly seals but that is not a big issue because it hardy ever rains in Dahab. They are currently renovating the hotel and is currently expanding to a slightly bigger hotel. They are adding a new swimming pool in the back plus if not mistaken about 10-12 more rooms. The hotel staff is one of the best I have seen in a long time. They are absolutely super friendly and super super nice. Being a small hotel if you ask anything to one of the staff members then everyone knows about it and therefore things are done a lot faster. The hotel employees will go beyond the normal steps to ensure that every guests are happy and satisfied. During our stay we were dealing with Sahab, he has an excellent attitude of hospitality and customer service. His vision and expertise of helping the customers is a very important and valuable asset for the hotel. The restaurant is located just in-front of the hotel across the street over looking the bay. Every day there are various breakfast options which are all very delicious and healthy. The sitting area is just over the water so you can see the water below. I would say this this is an excellent hotel in my opinion but one advise to every one is that Dahab by its nature is neither similar to Sharm el Sheikh nor to Hurghada or Cairo. So the level of quality of the hotels cannot be justified by comparing with the ones in other larger cities. Dahab is a very laid back mellow village and so are its inhabitants. You can not expect the same level of a 5 star hotel in Dahab compared to other modern cities. Over all the hotel is absolutely fantastic, when the renovation and expansion is fisnihed I believe it will be one of the best hotels in the city center. Most importantly the employees are the best and so I give this hotel a 5 star review.

reviews.title: So terrible
reviews.text: كنت حابة أزور المكان ده من فترة طويلة بسبب الصور والفيديوهات اللي كنت بشوفها، وكنت متحمسة جدًا للتجربة. حاولت أحجز أكتر من مرة وماكانش بيحصل توفيق لحد ما روحت أخيرًا.للأمانة الفيو تحفة والمكان من بره جميل فعلًا، لكن تجربتي للأسف ما كانتش كويسة خالص.أنا كنت ساكنة في العوامة 3 وبعدين نقلت للعوامة 2، والغرف من الداخل محتاجة تصليحات كتير. الدهانات مش كويسة، السباكة مش لطيفة، ومستوى النظافة كان سيئ جدًا، غير كمية الذباب الكبيرة. الفرش كان محروق من سجاير كمان قعدت حوالي 4 أيام من غير تليفزيون رغم إني طلبت أكتر من مرة.اللي خلّى الموضوع أسوأ إن الأسعار عالية جدًا، وبتقارب أو حتى أعلى من بعض أفضل الفنادق في دهب، فكنت متوقعة مستوى خدمة أفضل بكتير.للأسف تجربتي كانت سيئة، ومقدرش أرشّح المكان حاليًا إلا لو تم تحسين مستوى الصيانة والنظافةI had wanted to visit this place for a long time because of all the beautiful photos and videos I saw online, and I was really excited about the experience. However, my experience was unfortunately very disappointing.I first stayed in Houseboat 3 and then moved to Houseboat 2. The rooms really need a lot of maintenance. The paint is not in good condition, the plumbing isn’t great, and the cleanliness was very poor. There were also a lot of flies.
