reviews.title: Poor service & response - Lack of any sense of luxury / comfort
reviews.text: We stayed there for 3 nights in Adha feast in Sept 2015 . We wasn't happy at all from the experience and I guess that was the first and last time to go there .1. Breakfast : It should be available from 7:00 till 10:00 am . It was never available on time . They start to prepare it @ 7:50 with still a lot of missing items. Very poor variety , small quantities , no bakery at all , bread is not fresh, unclean tablecloths , no trash cans !!2. Pool Area : It is full of annoying cats . The swimming pool hoods was making a very loud noise 24/7 and spoiling any sense of quietness / pool enjoyment . On the 2nd day , the hoods were not working , and it caused the pool's water to erupt all over the area and it did wet our shoes and bags !3. Room Cleanliness & Comfort : The closets were dusty . The pillow was very soft and totally uncomfortable . The bathroom has no cleansing lotions and the soaps are of very bad quality . There was no daily room service at all . We stayed for 4 days , no one offered to clean the room or provide us with supplies of soap or tissues . In one of the rooms , the ceiling was wet and dropping water .4. Towels : There are no towels to be taken on the pool . We were supposed to use the same wet one used in our rooms . On second day , we came back from the beach and wanted to have our showers and asked them for clean towels , they informed us that there are no available ones !!!5. Wifi : No Wifi was available in the rooms . It was only around the pools and in balconies , and it was even very weak outdoors.6. Staff : There was no professional stuff with uniforms & tags . The whole staff is almost 3-4 men working around the whole motel . They seem totally unprofessional and they don't understand what they are doing with very poor sense of responsibility and customer's comfort. One day on breakfast , it was ready by 8:10 am, I asked one of them , wasn't it supposed to be ready by 7:00 am ? He stood there staring at me without even apologizing for the delay and turned his back and left.7. Hotel Rate Vs. Response : The hotel rate is more expensive compared by the other ones in the center of the shopping area itself , and yet no value was received for this . This was a very frustrating experience and I don't recommend it for anyone.

reviews.title: Lovely Oasis Close To The Action
reviews.text: We stayed at La Reine for about 5 days while diving the Red Sea.It's just around the corner from the markets and restaurants meaning you don't need a taxi to get around, but it's very quiet nevertheless.Room was cleaned every day except for one day.Overall the place is very clean compared to Cairo, staff added the extra touch when they cleaned the room by putting cooldrinks and bottled water in the freezer as well folding the new clean towels into different shapes every morning (was exciting to get back after a day of diving to see what creations they've made on our beds)Staff was very helpful, even made plenty of phonecalls to help us get tours organised painlessly (free of charge), organised luggage and visa pickup when we had to be somewhere else during another tour, packed us breakfast for the mornings where we had to leave 3am or 7am for a tour. They really went out of their way to make things happen.While waiting for the dive centre jeep to pick us up, we had nice conversations with some of the staff members.They did our washing and we were very happy to have some clean, good smelling clothes again. The pillows were big enough to have a comfy sleep and solid enough to squash mosquitos.Some of the staff struggle to speak English, but there's usually another staff member nearby who will help translate.The only gripes I have with Le Reine, is that the bathroom is very squashed, the shower even more so and the breakfast is a bit skimpy if all you can eat is the bread and have to give away all the cheeses and yoghurt to the stray cats - banana was often too green to eat and I was hoping for maybe a mango to munch instead of all the dairy products (which I can't eat). Luckily the markets around the corner stocked some bananas, so I could fulfil my breakfast-calorie requirements.Overall a very good experience!

reviews.title: fairly inexpensive hotel a block or so from the action
reviews.text: This hotel was decent. Considering you pay the same as for "motel 6" in the US. This was a deal. Cheaper hotels can be found, but without a pool and without breakfast.  It was a two minute walk from the main touristy shopping street and 3 blocks to the cornish of shops and restaurants.  The rooms all have a balcony that looks into the pool. The pool and room was clean.  I had to plug in the fridge, but it was quiet and no problem.  The one little light in the bathroom is not bright enough to shave very well. Good thing I was in bohemian Dahab and didn't have to worry about being clean shaven... LOL.  If you want a step up from the $15 a night hotels, then this place is alright. Not sure what people were talking about with dead mosquitos and such. This was set up by the manager at I-Dive since our group spilled over into needed a second hotel.  It worked for me and the staff were very pleasant. Breakfast was included and it was ok. The usual simple hotel breakfast. They make omelets and crepes for you when you get to the buffet.

reviews.title: Shonky
reviews.text: Arrived here on an organised tour after staying in 4 & 5 star resorts in Luxor aswan and Cairo. This is far from the standard we were promised. Blood stains on the wall from squashed mosquitos, water was leaking around the toilet, beds were filthy, cockeroaches. All other people on our tour group experienced similar problems with their rooms as well.

reviews.title: Must have been a magnificent building in it's prime.
reviews.text: Built of coloured stone around a large central pool. Sweeping staircaises and large potted palms gives the place an air of opulence. Each room has it's own balcony overlooking the pool. The rooms are nicely decorated but in a state of disrepair. In our room none of the doors worked properly, the taps in the bathroom basin were broken and the lock on the room door was close to falling apart. The staff were helpful and there was a free internet computer in the lobby. Breakfast was very good with cornflakes, toast, olives, yoghurt, cucumber, tomato, eggs and a few local dishes to try as well as unlimited tea and coffee. Overall a nice experience.

reviews.title: Cheap and cheerful
reviews.text: We stayed here at Christmas 2007. The pool area and reception is nice and clean. We had a downstairs room with a balcony overlooking the pool. The room was clean and the bed was comfy. It had enough wardrobe space, a tv and fridge. The bathroom was a bit tired and had a green gloss painted door that made it look a bit like an outhouse.The breakfast room was also a bit tired and the breakfasts were ok if you got there early enough (nice coffee and omelettes). The staff were polite and they arranged transport to and from the airport, which was on time and a reasonable cost.The location is great, only 5 minutes to the shops and restaurants of which there are plenty. Despite worries about the food it was all good and plentiful if you stick to the local fare. I don't recommend the Italian Restaurant. The Nessima Resort does an excellent fillet steak for about £7, and it has a great bar with a lovely bar man. Dahab is typically Eqyption and looks a bit run down in places. There's not much to do here if you don't like snorkelling or scuba diving unless you go on organised trips. If you do like diving/snorkelling I would definately come. The red sea is amazing  for both.

reviews.title: best hotel in the heart of Dahab
reviews.text: beautifully renovated hotel with everything you can wish for. Clean, nice rooms, friendly staff, big pool, great location. Just outside of the noisy part and therefore quiet, but only 5 minutes to walk to where the action is. Will have a new professional diving center from October. If you want to stay in Dahab, and not outside in one of those big "cemeteries in the desert", from where you need a taxi everytime you want to go into town, this is the place to book.

reviews.title: Simply Amazing
reviews.text: Greatest place in Dahab for relaxing. Oula and Jimmy are amazing as well as all their workers.  Very helpful and knowledgeable about everything around Dahab.  Made my vacation so amazing. I'll be back for sure!!!!!  I can't believe i had never heard of Dahab before i visited Egypt, everyone needs to go!!

reviews.title: Great Camp excelent team
reviews.text: Wonderfull Camp with fantastic people.The team is the best team we have meet in egypt.Honest trustly and super funny people.If u want a 5Star hotel, don't go there...but if u want to be in a nice atmosphear, well Locatel and super autentic people IS the place.Talking about toilets, cleaness IS not the best, but anything you need, you ask the crew and they Will do everything to solve it.They are in the way to fix everything and i know they WillWe could go other places, but i would choose this one 1000times :)

reviews.title: DON'T GO
reviews.text: Bad smell allover the camp, Dirty BATHROOM!!!!!, Dirty rooms. مكان قذر You can increase your budget a little bit and enjoy your trip in better places in dahab.Note: photos are not Real on trip advisor

reviews.title: Nice staff cozy inner garden good location! Good value for Ur money!!
reviews.text: Come to Dahab it is an amazing place! 200 is a lot of words there is a hammock a volleyball area a campfire big screen relax staff vintage vibe exotic there is communal kitchen but not in use but falafel is cheap so I can only recommend!

reviews.title: This place is a scam
reviews.text: The manager of this hostel is a thief. During our third night it was literally raining in our room so we were forced to move to another hotel, the employees were trying there best but their manager stopped answering their call. During the rain a big part of our clothes and stuff were wet so we lost a lot of time and we kindly asked for a reimbursement but the manager strictly refused and gave the order to not give us any cash. Like it was not enough, we’ve been threatened. Unfortunately this manager doesn’t deserve his employees and should be sanctioned.

reviews.title: AVOID THIS PLACE
reviews.text: Freshly arrived from Jordan, I checked in at 3am without any booking. I woke up at 12pm, the manager Assad comes to me, without even saying hello, how are you or even introducing himself to me and say : "it's 12 you need to leave right now!" I looked at him, laugh and tell him that I just woke up, we are 3 people including myself in the miserable place, there is dozen of other rooms so what's the matter? He said that it's the rule, Check in at 2pm, check out 10am so he was already doing me a favor. I told him that he was very stupid to react this way because I arrived late anyway so you can't apply this rule. He got mad and told me that he will call the police if I don't leave the place immediately. I laugh again, paid 100pounds instead of 150 and left. SO I RECOMMAND YOU GUYS TO NOT GO THIS PLACE EXCEPT IF YOU THINK THIS IS NORMAL

reviews.title: Adequate hostel
reviews.text: This place was the most reasonably priced accommodation in dahab. Service is kind and professional. It is a hostel however so u don’t get the luxuries of an inn or hotel. They rent snorkel masks and provide other services. I saw a sand board by the front desk!Wifi is always a plus and provided at camp😀

reviews.title: A place that shall not exist
reviews.text: People must be kidding by rating this place with more than 2 stars!! It is neither fancy as a hotel, nor too close to the beach like most of the camps in sinai. They don't even have a view of the beach (the photos of the beach are fake).The entrance of the place is a narrow lane that smelled of sewage. I had to change the room twice because of problems with the facilities and I ended up with a room with a broken AC remote control.You don't feel clean around; the WC as an example, I felt like I want to wash my hand after using the sink! so you can imagine the feeling after using the toilet! They don't provide sope BTW. And the water is very salty, so taking a shower is not that refreshing.There was many people around who were neither guests nor staff which was uncomfortable and unprofessional.As a conclusion, I've been to simpler camps and less equipped places. But this place doesn't have the mesmerising touch with nature that may forgive any other drawbacks. And it's not cheap, It has almost the same rate of pricing that better and cleaner places in dahab offers.

reviews.title: Great as usual
reviews.text: It was my second time to stay in Bishbishi garden village, it was a great choice, the staff are polite and friendly specially Sabry, the rooms are pretty decent for sleeping. The place is quiet and private. The location of the hostel is amazing right in the heart of the market.

reviews.title: Pretty basic and not very clean
reviews.text: Not nearly as good as many of the other hotels in Dabab. Not really very clean and in need a of a good renovation!  The room sizes were fine and the food was passable in the restaurant, fairly close to the centre, but not on the waterfront.

reviews.title: Clean, quiet and affordable!
reviews.text: Super convenient, clean and affordable room. I could not have planned a better room for my solo dive trip to Dahab. Not a single insect to be found. Super clean and very friendly hotel. My room near the rear of the hotel was very quiet even during Eid celebrations. I was grateful for the air conditioning during the heat wave. It was steps from shops and restaurants. I was diving with Scuba Zone who are based at this hotel.

reviews.title: One of the Family
reviews.text: During my 16 nights at Jowhara, I truly felt like one of the family. Suleiman and the entire staff showed me consistent kindness and patience. The cuddly cats and the sweet, friendly dog were a delight! I will definitely be returning, hopefully for a longer stay next time. Inshallah!

reviews.title: El Mashraba
reviews.text: The is the most comfortable, clean, cozy and friendly service i have ever been in ! I recommend this place in Dahab ! I had the most interesting experience ever with those guys 😍Thank you guys for everything you’re the best. ♥️

reviews.title: Great place, friendly staff, you get what you pay for
reviews.text: We stayed here a week in november, had a great time. It's located about 5-10 minutes from the beach, and the street leading down there is full of stores, supermarkets, restaurants and basically all you need. Supermarket for water, etc is right outside the hotell. The rooms are simple and not high quality, but its also one of the cheapest hotels in Dahab, so you get what you pay for. We got new towels whenever we wanted and they cleaned the room on request. Aircondition and wifi in the room. The backyard is very cozy, we hung out in the lounge both for breaktfast and in the evening. The staff and the owner, Soliman, was very helpfull and always friendly. We had a late flight back home the day we checked out, and he offered us to keep the room the whole day without paying more. The also helped us book our Sinai-trip with Jimmy from the hotel just up the street. If your fine with living in a simple room and dont want to pay extra for luxury, this is a great place to stay, felt like home!

reviews.title: Lovely hotel!
reviews.text: I had a great stay at Jowhara. The rooms are comfortable, breakfast is delicious, and the staff went above and beyond to make sure that I was comfortable and happy. I felt very safe and cared for (which is especially important for me as a solo female traveler). It’s very quiet and in a great location—tucked just a short walk away from the main downtown.

reviews.title: Amazing people
reviews.text: Jowhara is great in every aspect: price, location, atmosphere... but the people here make the real difference. Everyone on the staff was super friendlyThey kept our bags after checkout, offered us free diner with staff and let us use the bathroom for shower until the departure of our bus to cairo, at 10pm

reviews.title: Friendliest stay in Dahab
reviews.text: We stayed for 4 nights at the Jowhara hotel and completely loved it.It is a simple hotel but our room and bathroom were very clean and we had everything we needed. They provide you with towels but no soap/shampoo.For us the major selling point was the wonderful staff who were a complete delight and made our stay. Imad, Mohamed and Mostafa in particular were fantastic. Imad even woke up on our last day to make us breakfast before our taxi to Sharm El Sheikh Airport at 5am!!! What a superstar. The location is good, in the sleepier/less touristy part of Dahab which we much preferred. Overall would highly recommend.

reviews.title: Great stay! Highly recommended!
reviews.text: We are traveling with our two children and stayed in Jowhara Hotel for a week while we were in Dahab. It was fantastic. They were very easy to book with and responded promptly to emails inquiring about availability. They were very helpful with any tours that we were interested in doing but did not once “push” a tour on us that we had not asked them about. The breakfasts were great and the staff was exceptional. Especially Suleiman. He is wonderful! We would highly recommed Jowhara Hotel to anyone passing through Dahab.

reviews.title: mini Dahab
reviews.text: tge place is very affordable and includes all types of rooms , w/without AC ,ground floor , 1st floor and family room as well with 4 beds ...love the easy , simple and basic life there .they do anything we ask for , and they clean tge rooms once we ask for it ...lovely and friendly ppl ... will go again and again <3

reviews.title: Perfect price and value of money
reviews.text: The hotel is located in the city center and near to most of the markets there, rooms are simply furnished and small. some rooms have a mini bar and some not. Staff there are trying to help you all the time. Fast Check in process.

reviews.title: Worst stay by far
reviews.text: Considering the distressing pattern of behavior of the owner and several staff members, I implore everyone to exercise utmost caution when considering a visit to this establishment. Do not be deceived by its outward appearance of tranquility. The truth lies within the deeply disturbed nature of its owner, Said. Engaging with this place would only invite a nightmarish experience. This is not a mere warning; it is a sincere plea to prioritize your safety and well-being. Said's capacity for violence knows no bounds, capable of inflicting serious harm to the point of requiring hospitalization.For the sake of your own sanity and security, I strongly advise staying far away from this place. The presence of Said and the hotel staff has turned it into a veritable breeding ground of horror, a far cry from the peaceful haven it pretends to be.

reviews.title: BEWARE THE OWNER! HE IS A DRUNKEN SAVAGE
reviews.text: the scene that took place before my eyes was surrealistically messed up. the owner, Said, started beating up an older foreigner over a stupid issue that would normally be discussed in a professional manner but he didn't even leave room for talking, he instantly attacked with a sucker punch and carried on beating him up, also with the help of a younger and equally messed up boy that tried to push me away from stopping him and contributed in the beating. apparently this is not the first time he's done such a thing, and he's generally known for being mentally disturbed in several ways according to many people's testimonies. I could tell he's drunk the minute he got close by the obvious alcohol reek in his breath. he gave the foreigner he assaulted a ruptured eardrum which he could easily be jailed for. stay cautious as the beauty of the place could lure you enough into thinking it's such a peaceful space to be when in reality the person who runs it is the furthest one could be from peace or any basic quality of humanness, which would inevitably make your experience highly prone to being completely ruined. this is a serious warning sign as the guy is actually dangerous and could really lose it on ANYONE to the point of getting them hospitalized, literally.

reviews.title: Horrible stay
reviews.text: one night I was sitting in the lobby because I was bored of staying at the room. That old man from the reception said to me “ well, if you don’t like your room. You can take your money and go.” !!!!!! Seriously I will never recommend this hotel as this was the worst stay ever in my live.

reviews.title: Escape From Daily routine
reviews.text: Stayed at Amanda for 3 nights ten ft away was the sea practically on the beach, however the rocks makes the beach hard to swim, amazing views, room was clean and basic, free breakfast you order for a time and it’s cooked for you ,only a basic breakfast.

reviews.title: Noisy place
reviews.text: Despite the high music sounds after midnight, the rudeness of the staff and their slow services If you are a girl traveling solo the place is not safe for you .. as one of the days I saw one of the staff kissing one of the guests in the kitchen. A day later the guest and I met on the beach and told me the story behind that guy who kissed her and that she feels that he’s using her. The beach is not safe as you have to walk over rocks and corals ( Hotel is not caring about the corals and their health ). I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone even for a one night stay.

reviews.title: Really rude host
reviews.text: We went to ask for the rates, the person who was at the reception was very arrogant in his replies and had no sense of hospitality demeanor.. left us with an awful feeling that would surely never have us returning

reviews.title: BEST PLACE EVER!
reviews.text: I really love every single part of this place, everybody here is great, its one big family..the food is great he people are great everything here is just PERFECT..and Dont forget to tell Luna hi for me..a really nice golder retriever that loves the place like me..

reviews.title: Perfect stay
reviews.text: This hotel truly feels like your home away from home. Mohammed, Rita, Ali, and the rest of the staff welcome you with open arms and make you feel like family. Our room was basic but very clean, with a nice comfortable bed and windows that opened up for a view of the sea. The common areas inside the hotel and out on the beach are the perfect place to unwind and enjoy the views. A few minutes' walk along the seafront brings you into the center of Dahab, where you can find a host of restaurants, shops, and activities. The highlights of our stay were definitely the hotel's puppy, Luna, and the incredible breakfasts served by Ali. We'll be back!

reviews.title: Best place in dahab
reviews.text: The common saying in dahab is   Come as a guest, leave as a friend. At amandas its come as a guest leave part of the family. Mohamad, Rita"mom" are fantastic hosts and Ali makes AMAZING breakfasts everyday. We were only going to stay a wee or so but ended up staying 17 days. 5 min walk to the strip and as quite as can be. Eel garden is a 2 min walk for some of the better snorkeling around. We had the great fortune of "luna". A brand new puppy and got to see her grow up a bit. Hope she remembers us when we return. Ask for the chris and haleigh room

reviews.title: Highly Recommended
reviews.text: Sammy and his wife Rita are very welcoming, characterful, and warm hosts. They are knowledgable and helpful, and have good contacts to arrange anything you need in the area at very reasonable costs. The hotel has a very good location in an area a bit north of the bustle of the tourist 'strip,' on the beach, near a good snorkelling spot - eel garden. The rooms are large, comfortable, clean, the hot water works well, and there's a large common area for sitting around and relaxing. I really enjoyed my stay here, I extended my stay by two weeks.

reviews.title: Simply the best.
reviews.text: I was recommended this diving centre by my father, who is a diving enthusiast himself and was taken here by his colleagues and friends on a holiday trip. They were well known by the owner(s) of Dahab Divers Lodge. When he told me they were very relaxed but fervent at the same time, I was expecting a nice experience. The real thing, however, has still taken me by surprise. From the first moment onwards they treated me like I was a friend, cracking jokes and laughing throughout the first orientation of the course. Later, when we met our diving instructor, I was waiting to see what type of person he was. He seemed to have been selected for the same reason so many people enjoy hanging out at the DDL: very relaxed, thorough and passionate when explaining diving concepts and always ready to answer any questions.To make a long story short: I fell in love with Dahab and with diving because of the Dahab Divers Lodge, and I recommend everyone go to this place if you’re a complete beginner. No matter from where you start, you’ll leave this place a diver.Much love,Hendrik

reviews.title: Amazing Dive Open Water Course!
reviews.text: We had an awesome time at the Dahab Divers Lodge where my brother and 2 friends of us had our first experiences with diving by taking the Open Water Padi Course! All was taken care of: wetsuits, snorkels, cilinders etc! And our instructor was a super calm, relaxed, experienced, skillful and friendly teacher (Ahmed Baahr)! Everyone we encountered was friendly as well :) We enjoyed it so much that we will also be taking the Advanced Diving Course!! So take a chance (and a dive) and definitely visit the Divers Lodge <3 We will for sure come back!

reviews.title:
Dahab. is changing in a not good way
First I call Dahab DOG CITY
reviews.text: Dogs are everywhere, a lot of them on the street, also Egyptians young people have a dog as a status symbol, they prefer pitt bulls.If you don't like dogs, stay away from Dahab till the government take good actions.Its a crazy situation.

reviews.title: Great place to stay!
reviews.text: Stayed there for NYE, very clean and comfortable rooms with great bathrooms and an amazing location and excellent price. The host was brilliant, very helpful and accommodating. Will always stay there!

reviews.title: Best Place to Stay in Dahab
reviews.text: It is the perfect place to stay. The location is central and  all the best restaurants and attractions are  between 1-5 minutes walking distance. The cleans are so CLEAN and COZY. The common area is beautiful and the atmosphere is chilled and comforting. I will only stay here and recommend it for everyone; families, couples, friends and even solo-travelers!

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: We stayed 2 nights in the lodge, and it was perfect. It's the cleanest accommodation we have ever had in Dahab and super charming. The room was bright and colorful with basic furnishings with loads of character. The roof dome and the decoration made the room feel authentic and welcoming. Despite its location close to the Lighthouse area, it's very quiet at night yet close to all the restaurants and shops. We also dove with the Dahab Divers Lodge dive centre who never fail to impress us. They are super well organized with dedicated lockers and dedicated drying areas for all the equipment of each diver. They have great dive guides, very helpful staff and well-maintained rental equipment. All in all a perfect experience that we recommend to anyone going to Dahab.

reviews.title: Super lodge & dive center
reviews.text: Review is divided into three parts, part 1 location, part 2 is for the lodge and part 3 for the dive centerPart#1 locationLocation: 2 mins walking distance from light house diving spot- the main spot in dahab city1 min from everything in Dahab, pharmacy, restaurants, cafes and amazing Ralph German bakery—————————————-Part#2 the lodgeThe lodge is simply amazingRooms are simple with all basic facilities ACPrivate bathroomHot waterTowelsWindows in many placesBeds are clean and niceDesign is simply beautifulHatem the lodge owner is a very nice, helpful and decent guyHe insisted to be there to welcome me and always offering help and making sure everything is going perfectly They use only eco friendly plastic bags :)——————————————-Part #3 dive centerDive center experience is superb with a lot of help from Ibrahim the dive center owner and manager along with amazing staffThe system for diving gear storage, cleaning and managing is very niceAmazing diving instructor whom are friendly and always helpful an offering nice tips and tricks

reviews.title: A gem
reviews.text: We must’ve stayed in maybe 10 different places in our previous visits to Dahab, but this is the only one we came back to. With Dahab, you never really know what you’ll get, accommodation often goes into a state if disrepair and you’ll often find things like a faulty toilet or burnt out lightbulbs or sheets that seem to have bought in 1996. But Dahab Divers Lodge is newly furnished, and very well maintained. We came 4 years ago, and it seemed like it was exactly the same this time.The lodge is furnished in good taste, and everything is clean and in great shape. You’ll find bathroom amenities in place, and rooms smell like freshly cleaned linen. ACs are new and the upper floor domes give a great, spacious feel, with beautiful natural sky lights in the morning.Hatem is always available if you need anything, he is one of the friendliest hotel managers we know.We’ll definitely be coming back here soon.

reviews.title: it was short trip to dahab
reviews.text: it worm welcoming very nice and helpful people so supportive.nice cozy place clean rooms served with all your needs towels and candles  near to the beach and markets so easy to access.so ken to make you satisfied and happy.give you all help you need.

reviews.title: Well organized and friendly
reviews.text: Had 3 days diving with them canyon, pools, blue hole, Abu Talha, and moray gardenThanks Nemo our dive instructor, Saadany, and Ibrahim the ownersFriendly staff, excellent gear, and reasonable prices

tripadvisor.streetAddress: El Melal Street Light House Area , Masbat, Dahab 46617 Egypt

reviews.title: Rating of Jimmy Hotel Summer 2024
reviews.text: The hotel''s location is so sweet and close to every need, it''s nice, simple, and all about literacy, cooperation and any problem they like ... Breakfast is very sweet, sheriff of the hills, respectful, and a caring.. But the fault of Jamie's hotel in need of maintenance, the rooms in trouble, the need for renovation, follow-up, and the attention needed to keep the breakfast spot. They provide chairs and use the place in a perfect way. We had to fire and make a quick break.

reviews.title: Poor management, need maintenance, gas lighting customers, great location tho
reviews.text: Breakfast from 8-11 , went 10:30 to be told that we have no more food nor bread , they even went further to gas light telling me that it’s my fault that I was late . Told the receptionist that offered nothing but sorry !!!Bathroom needed maintenance

reviews.title: Best in town
reviews.text: Very nice and friendly staff with an amazing place to stay in like ur home and as they said (your home away from home)They made the most delicious breakfast with love.The rooms were very clean.The location is perfect near to everywhere.Love this place and people here♥️

reviews.title: WOW
reviews.text: WOW just WOW, such an amazing place. I can't believe I had never heard of Dahab before visiting Egypt.  Jimmy hotel was the most amazing hotel in Dahab. The view, the service, just everything was immaculate, I will be back there for sure.  The staff were very helpful with everything, even giving me a free trip. Amazing experience!!!!!

reviews.title: Good experience, friendly staff
reviews.text: Staff were extremely friendly and helpful. Rooms had nice wooden balconies and there’s a nice sea view. Hotel was nothing deluxe but it was clean. Breakfast pretty basic but does the job. It was close to a lot of shops and restaurants, a few minutes walking distance. Room had great working AC and a minibar.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: This place is highly recommended.  The owner, Jimmy, is extremely helpful and friendly, and simply can't do enough for people.  The hotel is a little oasis and is very pretty.  Such a nice place to stay and felt so safe.

reviews.title: Home far Away From your Home
reviews.text: Very Very very Safe Placewe were three ladies alone, no worries or harassment happened to us.  clean place room includes:- air conditioner- tv and Water kettle- refrigerator smallBIG THANKS to Friendly Stuff it was a great honor meeting you all :)

reviews.title: Best hotel in dahab
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay there and the staff are very friendly and the room was clean and the pool also was clean and it's location is very good and Jimmy the owner is really good person and friendly and will help you to enjoy your stay there

reviews.title: Home far from home 😍😍
reviews.text: I really loved the place it is very cozy staf  are super friendly the place is clean and they try thier best to make your trip memorable plus you will find everything around you restaurants and markets In addition they are the Best trip organizors with reasnable prices

reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text: The room I stayed at was not cleaned nor maintained, I felt as if the bed sheets were not changed. There was no place in the room to put our bags. There were at least four cockroaches, I had to sleep with my bags on the bed just so I wouldn’t have to put them on the floor. The bathroom was not clean, the window was broken and its floor was wet. When we went to the reception to tell them about the cockroaches they came and blamed us for the wet floor. They found it weired that we compalined about the insects. At the end we changed rooms and they said that they would take care of it, but the next morning I found that they rented the room to other guests, so I’m not sure if they really checked the problem out. Anyways, I wouldn’t go there again and would never recommend it to any of my friends.

tripadvisor.streetAddress: Dahab Mashraba St. Down Town, Dahab Egypt

reviews.title: Simple, but everything you need.
reviews.text: Unbeatable for the price. Rooms are not that big, but that's logical for the price. Cleanliness is good for Egypt. Through an alley and you're on the big tourist street.The inner courtyard feels safe; the balconies face inwards and are therefore always in someone's view. There is someone to talk to at any time of day.Earplugs are recommended at night because of barking dogs and deliveries to the restaurants at night (there's a lot of shouting). The communal kitchen and seating area are really cozy. The Bedouins were very nice and open. Air conditioning worked very well.

reviews.title: well managed and very good value
reviews.text: This is probably the best value accommodation in Dahab. Selection of rooms - small and basic with shared bathrooms, ensuites, and more spacious ensuites with balconies. There's two bedouin-style social areas offering shade, plus a couple of benches in the sun. There's a rudimentary kitchen with two fridge-freezers, stove and pans etc. with a new one being built as I write - should be ready in the next few weeks. FREE drinking water (huge bonus, especially if you hate to waste plastic) and a washing machine for guests' use. The place is kept clean and is well managed. Staff and owner are friendly and responsible. There's cats in the common areas (but they don't wander into the rooms). Good location in the middle of Dahab, 1 minute walk to the sea. Especially low rates for longer term stays. My room is an en suite twin with balcony. Two single beds (linen and towels provided), a desk, two chairs, mirror, bedside table, wardrobe, bathroom is fine, balcony is a nice place to relax. Wi-fi is decent most of the time. Note: there's I think three guesthouses in Dahab with the name "kangaroo" and/or "oasis". This is the one at the end of the short alleyway opposite Ali Baba restaurant. I know I sound a bit like an advert, but I'm really pleased to have found this place - been here four weeks now, relaxing, reading, writing. Their whatsapp is +201067037433

reviews.title: Low budget, clean and central
reviews.text: It's clean, low budget( help you save your money for mor excursions in Dahab ) and has a central location in the lighthouse area. The owners are friendly. That's all you need in Dahab. Good for backpackers and not for families. There are also rooms with AC. The only disadvantage is that some bathrooms have no doors. Otherwise is ok.

reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.text: I see it's a nice place cheap , simple, nearby sea , no service here but they have a lovely stuff and you can go anywhere you want it's not so far , they have a small kitchen but useful so you can cook by your self and dining in outdoor place they also have wifi internet .

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: Room was not clean, no air conditions, no fridge, no tv,  no food, no water ,nothing in a room but a bed and I was okay with this but the thing that I was not okay with is the terrible bathroom I saw people's pee and poof in every place no one clean it and sometimes there is no water inside it. As an advice don't even think to go there.

reviews.title: Cheap, clean, friendly staff
reviews.text: We ended up on a last minute road trip to Dahab, and a friend recommended this place. It's nothing fancy, but it was clean and for the price I was totally happy. If you're looking for a place purely to sleep at the end of a long day diving/kitesurfing/drinking it's perfect, but if you're expecting luxury go elsewhere

reviews.title: friendly manger
reviews.text: I am an Egyptian but it's my first visit to Dahab  it's a quit place and full of nature places . the camp is just 10 meters of the sea . take care that there is two camps called kangaroo go to the one in the street in front of "The kitchen "restaurant  the manger called Salah and he is friendly guy he can organize your trips all around Dahab  in the sea and in the desert and he have the best prices of them all. irst look I didn't like the places but in the next 30 min I found it greaaaaaat .I  recommend it

reviews.title: Horrible personnell
reviews.text: Stayed here first for 3 days when we got in trouble with one of the other guests because beer and food was stolen from us out of the common fridge. We didn't see this other guest perform the theft our selfs but the man in charge of the camp, Jamar, insisted it was this other guest and we trusted Jamar. So we got in a fight with the other guest and decided to do a 3 day trip to the desert and other places and then return when the other guest would be gone.The theft of the food didn't stop and we soon realized it was the personnel them self taking guests food from the common kitchen. We complained about this and also that the wifi always was down. Jamar explained that wifi was down in all of Dahab. We told him this wasn't true because it worked fine everywhere else. So his solution to the problem was that he thought that we could go to the other places and use their wifi. We said that that was a ridiculous idea and that he should just fix their wifi. He then went into a frenzy and asked us to stop complaining about everything. We thought it was just fare to point out that our stuff was stolen and that the wifi, that is included in the price, didn't work. There is so much negative things to write about the place so i will try to be as short as I can but it wont.The personell didn't do any of their tasks unless the owner were there. Then they were all over the place, cleaning the rooms, the common places, painting the walls etc. However when he wasn't there they were just a bunch of useless sitting around taking up the guests space, smoking and drinking coffe all the time. They weren't friendly and Jamar were even hostile at times. He was really the core problem of the whole camp. The guest there was great people but he made sure to talk bad- about everyone and try to turn other guest around each other (our example: the false accusation about the guest stealing from us). He even talked ill about the fantastic cat lady who only did good for the community and the camp. Everyone adored her and he couldn't stand someone doing better for his country.Because the workers didn't do any work we the guest our self had to do alla the work. The only one in the work force who really did some of the work was Mohammed who were really friendly and tried to help out and stop Jamars shenanigans.The rooms were cheap but not clean. We had to clean our own rooms. I would so much more recommend the other fighting Kangaroo camp where we moved over to, after being threatened by Jamar who took a frying pan and hit it in the table! where me, my wife and two other people sat and ate breakfast, because he thought we had made a mess in the kitchen. We had spend the entire morning cleaning the camp.After that we immediately packed our things and left. Also, he was threatening everyone that he got in an argue with that he would call the police on them. What the police would do under the different circumstances that occurred were very unclear. Of course he never called the police.A beautiful camp but with a really hostile environment that just makes you want to cut your vacation short.Thanks for listening and please, for your sake, stay at another camp. There are so many good options in Dahab.

reviews.title: nice camp
reviews.text: My room was simple but clean. The price is very cheap. The place is quiet. Mohamed is very friendly and it's a pleasure to drink tea with him.Thank you for your welcome and your simplicity !Christine

reviews.title: Cheap, Cozy and clean
reviews.text: it's quite, clean, cheap and relaxing, they have a variety of rooms rangring between 60 EGP per night to 120 EGP per night for a double airconditioned room with a balcony and a private bathroom,Kitchen is communal and the camp has a laundry room , and both the management and the residents are really friendly . It's a great place to lay on your back and enjoy the relaxing vibes of Dahab

reviews.title: Not that good
reviews.text: Toilets wasn't clean at all and the sheets too. Even after complaining about it, the toilet's stains hadn't been removed. Nice location and a good pool actually. I wouldn't stay in christina again especially room prices are not cheap comparing to other hotels offering same service but more clean

reviews.title: not value for money
reviews.text: From minutw we arrived he grief by manager with empty offers.1. rooms wasnt clean, had get housekeeping and tip him to give.place clea. again2. wifi is RUBBISH AND manager said it was ok , it wasnt , he said he fixed when it wasnt he loves to lie3 no wifi anywhere but rectipin 4. room have a smell , dam5.rooms are.old and dated , doors made.of scrap wood6. plig for fridge stop working, told they fix it ..wasnt it just wedged7.fridge froze stuff8. towels are clean but yellow9. breakfast is Biggest joke.. bread old salsad stay in chiller for days on end ...o ly fresh thing omelete thats not even tasty.Fresh food in dish have bee. made few days ago  and feel food recycled.the jiuce is TANG AND IS DISGUSTINGAVOID BREAKFAST NOT WORTH MONEY10.MANAGER IS ARGUMENTATIVE with craft smile.but doesnt do anything11 . manager got ac.on in his room but not reception so YOU BAKE12 hotel boast it swiss managenment..its Not it run by.egyptian and hotel manager  is running this.hotel into ground.13. note.owner  THIS HOTEL HAS AMAZING POTENTIAL YOU FRONT OFFICE MANAGER IS KILLING YOUR BUSINESS, WHAT SHAME AND WASTEalot money for zero value , i dont see value in staying here ... big mistake i def will not return this hotwl ir recommend it to even locals

reviews.title: Clean comfortable with great view and in the center of activities and attractions
reviews.text: The hotel is clean, and has an wonderful view. It is located to all centers of one-day tourism, and diving centers. All are reachable on foot. It is also 5 min away from the bus stop on foot. Its breakfast is nice and Egyptian. The personel were kind and helpful. We would repeat the stay when we go to Dahab again.

reviews.title: Nice budget hotel
reviews.text: I stayed for three weeks in this budget hotel. It is has a nice pool and a restaurant with a chill out space at the beach. I especially like the interior or the rooms. The breakfast buffet has many different mostly egyptian foods.Sometimes the showers are broken, so check directly after you enter the room. Also the wifi wasn't working properly for some days.The staff is very friendly - especially the breakfast chef :) - and this venue has a good value for the price!

reviews.title: 4 days of stay in this hotel was a nightmare
reviews.text: We got a room for 4 days in Dahab in this hotel. Positive:* Close to beach.* Nice swimming pool* Friendly staffNegatives:* We got first room for a night and then next day we had to ask to change it because shower and hot water system wasnt working.* Got a new room and shower was again broken. Asked to change room again and they replace the shower in few minutes. It was a band-aid fix which didnt work for long. * WIFI is slow.I guess the main reason for this situation is that Dahab as a place is not making any good money because of a decline in foreign tourists. This hotel probably is struggling with providing basic necessities.

reviews.title: The perfect palace to chill out
reviews.text: From the moment I arrived to when I left, everybody was so kind and helpful to me.Yusef, so calm and knowledgeable. He helped me with everything, from paying my stressed out taxi driver on the first night. Important advice on the best laundry, where to change money (when the banks are closed) and the most important thing for me, no big sell concerning the available trips around Dahab. Thank you.I think I must of met everybody who worked there, everyone took the time to talk and help me. Shout out to Ahmed in the restaurant.My room overlooking the pool was perfect, and very clean. The free breakfast had a big choice.Finally, a big thank you to Amal, the princess of the Cristina Beach Palace. Whose smile and friendly conversations made it a joy whenever i met her.

reviews.title: Very cozy atmosphere
reviews.text: The rooms are clean yet need some renewal which i knew they're working on it seriously, the pool is clean and well maintained, they have a restaurant by the beach front which serve nice food, the crew is very helpful and friendly, the owner Mrs Maha and her daughter Ms. Amal are running the hotel themselves so they're doing their best to look after every guest and  take the comments seriously, seems like this  management is new so they're working hard on making everything better. The hotel got a good location, I really loved the place

reviews.title: Too expensive for the service
reviews.text: Room with 2 beds without air conditioning for 300 per night breakfast included.+ Great location+ Nice pool+ Employees are helpful BUT - The wifi is very bad- I had to ask for hot water & shower - You can here the music of the bar from the roomThe place isn't bad but I felt it was too expensive compared to other hotels.

reviews.title: Nice place good location
reviews.text: I stayed at Christina Beach. My husband and I had a good time. The hotel is very close to the beach and in agosto location. I would recommend staying here if you want a nice place to sleep, and don't want to be disturbed.

reviews.title: nice hotel
reviews.text: compared to other budget hotels in Dahab it was a good choice, the reason we chosen this one is because it was so close to our diving center Big Blue Dahab.the breakfast buffet is nicewe took a triple room for me my wife and our two girls, the room was adequate.the hotel cafe on the sea side is very quit and ideal for people looking for relaxation.

tripadvisor.streetAddress: El Mashraba St. Masbat, Dahab 8772509 Egypt

reviews.title: Do not go there
reviews.text: Last day there the “receptionist” suggested we leave out bags in the room, instead of walking around with it and he explicitly said “pick them whenever you want”, we left them, and then when we came back to take them, the owner “Youssef” asked for money because he’s saying “these are the rules and this is not anybody’s fault but ours and the reception is out of it”. Never going to recommend this place to anyone, never coming back again, this is a place with literally no integrity.

reviews.title: 11 day stay
reviews.text: Basic budget accommodation. Centrally located, with private beach access. Everything you could need, from shopping, activities, takeaways and restaurants within a five minute walk. Stand out service from the owners who cannot do enough to welcome you and share their local knowledge

reviews.title: The loveliest place to stay in Dahab
reviews.text: Hands down the friendliest and loveliest place to stay in Dahab. Gracious host, chill setting. The garden is spacious and the rooms often have a private bathroom. Compared to the 40$+ hotels along the coast this is a bargain.

reviews.title: Comfy, cozy, hospitable & a great value for money! Backpacker heaven!
reviews.text: Budget travellers & divers, look no further! "Fighting Kangaroo El Bulti" has everything you need. (Do not confuse it with the other similarly named fighting kangaroo hotel. This one is tucked away next to Seven Heaven hotel right on the main boulevard. A prime spot!).The managers, a married couple, are amazing to interact with. Helpful & keen on making you comfortable. There's a shared equipped open air kitchen, and a nice common courtyard with comfy seats. The rooms are basic but everything is functional & clean. Hot water & AC available. For a central location, it is surprisingly nice & quite at night in the rooms. It's a great price for what you get! And if you're a solo traveller, I'm sure you'll make friends here.

reviews.title: Great location with an unbeatable price.
reviews.text: I have been here quite a few times. I would call myself a regular. Visited with family, friends and solo sometimes.The camp is located in the heart of the action of the boardwalk. Less than a minute walk to all cafes, restaurants and water.Rooms vary from 100 Egyptian pounds (5$) to 250 per night per person based on wether you want a room with AC, own restroom or a fan and a hut. The staff is very friendly and accommodating and the regular guests at the camp are also quite nice.I highly recommend this place for a true Dahab experience. Oh, forgot to write how much I love the name ❤️🤣

reviews.title: Welcome Home
reviews.text: Sam the proprieter and his family are what makes magic of this place.  Sam welcomes you with such a smile and kindness that you truly do feel at home from the first moment.  He keeps the pleasant courtyard impecable, and though the rooms are simple and a bit old, they're clean, functional, and very inexpensive.  Sam is always willing to help with anything you need and never pushes for anything.Also we asked if they offered tours of the Blue Hole and Colored Canyon, which they did, and were the best price we found in town.  (We'd asked at nearly 10 different places).  Excellent value, complete satisfaction.  Especially the Canyon tour we were impressed by: their bedouin guide Mansour spoke excellent English, absolutely loved the desert and what he did, knew tons of information, never hurried or pressed us, and was polite and respectful the whole time.  Try to stay here; if they're booked, at least take a tour with them.

reviews.title: place to sleep
reviews.text: I was in this camp for 2 nights in may 2016 with a friend of mine, we had a double room with an air conditioner that work with 50% of its power, the room has a cupboard.  The bathroom was very bad , no door and the toilet was not working well There is a place outside to sit and relax  with enough cushions we  have our meals in the open area in the middle of the camp , they have good free Wi-Fi , and oven if you like to make tea or coffee.The owners of the camp are nice people, they can take you to the bus station and get you back . The place of the camp is in the middle of everything.

reviews.title: Excellent Service and Owner!
reviews.text: I've been to Dahab 3 times, and I will never stay anywhere except Fighting Kangaroo!  Sam is absolutely the best host you could ever imagine - on my first stay in 2012, I got food poisioning (not from his restaurant, might I add) and he helped me with everything - made me soup especially for my tummy, brought me teas, water, everything, he even drove me to the clinic and stayed with me to make sure I was okay!  There isn't a more gracious and kind host anywhere! Regarding the rooms, they are very economical, clean, and have everything you might need.  He provides a communal fridge where you can store drinks and food and will cater to your needs if you want to cook something.  Some of the rooms have murals inside on the walls which past long term residents have created, and new guests add to which makes it all feel more friendly and like you are at your local spot.  I recommend choosing one of the rooms with A/C for a few extra dollars per night.  Although you don't NEED the A/C, it never hurts to have it in case the breeze dies down at night or you want a few extra hours lie in on a lazy Sunday morning :-)

reviews.title: Great Camp, Great People!
reviews.text: I'm writing this review much belated to my visit last summer.  After arriving in Dahab, I looked for a place to crash and call home for the next month while diving.  I found a great deal at The Fighting Kangaroo and had no regrets.  Its right on the main strip in town and the owners are great.Sam was very helpful and friendly my entire stay and consider a good friend I'd like to see once back in Egypt one day.Lodging is affordable, location is perfect and the atmosphere peaceful.5*

reviews.title: Fighting Kangaroo El Bulti
reviews.text: This is one of the few places in the main strip with true value for money and bedouin hospitality. They offer clean budget rooms and I've stayed here many times and once for a long period...there are many other expats who stay at El Bulti Fighting Kangaroo for long periods.Its a friendly family run place, lead by a bedoin who has been running the place since the 1970s and his son. There are two bedoin camps called Fighting Kangaroo in Dahab, this one is next door to 7th Heaven hotel, tucked in behind just steps away from the main pedestrian street along the ocean. For that reason it can be easy to miss, I only found it by accident myself the first time (I was staying in the other FK and the sign pointing the 'wrong' direction piqued my interest).The owners are happy to arrange trips for you and will sometimes fire up the BBQ to cook for guests. It is quite near the muzin tower of the mosque so you'll hear the calls to prayer quite well, but hey...its Egypt. Overall a really great place to stay in Dahab!

reviews.title: Clean and affordable
reviews.text: Very nice place , at the center of Dahab , clean , well furnished and very friendly staff.

reviews.title: Very good place for a good price.
reviews.text: This is a very good place, I stayed for almost two weeks in the end of april beginning of may. The room was nice and clean, good working aircondition  and a good sized bathroom. Fresh towels as often as you want, just ask and in 30 sec you have fresh towels. Very friendly staff.They served you a good breakfast on the roof. There was also a fridge in the kitchen where you could stor fruit or drinks. And they offered you transfer to and from the airport for a good price. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text: It has been great choice to stay at Dahab Home, the place is very nice clean and comfortably,  new furniture,  very nice breakfast included and staff are very helpful polite and friendly,  highly recommended for all travellers

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Very nice and clean,staff are great help, very close to all restaurants and Caffe,2 minutes walking to the beach ,Will definitely keep staying here at Dahab home, Breakfast on the rooftop is amazing, best sunset view.

reviews.title: Dahab home feels like home
reviews.text: We have been several times in Dahab and this time was first time we stayed in Dahab home. The staff is simply amazing, the kindest, most helpful and they are taking care you get the best of your holiday. The place is cozy, clean and with great breakfast (a mountain view on terrace included:) ). Location is just a step away from the city center.We are looking forward to coming back asap

reviews.title: Great choice
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay at Dahab Home. Tarik and his family are lovely, friendly, helpful people - nothing was too much trouble. The location is great: quiet; only a short walk to the sea front; and very close to numerous cafes and restaurants. We loved having the delicious breakfast on the delightful roof and were very comfortable in our room, which easily met all our needs.

reviews.title: Dahabs Finest
reviews.text: The place is located perfectly, right on the beach, ocean views... Surrounded with restaurants, away from the noise and busy tourist area yet only a couple of minute walk down the wonderful breezy beach walk.Assalah Square is a couple of minutes walk with plenty of local supermarkets fresh fruit and veg shops as well as great cooked food in front of you until after midnight.. Our one bedroom apartment, 104, was ready at 09.30 a.m.We had a minor issue with the cooker, we explain to the boss, Saad. With 30 minutes a brand new cooker was delivered.The WiFi is brilliant.. We stayed in many places in Dahab, as accommodation goes in Dahab this place wins by a long way..  This is the middle of the dessert so don't complain if the walls need a lick of paint.. We contact Saad directly for a good deal through Google chat.. We paid 1000 Egyptian pounds per night ( around £25 per night at the time of writing this) Des and Sinead The Osprey Hotel Kingussie

reviews.title: Breathtaking view
reviews.text: The room was very clean with breathtaking view. The location is close to everything. Abd Elrahman was so helpful and was always there whenever needed. The rooftop is highly recommended.There was high speed wifi in the room. I would totally recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: Calm with motivation
reviews.text: Location is fantastic Clean rooms Staff is nice Owner is so kind Comfortable I arrive about 10 am and reception had fast room , clean and view was great and so clear the location in center of assalah With rocks beach 🏖 i order breakfast it was delicious

reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text: Very bad experience ,the stuff was very rude we had to carry our bags upstairs to our room without them helping at all,asked for a towel didnt receive it ever,bed sheets was dirty and the duvet was dirty the curtains were stained , insects were dead and crushed on the window ,the owner when we called him to say that the bed was not comfy kept calling us to ask if we are going to leave because some one else need the room !! And they kept knocking loudly on the room asking us to leave since 9am ,the worst experience ever ,never again will we go to diamond hotel dahab

reviews.title: Best Hotel to stay in Dahab
reviews.text: Very clean hotel compared to other dahab hotels.The staff is very helpful.I forgot something at hotel and they helped me to get it back so I respect their honesty.Sea view rooms have a very beautiful view.Hotel's own beach has a variety of fish that you love to see ❤️

reviews.title: Yaaayyy♥️♥️♥️
reviews.text: The place is more than amazing 😍😍😍😍 and the staff are very friendly⁦♥️⁩⁦♥️⁩I felt home🖤⁦♥️⁩And the most beautiful thing is that dogs are welcomed 🥰I created many moments not only with my friends, but also with the staff ♥️ And the barbecues 🤤🤤🤤🤤It was hard for me to leave 🥺🥺

reviews.title: solo travel second time
reviews.text: affordable and this is definitely a chilling place the people there is so helpful, friendly and cheerful, decent and so respectful..  the place is so cozy full of pets , near to all your needs and still so quite 🖤

reviews.title: NOT SAFE
reviews.text: I was with 7 friends of mine, 5 girls and 2 boys. We had the most uncomfortable trip ever.First there was no water most of the time And My aircondition was broke in a room that hit 40 degrees easily.Second and the main problem is there is Two non-trained dogs at the entrance of the camp, they used to bark at us and one day they attacked one of my friends and end up with injury in his elbow.

reviews.title: Worst experience ever
reviews.text: we were a group of 8 , rented triple and double rooms , rooms were not clean , bathrooms are nightmare , on and off water supply. the guy responsible is not totally conscious most of the time. they have two dogs , the owner's dog attacked one of my friends and we had to leave and refund our money. the chill out area is far from clean and cozy. paying same price u can find way better alternatives.in owner's defense the dog had all his vaccinations yet a bit aggressive and attacked 4 people before our incident.

reviews.title: Awuful place & Unfriendly hosts
reviews.text: This place is really horrible .. its full of negative energy that forces you to minimize the hours of your stay in it. The people working there are unfriendly and has no minimum basics of hospitality. there were dogs owned by the owner of the place that attacked me and my friends. the pictures added here are not as in reality. the place is unclean at all. and at the end when we wanted to leave they did not want us to refund our money.

reviews.title: Great for camping ...
reviews.text: I was on a solo bike tour and wanted to camp in dahab, Sunrise give me space to set my tent with good services, bathroom, kitchen and amazing company and friendly staff, I even stayed more than I planned.If you want to be in the city but still get to camp and meet like minded people, Sunrise will be your best option.

reviews.title: Very very helpful staff
reviews.text: I made the reservation and Ahmed was soo friendly, actually when i went there we didnot like it, it was so calm and it was really small area, but we cancelled the reservation without any fees and Ahmed helped us find another okace abd he made recommendations. I wish i could stay there but the garden was very small and reems was close but i recommend for others to try the stay.

reviews.title: Fantastic location, exactly what you pay for!
reviews.text: My friend and I travelled to Dahab to dive and a friend of ours who lived there advised us to stay at Sunrise! The price was great we payed 150EP a night and Ahmed was fantastic! The rooms were really basic with 2 beds and a bathroom and some storage spaces for our clothes, everything was really clean and sunrise is a stone throw from the main promenade! Ahmed also offers a campfire in the evening with shisha and a barbecue if you ask, I think that cost us 100EP  each and there was 4 of us. Sunrise is really quiet and we slept really well! I have no complaints it was exactly what we were looking for!

reviews.title: Great location, nothing to complain of
reviews.text: This is where I always stay in Dahab, I'd go back again and again. Haven't ever had a problem here. I don't know, it's hard to explain, but the feel of the place is really nice - chilled, relaxed, never had any problems with noise (only occasionally with 'parties' from nearby places), child-friendly, feels very safe, simple and clean. I like that there are basic emergency supplies in each room (ie. a bottle of Raid insect killer just in case!) The shower is better than most in Dahab. Only difficulty is in getting through to them, their facebook site does not have updated numbers. I don't know what people mean when they say this place cost them 20 GPB. I paid the equivalent of about 10 - maybe the price has gone down. A really enjoyable stay, thanks. It's my home away from home in Dahab. Jay's restaurant is a real winner, too.

reviews.title: Great value
reviews.text: We booked Sunrise Lodge because of an outstanding deal on Groupon which included breakfast and transfers all for £7pp per night! For this price we really feel the lodge delivered 100%. Fantastic location, just behind the beach promenade but perfectly located for access to the dive sites to the north and south of Dahab.Breakfast at Jays was great, even provided pack up for when we had early morning dives. We often ended up at Jays most afternoons because of its location, friendly staff and great strawberry smoothies.The rooms themselves are basic, but what more do you need than a bathroom, bed and somewhere to put your clothes. We did have room 4 to start with which does have a slight smell to it because of the drainage but got moved to room 2 after a couple of hours without even asking which was absolotuly fine and perfect for our week long dive holiday.Ahmed the on-site man is great and will help you with whatever you need. Claire the owner was fantastically helpful with emails before we arrived in Dahab, recommending dive centres, horse riding and various excursions. We would definitely stay here again and would recommend to divers looking to spend their cash on diving rather than a 5* hotel. As we stayed at Sunrise we also got a discount at the dive centre recommended which made the whole thing even better!
